source_hebrew: Westminster Leningrad Codex (pointed text via Sefaria), supplied for reference; the site does not display the Hebrew

verses.english: The proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel,
verses.hebrew: מִשְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹה בֶן־דָּוִד מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: for knowing wisdom and discipline, for understanding words of insight,
verses.hebrew: לָדַעַת חָכְמָה וּמוּסָר לְהָבִין אִמְרֵי בִינָה׃

verses.english: for receiving discipline in wise conduct, righteousness, justice, and equity,
verses.hebrew: לָקַחַת מוּסַר הַשְׂכֵּל צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט וּמֵישָׁרִים׃

verses.english: to give prudence to the inexperienced, knowledge and discretion to the young,
verses.hebrew: לָתֵת לִפְתָאיִם עָרְמָה לְנַעַר דַּעַת וּמְזִמָּה׃

verses.english: Let the wise listen and increase in learning, and the discerning acquire guidance,
verses.hebrew: יִשְׁמַע חָכָם וְיוֹסֶף לֶקַח וְנָבוֹן תַּחְבֻּלוֹת יִקְנֶה׃

verses.english: to understand a proverb and a figurative saying, the words of the wise and their riddles.
verses.hebrew: לְהָבִין מָשָׁל וּמְלִיצָה דִּבְרֵי חֲכָמִים וְחִידֹתָם׃

verses.english: The fear of YHWH is the beginning of knowledge; fools despise wisdom and discipline.
verses.hebrew: יִרְאַת יְהוָה רֵאשִׁית דָּעַת חָכְמָה וּמוּסָר אֱוִילִים בָּזוּ׃

verses.english: Listen, my son, to your father's discipline, and do not abandon your mother's instruction,
verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע בְּנִי מוּסַר אָבִיךָ וְאַל־תִּטֹּשׁ תּוֹרַת אִמֶּךָ׃

verses.english: for they are a graceful garland for your head and necklaces for your neck.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לִוְיַת חֵן הֵם לְרֹאשֶׁךָ וַעֲנָקִים לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: My son, if sinners entice you, do not consent.
verses.hebrew: בְּנִי אִם־יְפַתּוּךָ חַטָּאִים אַל־תֹּבֵא׃

verses.english: If they say, Come with us; let us lie in wait for blood, let us hide for the innocent without cause,
verses.hebrew: אִם־יֹאמְרוּ לְכָה אִתָּנוּ נֶאֶרְבָה לְדָם נִצְפְּנָה לְנָקִי חִנָּם׃

verses.english: let us swallow them alive like Sheol, whole, like those descending to the Pit,
verses.hebrew: נִבְלָעֵם כִּשְׁאוֹל חַיִּים וּתְמִימִים כְּיוֹרְדֵי בוֹר׃

verses.english: we will find every precious possession; we will fill our houses with plunder.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הוֹן יָקָר נִמְצָא נְמַלֵּא בָתֵּינוּ שָׁלָל׃

verses.english: Cast your lot among us; we will all have one purse.
verses.hebrew: גּוֹרָלְךָ תַּפִּיל בְּתוֹכֵנוּ כִּיס אֶחָד יִהְיֶה לְכֻלָּנוּ׃

verses.english: My son, do not walk in the way with them; hold your foot back from their path,
verses.hebrew: בְּנִי אַל־תֵּלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ אִתָּם מְנַע רַגְלְךָ מִנְּתִיבָתָם׃

verses.english: for their feet run toward evil, and they hurry to shed blood.
verses.hebrew: כִּי רַגְלֵיהֶם לָרַע יָרוּצוּ וִימַהֲרוּ לִשְׁפָּךְ־דָּם׃

verses.english: For a net is spread in vain before the eyes of any winged creature,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־חִנָּם מְזֹרָה הָרָשֶׁת בְּעֵינֵי כָל־בַּעַל כָּנָף׃

verses.english: but they lie in wait for their own blood; they hide for their own lives.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵם לְדָמָם יֶאֱרֹבוּ יִצְפְּנוּ לְנַפְשֹׁתָם׃

verses.english: Such are the paths of everyone who gains by greed: it takes the life of its owners.
verses.hebrew: כֵּן אָרְחוֹת כָּל־בֹּצֵעַ בָּצַע אֶת־נֶפֶשׁ בְּעָלָיו יִקָּח׃

verses.english: Wisdom cries aloud outside; in the squares she raises her voice.
verses.hebrew: חָכְמוֹת בַּחוּץ תָּרֹנָּה בָּרְחֹבוֹת תִּתֵּן קוֹלָהּ׃

verses.english: At the head of the noisy streets she calls; at the city's gateways she speaks her words:
verses.hebrew: בְּרֹאשׁ הֹמִיּוֹת תִּקְרָא בְּפִתְחֵי שְׁעָרִים בָּעִיר אֲמָרֶיהָ תֹאמֵר׃

verses.english: How long, inexperienced ones, will you love inexperience, scoffers delight in scoffing, and fools hate knowledge?
verses.hebrew: עַד־מָתַי פְּתָיִם תְּאֵהֲבוּ פֶתִי וְלֵצִים לָצוֹן חָמְדוּ לָהֶם וּכְסִילִים יִשְׂנְאוּ־דָעַת׃

verses.english: Turn at my correction. I will pour out my spirit to you; I will make my words known to you.
verses.hebrew: תָּשׁוּבוּ לְתוֹכַחְתִּי הִנֵּה אַבִּיעָה לָכֶם רוּחִי אוֹדִיעָה דְבָרַי אֶתְכֶם׃

verses.english: Because I called and you refused, I stretched out my hand and no one paid attention,
verses.hebrew: יַעַן קָרָאתִי וַתְּמָאֵנוּ נָטִיתִי יָדִי וְאֵין מַקְשִׁיב׃

verses.english: and you disregarded all my counsel and wanted none of my correction,
verses.hebrew: וַתִּפְרְעוּ כָל־עֲצָתִי וְתוֹכַחְתִּי לֹא אֲבִיתֶם׃

verses.english: I too will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your terror comes,
verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֲנִי בְּאֵידְכֶם אֶשְׂחָק אֶלְעַג בְּבֹא פַחְדְּכֶם׃

verses.english: when your terror comes like devastation and your calamity arrives like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come upon you.
verses.hebrew: בְּבֹא כשאוה [כְשׁוֹאָה ] פַּחְדְּכֶם וְאֵידְכֶם כְּסוּפָה יֶאֱתֶה בְּבֹא עֲלֵיכֶם צָרָה וְצוּקָה׃

verses.english: Then they will call me, but I will not answer; they will seek me eagerly, but will not find me,
verses.hebrew: אָז יִקְרָאֻנְנִי וְלֹא אֶעֱנֶה יְשַׁחֲרֻנְנִי וְלֹא יִמְצָאֻנְנִי׃

verses.english: because they hated knowledge and did not choose the fear of YHWH,
verses.hebrew: תַּחַת כִּי־שָׂנְאוּ דָעַת וְיִרְאַת יְהֹוָה לֹא בָחָרוּ׃

verses.english: wanted none of my counsel, and despised all my correction.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־אָבוּ לַעֲצָתִי נָאֲצוּ כָּל־תּוֹכַחְתִּי׃

verses.english: They will eat the fruit of their way and be filled with their own schemes.
verses.hebrew: וְיֹאכְלוּ מִפְּרִי דַרְכָּם וּמִמֹּעֲצֹתֵיהֶם יִשְׂבָּעוּ׃

verses.english: For the turning away of the inexperienced will kill them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them.
verses.hebrew: כִּי מְשׁוּבַת פְּתָיִם תַּהַרְגֵם וְשַׁלְוַת כְּסִילִים תְּאַבְּדֵם׃

verses.english: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, at ease without fear of harm.
verses.hebrew: וְשֹׁמֵעַ לִי יִשְׁכָּן־בֶּטַח וְשַׁאֲנַן מִפַּחַד רָעָה׃

verses.english: My son, if you receive my words and store my commandments within you,
verses.hebrew: בְּנִי אִם־תִּקַּח אֲמָרָי וּמִצְוֺתַי תִּצְפֹּן אִתָּךְ׃

verses.english: making your ear attend to wisdom and inclining your heart to understanding,
verses.hebrew: לְהַקְשִׁיב לַחָכְמָה אָזְנֶךָ תַּטֶּה לִבְּךָ לַתְּבוּנָה׃

verses.english: indeed, if you call for insight and raise your voice for understanding,
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם לַבִּינָה תִקְרָא לַתְּבוּנָה תִּתֵּן קוֹלֶךָ׃

verses.english: if you seek it like silver and search for it like hidden treasures,
verses.hebrew: אִם־תְּבַקְשֶׁנָּה כַכָּסֶף וְכַמַּטְמוֹנִים תַּחְפְּשֶׂנָּה׃

verses.english: then you will understand the fear of YHWH and find the knowledge of God.
verses.hebrew: אָז תָּבִין יִרְאַת יְהוָה וְדַעַת אֱלֹהִים תִּמְצָא׃

verses.english: For YHWH gives wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge and understanding.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יְהוָה יִתֵּן חָכְמָה מִפִּיו דַּעַת וּתְבוּנָה׃

verses.english: He stores up sound wisdom for the upright, a shield for those walking in integrity,
verses.hebrew: וצפן [יִצְפֹּן] לַיְשָׁרִים תּוּשִׁיָּה מָגֵן לְהֹלְכֵי תֹם׃

verses.english: to guard the paths of justice; He protects the way of His faithful ones.
verses.hebrew: לִנְצֹר אָרְחוֹת מִשְׁפָּט וְדֶרֶךְ חסידו [חֲסִידָיו] יִשְׁמֹר׃

verses.english: Then you will understand righteousness, justice, and equity—every good path.
verses.hebrew: אָז תָּבִין צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט וּמֵישָׁרִים כָּל־מַעְגַּל־טוֹב׃

verses.english: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־תָבוֹא חָכְמָה בְלִבֶּךָ וְדַעַת לְנַפְשְׁךָ יִנְעָם׃

verses.english: Discretion will watch over you; understanding will guard you,
verses.hebrew: מְזִמָּה תִּשְׁמֹר עָלֶיךָ תְּבוּנָה תִנְצְרֶכָּה׃

verses.english: to rescue you from the evil way, from the man who speaks perversities,
verses.hebrew: לְהַצִּילְךָ מִדֶּרֶךְ רָע מֵאִישׁ מְדַבֵּר תַּהְפֻּכוֹת׃

verses.english: from those who abandon upright paths to walk in ways of darkness,
verses.hebrew: הַעֹזְבִים אָרְחוֹת יֹשֶׁר לָלֶכֶת בְּדַרְכֵי־חֹשֶׁךְ׃

verses.english: who rejoice in doing evil and delight in evil perversities,
verses.hebrew: הַשְּׂמֵחִים לַעֲשׂוֹת רָע יָגִילוּ בְּתַהְפֻּכוֹת רָע׃

verses.english: whose paths are crooked and who are devious in their courses,
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר אָרְחֹתֵיהֶם עִקְּשִׁים וּנְלוֹזִים בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתָם׃

verses.english: to rescue you from the stranger woman, from the foreign woman who makes her words smooth,
verses.hebrew: לְהַצִּילְךָ מֵאִשָּׁה זָרָה מִנָּכְרִיָּה אֲמָרֶיהָ הֶחֱלִיקָה׃

verses.english: who abandons the companion of her youth and forgets the covenant of her God.
verses.hebrew: הַעֹזֶבֶת אַלּוּף נְעוּרֶיהָ וְאֶת־בְּרִית אֱלֹהֶיהָ שָׁכֵחָה׃

verses.english: For her house sinks toward death, and her paths lead to the shades.
verses.hebrew: כִּי שָׁחָה אֶל־מָוֶת בֵּיתָהּ וְאֶל־רְפָאִים מַעְגְּלֹתֶיהָ׃

verses.english: None who go to her return, nor do they reach the paths of life.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־בָּאֶיהָ לֹא יְשׁוּבוּן וְלֹא־יַשִּׂיגוּ אָרְחוֹת חַיִּים׃

verses.english: Thus you may walk in the way of the good and keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.hebrew: לְמַעַן תֵּלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ טוֹבִים וְאָרְחוֹת צַדִּיקִים תִּשְׁמֹר׃

verses.english: For the upright will inhabit the land, and the blameless will remain in it,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יְשָׁרִים יִשְׁכְּנוּ אָרֶץ וּתְמִימִים יִוָּתְרוּ בָהּ׃

verses.english: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the treacherous uprooted from it.
verses.hebrew: וּרְשָׁעִים מֵאֶרֶץ יִכָּרֵתוּ וּבוֹגְדִים יִסְּחוּ מִמֶּנָּה׃

verses.english: My son, do not forget my instruction; let your heart keep my commandments,
verses.hebrew: בְּנִי תּוֹרָתִי אַל־תִּשְׁכָּח וּמִצְוֺתַי יִצֹּר לִבֶּךָ׃

verses.english: for they will add length of days, years of life, and peace to you.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֹרֶךְ יָמִים וּשְׁנוֹת חַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם יוֹסִיפוּ לָךְ׃

verses.english: Do not let loyal love and faithfulness leave you. Bind them around your neck; write them on the tablet of your heart.
verses.hebrew: חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת אַל־יַעַזְבֻךָ קָשְׁרֵם עַל־גַּרְגְּרוֹתֶיךָ כָּתְבֵם עַל־לוּחַ לִבֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Then find favor and good understanding in the eyes of God and humanity.
verses.hebrew: וּמְצָא־חֵן וְשֵׂכֶל־טוֹב בְּעֵינֵי אֱלֹהִים וְאָדָם׃

verses.english: Trust YHWH with all your heart; do not lean on your own understanding.
verses.hebrew: בְּטַח אֶל־יְהוָה בְּכָל־לִבֶּךָ וְאֶל־בִּינָתְךָ אַל־תִּשָּׁעֵן׃

verses.english: In all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.
verses.hebrew: בְּכָל־דְּרָכֶיךָ דָעֵהוּ וְהוּא יְיַשֵּׁר אֹרְחֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear YHWH and turn away from evil.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תְּהִי חָכָם בְּעֵינֶיךָ יְרָא אֶת־יְהוָה וְסוּר מֵרָע׃

verses.english: It will be healing to your navel and refreshment to your bones.
verses.hebrew: רִפְאוּת תְּהִי לְשָׁרֶּךָ וְשִׁקּוּי לְעַצְמוֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Honor YHWH from your wealth and from the first of all your produce,
verses.hebrew: כַּבֵּד אֶת־יְהוָה מֵהוֹנֶךָ וּמֵרֵאשִׁית כָּל־תְּבוּאָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: and your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.
verses.hebrew: וְיִמָּלְאוּ אֲסָמֶיךָ שָׂבָע וְתִירוֹשׁ יְקָבֶיךָ יִפְרֹצוּ׃

verses.english: My son, do not reject YHWH's discipline or be disgusted by His correction,
verses.hebrew: מוּסַר יְהוָה בְּנִי אַל־תִּמְאָס וְאַל־תָּקֹץ בְּתוֹכַחְתּוֹ׃

verses.english: for YHWH corrects the one He loves, as a father the son in whom he delights.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֶת אֲשֶׁר יֶאֱהַב יְהוָה יוֹכִיחַ וּכְאָב אֶת־בֵּן יִרְצֶה׃

verses.english: Happy is the person who finds wisdom, the person who obtains understanding,
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם מָצָא חָכְמָה וְאָדָם יָפִיק תְּבוּנָה׃

verses.english: for her gain is better than the gain of silver, and her yield better than gold.
verses.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב סַחְרָהּ מִסְּחַר־כָּסֶף וּמֵחָרוּץ תְּבוּאָתָהּ׃

verses.english: She is more precious than corals, and none of your desires can compare with her.
verses.hebrew: יְקָרָה הִיא מפניים [מִפְּנִינִים] וְכָל־חֲפָצֶיךָ לֹא יִשְׁווּ־בָהּ׃

verses.english: Length of days is in her right hand; in her left are wealth and honor.
verses.hebrew: אֹרֶךְ יָמִים בִּימִינָהּ בִּשְׂמֹאולָהּ עֹשֶׁר וְכָבוֹד׃

verses.english: H — [No corresponding passage in the selected Hebrew text.]
verses.hebrew: אֹרֶךְ יָמִים בִּימִינָהּ בִּשְׂמֹאולָהּ עֹשֶׁר וְכָבוֹד׃

verses.english: Her ways are pleasant ways, and all her paths are peace.
verses.hebrew: דְּרָכֶיהָ דַרְכֵי־נֹעַם וְכָל־נְתִיבוֹתֶיהָ שָׁלוֹם׃

verses.english: She is a tree of life to those who grasp her; those who hold her fast are called happy.
verses.hebrew: עֵץ־חַיִּים הִיא לַמַּחֲזִיקִים בָּהּ וְתֹמְכֶיהָ מְאֻשָּׁר׃

verses.english: YHWH founded the earth by wisdom; He established the heavens by understanding.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה בְּחָכְמָה יָסַד־אָרֶץ כּוֹנֵן שָׁמַיִם בִּתְבוּנָה׃

verses.english: By His knowledge the deeps were split open, and the clouds drip dew.
verses.hebrew: בְּדַעְתּוֹ תְּהוֹמוֹת נִבְקָעוּ וּשְׁחָקִים יִרְעֲפוּ־טָל׃

verses.english: My son, do not let them slip from your eyes; keep sound wisdom and discretion,
verses.hebrew: בְּנִי אַל־יָלֻזוּ מֵעֵינֶיךָ נְצֹר תֻּשִׁיָּה וּמְזִמָּה׃

verses.english: and they will be life to your soul and grace for your neck.
verses.hebrew: וְיִהְיוּ חַיִּים לְנַפְשֶׁךָ וְחֵן לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: H — [No corresponding passage in the selected Hebrew text.]
verses.hebrew: וְיִהְיוּ חַיִּים לְנַפְשֶׁךָ וְחֵן לְגַרְגְּרֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Then you will walk your way securely, and your foot will not stumble.
verses.hebrew: אָז תֵּלֵךְ לָבֶטַח דַּרְכֶּךָ וְרַגְלְךָ לֹא תִגּוֹף׃

verses.english: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
verses.hebrew: אִם־תִּשְׁכַּב לֹא־תִפְחָד וְשָׁכַבְתָּ וְעָרְבָה שְׁנָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Do not fear sudden terror or the devastation of the wicked when it comes,
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּירָא מִפַּחַד פִּתְאֹם וּמִשֹּׁאַת רְשָׁעִים כִּי תָבֹא׃

verses.english: for YHWH will be your confidence and guard your foot from capture.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יְהוָה יִהְיֶה בְכִסְלֶךָ וְשָׁמַר רַגְלְךָ מִלָּכֶד׃

verses.english: Do not withhold good from those to whom it belongs when your hand has the power to do it.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּמְנַע־טוֹב מִבְּעָלָיו בִּהְיוֹת לְאֵל ידיך [יָדְךָ] לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

verses.english: Do not say to your neighbor, Go and return; tomorrow I will give, when you have it with you.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תֹּאמַר לרעיך [לְרֵעֲךָ ] לֵךְ וָשׁוּב וּמָחָר אֶתֵּן וְיֵשׁ אִתָּךְ׃

verses.english: Do not plan evil against your neighbor when he lives securely beside you.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּחֲרֹשׁ עַל־רֵעֲךָ רָעָה וְהוּא־יוֹשֵׁב לָבֶטַח אִתָּךְ׃

verses.english: Do not quarrel with anyone without cause, if he has done you no harm.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תרוב [תָּרִיב] עִם־אָדָם חִנָּם אִם־לֹא גְמָלְךָ רָעָה׃

verses.english: Do not envy a violent man or choose any of his ways,
verses.hebrew: אַל־תְּקַנֵּא בְּאִישׁ חָמָס וְאַל־תִּבְחַר בְּכָל־דְּרָכָיו׃

verses.english: for the devious person is an abomination to YHWH, but His intimate counsel is with the upright.
verses.hebrew: כִּי תוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה נָלוֹז וְאֶת־יְשָׁרִים סוֹדוֹ׃

verses.english: YHWH's curse is in the wicked person's house, but He blesses the dwelling of the righteous.
verses.hebrew: מְאֵרַת יְהוָה בְּבֵית רָשָׁע וּנְוֵה צַדִּיקִים יְבָרֵךְ׃

verses.english: He scoffs at scoffers, but gives grace to the humble.
verses.hebrew: אִם־לַלֵּצִים הוּא־יָלִיץ ולעניים [וְלַעֲנָוִים] יִתֶּן־חֵן׃

verses.english: The wise will inherit honor, but fools raise up disgrace.
verses.hebrew: כָּבוֹד חֲכָמִים יִנְחָלוּ וּכְסִילִים מֵרִים קָלוֹן׃

verses.english: Listen, children, to a father's discipline; pay attention to gain understanding,
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ בָנִים מוּסַר אָב וְהַקְשִׁיבוּ לָדַעַת בִּינָה׃

verses.english: for I give you good teaching; do not abandon my instruction.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֶקַח טוֹב נָתַתִּי לָכֶם תּוֹרָתִי אַל־תַּעֲזֹבוּ׃

verses.english: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child before my mother,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־בֵן הָיִיתִי לְאָבִי רַךְ וְיָחִיד לִפְנֵי אִמִּי׃

verses.english: and he taught me and said to me, Let your heart hold fast to my words; keep my commandments and live.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּרֵנִי וַיֹּאמֶר לִי יִתְמָךְ־דְּבָרַי לִבֶּךָ שְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתַי וֶחְיֵה׃

verses.english: Acquire wisdom; acquire understanding. Do not forget or turn away from the words of my mouth.
verses.hebrew: קְנֵה חָכְמָה קְנֵה בִינָה אַל־תִּשְׁכַּח וְאַל־תֵּט מֵאִמְרֵי־פִי׃

verses.english: Do not abandon her, and she will keep you; love her, and she will guard you.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּעַזְבֶהָ וְתִשְׁמְרֶךָּ אֱהָבֶהָ וְתִצְּרֶךָּ׃

verses.english: Prize her, and she will exalt you; she will honor you when you embrace her.
verses.hebrew: סַלְסְלֶהָ וּתְרוֹמְמֶךָּ תְּכַבֵּדְךָ כִּי תְחַבְּקֶנָּה׃

verses.english: She will place a graceful garland on your head; she will bestow a glorious crown on you.
verses.hebrew: תִּתֵּן לְרֹאשְׁךָ לִוְיַת־חֵן עֲטֶרֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת תְּמַגְּנֶךָּ׃

verses.english: Listen, my son, and receive my words, and your years of life will increase.
verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע בְּנִי וְקַח אֲמָרָי וְיִרְבּוּ לְךָ שְׁנוֹת חַיִּים׃

verses.english: I have taught you in wisdom's way; I have led you in upright tracks.
verses.hebrew: בְּדֶרֶךְ חָכְמָה הֹרֵתִיךָ הִדְרַכְתִּיךָ בְּמַעְגְּלֵי־יֹשֶׁר׃

verses.english: When you walk, your steps will not be cramped; when you run, you will not stumble.
verses.hebrew: בְּלֶכְתְּךָ לֹא־יֵצַר צַעֲדֶךָ וְאִם־תָּרוּץ לֹא תִכָּשֵׁל׃

verses.english: Hold fast to discipline; do not let go. Guard her, for she is your life.
verses.hebrew: הַחֲזֵק בַּמּוּסָר אַל־תֶּרֶף נִצְּרֶהָ כִּי־הִיא חַיֶּיךָ׃

verses.english: Do not enter the path of the wicked or advance along the way of evil people.
verses.hebrew: בְּאֹרַח רְשָׁעִים אַל־תָּבֹא וְאַל־תְּאַשֵּׁר בְּדֶרֶךְ רָעִים׃

verses.english: Avoid it; do not pass through it. Turn aside from it and pass on.
verses.hebrew: פְּרָעֵהוּ אַל־תַּעֲבָר־בּוֹ שְׂטֵה מֵעָלָיו וַעֲבוֹר׃

verses.english: For they cannot sleep unless they do evil; their sleep is stolen unless they make someone stumble.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא יִשְׁנוּ אִם־לֹא יָרֵעוּ וְנִגְזְלָה שְׁנָתָם אִם־לֹא יכשולו [יַכְשִׁילוּ׃]

verses.english: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לָחֲמוּ לֶחֶם רֶשַׁע וְיֵין חֲמָסִים יִשְׁתּוּ׃

verses.english: But the path of the righteous is like a shining light, growing brighter until the day is fully established.
verses.hebrew: וְאֹרַח צַדִּיקִים כְּאוֹר נֹגַהּ הוֹלֵךְ וָאוֹר עַד־נְכוֹן הַיּוֹם׃

verses.english: The way of the wicked is like deep darkness; they do not know what makes them stumble.
verses.hebrew: דֶּרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים כָּאֲפֵלָה לֹא יָדְעוּ בַּמֶּה יִכָּשֵׁלוּ׃

verses.english: My son, attend to my words; incline your ear to my sayings.
verses.hebrew: בְּנִי לִדְבָרַי הַקְשִׁיבָה לַאֲמָרַי הַט־אָזְנֶךָ׃

verses.english: Do not let them slip from your eyes; keep them within your heart,
verses.hebrew: אַל־יַלִּיזוּ מֵעֵינֶיךָ שָׁמְרֵם בְּתוֹךְ לְבָבֶךָ׃

verses.english: for they are life to those who find them and healing to all their flesh.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־חַיִּים הֵם לְמֹצְאֵיהֶם וּלְכָל־בְּשָׂרוֹ מַרְפֵּא׃

verses.english: Above everything guarded, guard your heart, for from it flow the outlets of life.
verses.hebrew: מִכָּל־מִשְׁמָר נְצֹר לִבֶּךָ כִּי־מִמֶּנּוּ תּוֹצְאוֹת חַיִּים׃

verses.english: Remove crooked speech from yourself; put devious lips far from you.
verses.hebrew: הָסֵר מִמְּךָ עִקְּשׁוּת פֶּה וּלְזוּת שְׂפָתַיִם הַרְחֵק מִמֶּךָּ׃

verses.english: Let your eyes look straight ahead, and your eyelids direct themselves before you.
verses.hebrew: עֵינֶיךָ לְנֹכַח יַבִּיטוּ וְעַפְעַפֶּיךָ יַיְשִׁרוּ נֶגְדֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Level the track for your foot, and let all your ways be established.
verses.hebrew: פַּלֵּס מַעְגַּל רַגְלֶךָ וְכָל־דְּרָכֶיךָ יִכֹּנוּ׃

verses.english: Do not turn to the right or the left; turn your foot away from evil.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תֵּט־יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול הָסֵר רַגְלְךָ מֵרָע׃

verses.english: H — [No corresponding passage in the selected Hebrew text.]
verses.hebrew: אַל־תֵּט־יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול הָסֵר רַגְלְךָ מֵרָע׃

verses.english: H — [No corresponding passage in the selected Hebrew text.]
verses.hebrew: אַל־תֵּט־יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאול הָסֵר רַגְלְךָ מֵרָע׃

verses.english: My son, attend to my wisdom; incline your ear to my understanding,
verses.hebrew: בְּנִי לְחָכְמָתִי הַקְשִׁיבָה לִתְבוּנָתִי הַט־אָזְנֶךָ׃

verses.english: to guard discretion, and let your lips preserve knowledge.
verses.hebrew: לִשְׁמֹר מְזִמּוֹת וְדַעַת שְׂפָתֶיךָ יִנְצֹרוּ׃

verses.english: For an outsider woman's lips drip honey, and her palate is smoother than oil,
verses.hebrew: כִּי נֹפֶת תִּטֹּפְנָה שִׂפְתֵי זָרָה וְחָלָק מִשֶּׁמֶן חִכָּהּ׃

verses.english: but her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.
verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ מָרָה כַלַּעֲנָה חַדָּה כְּחֶרֶב פִּיּוֹת׃

verses.english: Her feet descend to death; her steps take hold of Sheol.
verses.hebrew: רַגְלֶיהָ יֹרְדוֹת מָוֶת שְׁאוֹל צְעָדֶיהָ יִתְמֹכוּ׃

verses.english: She gives no thought to the path of life; her tracks wander, and she does not know.
verses.hebrew: אֹרַח חַיִּים פֶּן־תְּפַלֵּס נָעוּ מַעְגְּלֹתֶיהָ לֹא תֵדָע׃

verses.english: Now, sons, listen to me, and do not turn from the sayings of my mouth.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה בָנִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִי וְאַל־תָּסוּרוּ מֵאִמְרֵי־פִי׃

verses.english: Keep your way far from her, and do not approach the entrance of her house,
verses.hebrew: הַרְחֵק מֵעָלֶיהָ דַרְכֶּךָ וְאַל־תִּקְרַב אֶל־פֶּתַח בֵּיתָהּ׃

verses.english: lest you give your splendor to others and your years to a cruel one,
verses.hebrew: פֶּן־תִּתֵּן לַאֲחֵרִים הוֹדֶךָ וּשְׁנֹתֶיךָ לְאַכְזָרִי׃

verses.english: lest strangers be filled with your strength, and your hard-earned gains be in an outsider's house,
verses.hebrew: פֶּן־יִשְׂבְּעוּ זָרִים כֹּחֶךָ וַעֲצָבֶיךָ בְּבֵית נָכְרִי׃

verses.english: and you groan at your end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,
verses.hebrew: וְנָהַמְתָּ בְאַחֲרִיתֶךָ בִּכְלוֹת בְּשָׂרְךָ וּשְׁאֵרֶךָ׃

verses.english: and say, “How I hated discipline! My heart despised correction.
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵיךְ שָׂנֵאתִי מוּסָר וְתוֹכַחַת נָאַץ לִבִּי׃

verses.english: I did not listen to my instructors' voice or incline my ear to my teachers.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־שָׁמַעְתִּי בְּקוֹל מוֹרָי וְלִמְלַמְּדַי לֹא־הִטִּיתִי אָזְנִי׃

verses.english: I was nearly in every kind of evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.”
verses.hebrew: כִּמְעַט הָיִיתִי בְכָל־רָע בְּתוֹךְ קָהָל וְעֵדָה׃

verses.english: Drink water from your cistern, flowing water from within your well.
verses.hebrew: שְׁתֵה־מַיִם מִבּוֹרֶךָ וְנֹזְלִים מִתּוֹךְ בְּאֵרֶךָ׃

verses.english: Should your springs scatter outside, streams of water in the squares?
verses.hebrew: יָפוּצוּ מַעְיְנֹתֶיךָ חוּצָה בָּרְחֹבוֹת פַּלְגֵי־מָיִם׃

verses.english: Let them be yours alone, with no strangers sharing them with you.
verses.hebrew: יִהְיוּ־לְךָ לְבַדֶּךָ וְאֵין לְזָרִים אִתָּךְ׃

verses.english: Let your fountain be blessed, and rejoice in the wife of your youth,
verses.hebrew: יְהִי־מְקוֹרְךָ בָרוּךְ וּשְׂמַח מֵאֵשֶׁת נְעוּרֶךָ׃

verses.english: a loving doe and a graceful mountain goat. Let her breasts satisfy you at every time; be always enraptured in her love.
verses.hebrew: אַיֶּלֶת אֲהָבִים וְיַעֲלַת־חֵן דַּדֶּיהָ יְרַוֻּךָ בְכָל־עֵת בְּאַהֲבָתָהּ תִּשְׁגֶּה תָמִיד׃

verses.english: Why, my son, be enraptured with an outsider woman and embrace a stranger's bosom?
verses.hebrew: וְלָמָּה תִשְׁגֶּה בְנִי בְזָרָה וּתְחַבֵּק חֵק נָכְרִיָּה׃

verses.english: For a man's ways are before YHWH's eyes, and He weighs all his tracks.
verses.hebrew: כִּי נֹכַח עֵינֵי יְהוָה דַּרְכֵי־אִישׁ וְכָל־מַעְגְּלֹתָיו מְפַלֵּס׃

verses.english: His iniquities capture him—the wicked man; he is held by the cords of his sin.
verses.hebrew: עַווֹנוֹתָיו יִלְכְּדֻנוֹ אֶת־הָרָשָׁע וּבְחַבְלֵי חַטָּאתוֹ יִתָּמֵךְ׃

verses.english: He dies for lack of discipline; in the abundance of his folly he goes astray.
verses.hebrew: הוּא יָמוּת בְּאֵין מוּסָר וּבְרֹב אִוַּלְתּוֹ יִשְׁגֶּה׃

verses.english: My son, if you have pledged yourself for your neighbor, struck your palms for a stranger,
verses.hebrew: בְּנִי אִם־עָרַבְתָּ לְרֵעֶךָ תָּקַעְתָּ לַזָּר כַּפֶּיךָ׃

verses.english: you have been snared by your mouth's sayings, captured by your mouth's sayings.
verses.hebrew: נוֹקַשְׁתָּ בְאִמְרֵי־פִיךָ נִלְכַּדְתָּ בְּאִמְרֵי־פִיךָ׃

verses.english: Then do this, my son, and rescue yourself, for you have come into your neighbor's hand: go, humble yourself and press your neighbors.
verses.hebrew: עֲשֵׂה זֹאת אֵפוֹא בְּנִי וְהִנָּצֵל כִּי בָאתָ בְכַף־רֵעֶךָ לֵךְ הִתְרַפֵּס וּרְהַב רֵעֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Give no sleep to your eyes or slumber to your eyelids.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתֵּן שֵׁנָה לְעֵינֶיךָ וּתְנוּמָה לְעַפְעַפֶּיךָ׃

verses.english: Rescue yourself like a gazelle from a hand, like a bird from the trapper's hand.
verses.hebrew: הִנָּצֵל כִּצְבִי מִיָּד וּכְצִפּוֹר מִיַּד יָקוּשׁ׃

verses.english: Go to the ant, sluggard; see its ways and become wise.
verses.hebrew: לֵךְ־אֶל־נְמָלָה עָצֵל רְאֵה דְרָכֶיהָ וַחֲכָם׃

verses.english: It has no chief, officer or ruler,
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר אֵין־לָהּ קָצִין שֹׁטֵר וּמֹשֵׁל׃

verses.english: yet it prepares its bread in summer, gathers its food at harvest.
verses.hebrew: תָּכִין בַּקַּיִץ לַחְמָהּ אָגְרָה בַקָּצִיר מַאֲכָלָהּ׃

verses.english: How long will you lie down, sluggard? When will you rise from your sleep?
verses.hebrew: עַד־מָתַי עָצֵל תִּשְׁכָּב מָתַי תָּקוּם מִשְּׁנָתֶךָ׃

verses.english: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to lie down—
verses.hebrew: מְעַט שֵׁנוֹת מְעַט תְּנוּמוֹת מְעַט חִבֻּק יָדַיִם לִשְׁכָּב׃

verses.english: and your poverty comes like a prowler, your want like a man with a shield.
verses.hebrew: וּבָא־כִמְהַלֵּךְ רֵאשֶׁךָ וּמַחְסֹרְךָ כְּאִישׁ מָגֵן׃

verses.hebrew: וּבָא־כִמְהַלֵּךְ רֵאשֶׁךָ וּמַחְסֹרְךָ כְּאִישׁ מָגֵן׃

verses.english: A worthless person, a man of wickedness, walks with a crooked mouth,
verses.hebrew: אָדָם בְּלִיַּעַל אִישׁ אָוֶן הוֹלֵךְ עִקְּשׁוּת פֶּה׃

verses.english: winking with his eyes, signaling with his feet, pointing with his fingers.
verses.hebrew: קֹרֵץ בְּעֵינָו מֹלֵל בְּרַגְלָו מֹרֶה בְּאֶצְבְּעֹתָיו׃

verses.english: Perversities are in his heart; he devises evil at every time, sends out quarrels.
verses.hebrew: תַּהְפֻּכוֹת בְּלִבּוֹ חֹרֵשׁ רָע בְּכָל־עֵת מדנים [מִדְיָנִים] יְשַׁלֵּחַ׃

verses.english: Therefore his disaster comes suddenly; in an instant he is broken, with no healing.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן פִּתְאֹם יָבוֹא אֵידוֹ פֶּתַע יִשָּׁבֵר וְאֵין מַרְפֵּא׃

verses.english: There are six things YHWH hates, seven that are abominations to His soul:
verses.hebrew: שֶׁשׁ־הֵנָּה שָׂנֵא יְהוָה וְשֶׁבַע תועבות [תּוֹעֲבַת] נַפְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: lofty eyes, a lying tongue, hands shedding innocent blood,
verses.hebrew: עֵינַיִם רָמוֹת לְשׁוֹן שָׁקֶר וְיָדַיִם שֹׁפְכוֹת דָּם־נָקִי׃

verses.english: a heart devising wicked plans, feet hurrying to run to evil,
verses.hebrew: לֵב חֹרֵשׁ מַחְשְׁבוֹת אָוֶן רַגְלַיִם מְמַהֲרוֹת לָרוּץ לָרָעָה׃

verses.english: a false witness who breathes out lies, and one who sends quarrels among brothers.
verses.hebrew: יָפִיחַ כְּזָבִים עֵד שָׁקֶר וּמְשַׁלֵּחַ מְדָנִים בֵּין אַחִים׃

verses.english: Guard, my son, your father's commandment, and do not forsake your mother's instruction.
verses.hebrew: נְצֹר בְּנִי מִצְוַת אָבִיךָ וְאַל־תִּטֹּשׁ תּוֹרַת אִמֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Bind them always upon your heart; fasten them around your neck.
verses.hebrew: קָשְׁרֵם עַל־לִבְּךָ תָמִיד עָנְדֵם עַל־גַּרְגְּרֹתֶךָ׃

verses.english: When you walk, she will lead you; when you lie down, she will guard you; when you wake, she will converse with you.
verses.hebrew: בְּהִתְהַלֶּכְךָ תַּנְחֶה אֹתָךְ בְּשָׁכְבְּךָ תִּשְׁמֹר עָלֶיךָ וַהֲקִיצוֹתָ הִיא תְשִׂיחֶךָ׃

verses.english: For the commandment is a lamp and instruction a light; corrective discipline is life's way,
verses.hebrew: כִּי נֵר מִצְוָה וְתוֹרָה אוֹר וְדֶרֶךְ חַיִּים תּוֹכְחוֹת מוּסָר׃

verses.english: to guard you from the evil woman, from the smooth tongue of an outsider woman.
verses.hebrew: לִשְׁמָרְךָ מֵאֵשֶׁת רָע מֵחֶלְקַת לָשׁוֹן נָכְרִיָּה׃

verses.english: Do not desire her beauty in your heart, and do not let her capture you with her eyelids.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּחְמֹד יָפְיָהּ בִּלְבָבֶךָ וְאַל־תִּקָּחֲךָ בְּעַפְעַפֶּיהָ׃

verses.english: For a prostitute's price is as much as a loaf of bread, but another man's wife hunts a precious life.
verses.hebrew: כִּי בְעַד־אִשָּׁה זוֹנָה עַד־כִּכַּר לָחֶם וְאֵשֶׁת אִישׁ נֶפֶשׁ יְקָרָה תָצוּד׃

verses.english: Can a man gather fire into his bosom without his garments being burned?
verses.hebrew: הֲיַחְתֶּה אִישׁ אֵשׁ בְּחֵיקוֹ וּבְגָדָיו לֹא תִשָּׂרַפְנָה׃

verses.english: Or can a man walk on coals without his feet being scorched?
verses.hebrew: אִם־יְהַלֵּךְ אִישׁ עַל־הַגֶּחָלִים וְרַגְלָיו לֹא תִכָּוֶינָה׃

verses.english: So is the one who goes in to his neighbor's wife: no one who touches her will go unpunished.
verses.hebrew: כֵּן הַבָּא אֶל־אֵשֶׁת רֵעֵהוּ לֹא יִנָּקֶה כָּל־הַנֹּגֵעַ בָּהּ׃

verses.english: People do not despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself because he is hungry.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יָבוּזוּ לַגַּנָּב כִּי יִגְנוֹב לְמַלֵּא נַפְשׁוֹ כִּי יִרְעָב׃

verses.english: But if found, he repays sevenfold; he gives all the wealth of his house.
verses.hebrew: וְנִמְצָא יְשַׁלֵּם שִׁבְעָתָיִם אֶת־כָּל־הוֹן בֵּיתוֹ יִתֵּן׃

verses.english: The one committing adultery with a woman lacks sense; he who destroys himself does this.
verses.hebrew: נֹאֵף אִשָּׁה חֲסַר־לֵב מַשְׁחִית נַפְשׁוֹ הוּא יַעֲשֶׂנָּה׃

verses.english: He finds injury and disgrace, and his reproach will not be wiped away.
verses.hebrew: נֶגַע־וְקָלוֹן יִמְצָא וְחֶרְפָּתוֹ לֹא תִמָּחֶה׃

verses.english: For jealousy is a man's fury; he will not spare on the day of vengeance.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־קִנְאָה חֲמַת־גָּבֶר וְלֹא־יַחְמוֹל בְּיוֹם נָקָם׃

verses.english: He will show no favor to any ransom, and will not consent though you multiply a bribe.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יִשָּׂא פְּנֵי כָל־כֹּפֶר וְלֹא־יֹאבֶה כִּי תַרְבֶּה־שֹׁחַד׃

verses.english: My son, guard my sayings, and store my commandments with you.
verses.hebrew: בְּנִי שְׁמֹר אֲמָרָי וּמִצְוֺתַי תִּצְפֹּן אִתָּךְ׃

verses.english: H — [No corresponding text in the displayed Hebrew main text.]
verses.hebrew: בְּנִי שְׁמֹר אֲמָרָי וּמִצְוֺתַי תִּצְפֹּן אִתָּךְ׃

verses.english: Guard my commandments and live, my instruction like the pupil of your eyes.
verses.hebrew: שְׁמֹר מִצְוֺתַי וֶחְיֵה וְתוֹרָתִי כְּאִישׁוֹן עֵינֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Bind them upon your fingers; write them upon the tablet of your heart.
verses.hebrew: קָשְׁרֵם עַל־אֶצְבְּעֹתֶיךָ כָּתְבֵם עַל־לוּחַ לִבֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Say to wisdom, “You are my sister,” and call understanding your intimate companion,
verses.hebrew: אֱמֹר לַחָכְמָה אֲחֹתִי אָתְּ וּמֹדָע לַבִּינָה תִקְרָא׃

verses.english: to guard you from an outsider woman, from the stranger who smooths her sayings.
verses.hebrew: לִשְׁמָרְךָ מֵאִשָּׁה זָרָה מִנָּכְרִיָּה אֲמָרֶיהָ הֶחֱלִיקָה׃

verses.english: For at my house's window I looked out through my lattice,
verses.hebrew: כִּי בְּחַלּוֹן בֵּיתִי בְּעַד אֶשְׁנַבִּי נִשְׁקָפְתִּי׃

verses.english: and I saw among the simple, discerned among the sons, a young man lacking sense,
verses.hebrew: וָאֵרֶא בַפְּתָאיִם אָבִינָה בַבָּנִים נַעַר חֲסַר־לֵב׃

verses.english: passing through the market street near her corner, stepping along the way to her house,
verses.hebrew: עֹבֵר בַּשּׁוּק אֵצֶל פִּנָּהּ וְדֶרֶךְ בֵּיתָהּ יִצְעָד׃

verses.english: at twilight, in the evening of the day, in the blackness of night and darkness.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֶשֶׁף־בְּעֶרֶב יוֹם בְּאִישׁוֹן לַיְלָה וַאֲפֵלָה׃

verses.english: and look, a woman meets him, dressed as a prostitute and guarded in heart.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה אִשָּׁה לִקְרָאתוֹ שִׁית זוֹנָה וּנְצֻרַת לֵב׃

verses.english: She is noisy and rebellious; her feet do not stay in her house.
verses.hebrew: הֹמִיָּה הִיא וְסֹרָרֶת בְּבֵיתָהּ לֹא־יִשְׁכְּנוּ רַגְלֶיהָ׃

verses.english: Now outside, now in the squares, she lurks at every corner.
verses.hebrew: פַּעַם בַּחוּץ פַּעַם בָּרְחֹבוֹת וְאֵצֶל כָּל־פִּנָּה תֶאֱרֹב׃

verses.english: She seizes him and kisses him; with a bold face she says to him,
verses.hebrew: וְהֶחֱזִיקָה בּוֹ וְנָשְׁקָה־לּוֹ הֵעֵזָה פָנֶיהָ וַתֹּאמַר לוֹ׃

verses.english: “Peace-offering sacrifices were due from me; today I paid my vows.
verses.hebrew: זִבְחֵי שְׁלָמִים עָלָי הַיּוֹם שִׁלַּמְתִּי נְדָרָי׃

verses.english: That is why I came out to meet you, to seek your face eagerly, and I found you.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן יָצָאתִי לִקְרָאתֶךָ לְשַׁחֵר פָּנֶיךָ וָאֶמְצָאֶךָּ׃

verses.english: I have spread coverings over my couch, patterned fabrics of Egyptian thread.
verses.hebrew: מַרְבַדִּים רָבַדְתִּי עַרְשִׂי חֲטֻבוֹת אֵטוּן מִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes and cinnamon.
verses.hebrew: נַפְתִּי מִשְׁכָּבִי מֹר אֲהָלִים וְקִנָּמוֹן׃

verses.english: Come, let us drink our fill of lovemaking until morning; let us delight in love.
verses.hebrew: לְכָה נִרְוֶה דֹדִים עַד־הַבֹּקֶר נִתְעַלְּסָה בָּאֳהָבִים׃

verses.english: For the man is not in his house; he has gone on a distant journey.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֵין הָאִישׁ בְּבֵיתוֹ הָלַךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ מֵרָחוֹק׃

verses.english: He took the silver pouch in his hand; on the day of the full moon he will come to his house.”
verses.hebrew: צְרוֹר־הַכֶּסֶף לָקַח בְּיָדוֹ לְיוֹם הַכֵּסֶא יָבֹא בֵיתוֹ׃

verses.english: She turns him aside with her many persuasions; with her lips' smoothness she drives him away.
verses.hebrew: הִטַּתּוּ בְּרֹב לִקְחָהּ בְּחֵלֶק שְׂפָתֶיהָ תַּדִּיחֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: Suddenly he goes after her, like an ox going to slaughter, like a fetter for a fool's discipline,
verses.hebrew: הוֹלֵךְ אַחֲרֶיהָ פִּתְאֹם כְּשׁוֹר אֶל־טָבַח יָבוֹא וּכְעֶכֶס אֶל־מוּסַר אֱוִיל׃

verses.english: until an arrow splits his liver, like a bird rushing to the snare, not knowing it concerns his life.
verses.hebrew: עַד יְפַלַּח חֵץ כְּבֵדוֹ כְּמַהֵר צִפּוֹר אֶל־פָּח וְלֹא־יָדַע כִּי־בְנַפְשׁוֹ הוּא׃

verses.english: Now, sons, listen to me; attend to the sayings of my mouth.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה בָנִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִי וְהַקְשִׁיבוּ לְאִמְרֵי־פִי׃

verses.english: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways; do not stray in her paths.
verses.hebrew: אַל־יֵשְׂטְ אֶל־דְּרָכֶיהָ לִבֶּךָ אַל־תֵּתַע בִּנְתִיבוֹתֶיהָ׃

verses.english: For many are the slain she has brought down, and mighty are all she has killed.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־רַבִּים חֲלָלִים הִפִּילָה וַעֲצֻמִים כָּל־הֲרֻגֶיהָ׃

verses.english: Her house is ways to Sheol, descending to death's chambers.
verses.hebrew: דַּרְכֵי שְׁאוֹל בֵּיתָהּ יֹרְדוֹת אֶל־חַדְרֵי־מָוֶת׃

verses.english: Does not Wisdom call, and Understanding raise her voice?
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא־חָכְמָה תִקְרָא וּתְבוּנָה תִּתֵּן קוֹלָהּ׃

verses.english: At the top of the heights beside the road, at the meeting of the paths she stands.
verses.hebrew: בְּרֹאשׁ־מְרוֹמִים עֲלֵי־דָרֶךְ בֵּית נְתִיבוֹת נִצָּבָה׃

verses.english: Beside the gates, at the mouth of the town, at the entrance of the doorways she cries out:
verses.hebrew: לְיַד־שְׁעָרִים לְפִי־קָרֶת מְבוֹא פְתָחִים תָּרֹנָּה׃

verses.english: “To you, men, I call, and my voice is to the children of humankind.
verses.hebrew: אֲלֵיכֶם אִישִׁים אֶקְרָא וְקוֹלִי אֶל־בְּנֵי אָדָם׃

verses.english: Understand shrewdness, you simple ones; and you fools, understand with the heart.
verses.hebrew: הָבִינוּ פְתָאיִם עָרְמָה וּכְסִילִים הָבִינוּ לֵב׃

verses.english: Listen, for I will speak noble things, and the opening of my lips will be upright things.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ כִּי־נְגִידִים אֲדַבֵּר וּמִפְתַּח שְׂפָתַי מֵישָׁרִים׃

verses.english: For my palate will utter truth, and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־אֱמֶת יֶהְגֶּה חִכִּי וְתוֹעֲבַת שְׂפָתַי רֶשַׁע׃

verses.english: All the sayings of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing twisted or crooked in them.
verses.hebrew: בְּצֶדֶק כָּל־אִמְרֵי־פִי אֵין בָּהֶם נִפְתָּל וְעִקֵּשׁ׃

verses.english: They are all straightforward to one who understands, and upright to those who find knowledge.
verses.hebrew: כֻּלָּם נְכֹחִים לַמֵּבִין וִישָׁרִים לְמֹצְאֵי דָעַת׃

verses.english: Take my discipline rather than silver, and knowledge rather than choice gold.
verses.hebrew: קְחוּ־מוּסָרִי וְאַל־כָּסֶף וְדַעַת מֵחָרוּץ נִבְחָר׃

verses.english: For wisdom is better than precious gems, and all desirable things cannot equal her.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־טוֹבָה חָכְמָה מִפְּנִינִים וְכָל־חֲפָצִים לֹא יִשְׁווּ־בָהּ׃

verses.english: I, Wisdom, dwell with shrewdness, and I find knowledge of thoughtful plans.
verses.hebrew: אֲ‍נִי־חָכְמָה שָׁכַנְתִּי עָרְמָה וְדַעַת מְזִמּוֹת אֶמְצָא׃

verses.english: The fear of YHWH is hatred of evil; pride and arrogance and the evil way and a perverse mouth I hate.
verses.hebrew: יִרְאַת יְהוָה שְׂנֹאת רָע גֵּאָה וְגָאוֹן וְדֶרֶךְ רָע וּפִי תַהְפֻּכוֹת שָׂנֵאתִי׃

verses.english: Counsel and sound resourcefulness are mine; I am understanding; strength is mine.
verses.hebrew: לִי־עֵצָה וְתוּשִׁיָּה אֲנִי בִינָה לִי גְבוּרָה׃

verses.english: By me kings reign, and rulers decree righteousness.
verses.hebrew: בִּי מְלָכִים יִמְלֹכוּ וְרוֹזְנִים יְחֹקְקוּ צֶדֶק׃

verses.english: By me princes rule, and nobles—all who judge righteously.
verses.hebrew: בִּי שָׂרִים יָשֹׂרוּ וּנְדִיבִים כָּל־שֹׁפְטֵי צֶדֶק׃

verses.english: I love those who love me, and those who diligently seek me will find me.
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי אהביה [אֹהֲבַי] אֵהָב וּמְשַׁחֲרַי יִמְצָאֻנְנִי׃

verses.english: Wealth and honor are with me, enduring substance and righteousness.
verses.hebrew: עֹשֶׁר־וְכָבוֹד אִתִּי הוֹן עָתֵק וּצְדָקָה׃

verses.english: My fruit is better than gold, than refined gold, and my yield than choice silver.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב פִּרְיִי מֵחָרוּץ וּמִפָּז וּתְבוּאָתִי מִכֶּסֶף נִבְחָר׃

verses.english: I walk in the path of righteousness, in the midst of the tracks of justice,
verses.hebrew: בְּאֹרַח־צְדָקָה אֲהַלֵּך בְּתוֹךְ נְתִיבוֹת מִשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: to cause those who love me to inherit substance, and to fill their storehouses.
verses.hebrew: לְהַנְחִיל אֹהֲבַי יֵשׁ וְאֹצְרֹתֵיהֶם אֲמַלֵּא׃

verses.hebrew: לְהַנְחִיל אֹהֲבַי יֵשׁ וְאֹצְרֹתֵיהֶם אֲמַלֵּא׃

verses.english: YHWH acquired me as the beginning of His way, before His works of long ago.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה קָנָנִי רֵאשִׁית דַּרְכּוֹ קֶדֶם מִפְעָלָיו מֵאָז׃

verses.english: From eternity I was installed, from the beginning, from before the earth.
verses.hebrew: מֵעוֹלָם נִסַּכְתִּי מֵרֹאשׁ מִקַּדְמֵי־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: When there were no deeps I was brought forth, when there were no springs heavy with water.
verses.hebrew: בְּאֵין־תְּהֹמוֹת חוֹלָלְתִּי בְּאֵין מַעְיָנוֹת נִכְבַּדֵּי־מָיִם׃

verses.english: Before the mountains were sunk in place, before the hills I was brought forth,
verses.hebrew: בְּטֶרֶם הָרִים הָטְבָּעוּ לִפְנֵי גְבָעוֹת חוֹלָלְתִּי׃

verses.english: while He had not yet made earth and open country, or the first dust of the inhabited world.
verses.hebrew: עַד־לֹא עָשָׂה אֶרֶץ וְחוּצוֹת וְרֹאשׁ עָפְרוֹת תֵּבֵל׃

verses.english: When He established the heavens, I was there; when He inscribed a circle on the face of the deep,
verses.hebrew: בַּהֲכִינוֹ שָׁמַיִם שָׁם אָנִי בְּחוּקוֹ חוּג עַל־פְּנֵי תְהוֹם׃

verses.english: when He made the clouds above firm, when the springs of the deep grew strong,
verses.hebrew: בְּאַמְּצוֹ שְׁחָקִים מִמָּעַל בַּעֲזוֹז עִינוֹת תְּהוֹם׃

verses.english: when He set its boundary for the sea, so that the waters would not pass beyond His command, when He inscribed the foundations of the earth,
verses.hebrew: בְּשׂוּמוֹ לַיָּם חֻקּוֹ וּמַיִם לֹא יַעַבְרוּ־פִיו בְּחוּקוֹ מוֹסְדֵי אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: then I was beside Him as a master worker, and I was delight day by day, playing before Him at every time,
verses.hebrew: וָאֶהְיֶה אֶצְלוֹ אָמוֹן וָאֶהְיֶה שַׁעֲשֻׁעִים יוֹם יוֹם מְשַׂחֶקֶת לְפָנָיו בְּכָל־עֵת׃

verses.english: playing in His inhabited earth, and my delight was with the children of humankind.
verses.hebrew: מְשַׂחֶקֶת בְּתֵבֵל אַרְצוֹ וְשַׁעֲשֻׁעַי אֶת־בְּנֵי אָדָם׃

verses.english: And now, children, listen to me; happy are those who keep my ways.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה בָנִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִי וְאַשְׁרֵי דְּרָכַי יִשְׁמֹרוּ׃

verses.english: Happy is the person who listens to me, keeping watch at my doors day by day, guarding the posts of my entrances.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם שֹׁמֵעַ לִי לִשְׁקֹד עַל־דַּלְתֹתַי יוֹם יוֹם לִשְׁמֹר מְזוּזֹת פְּתָחָי׃

verses.english: For whoever finds me has found life, and obtains favor from YHWH.
verses.hebrew: כִּי מֹצְאִי מצאי [מָצָא] חַיִּים וַיָּפֶק רָצוֹן מֵיְהוָה׃

verses.english: But whoever sins against me does violence to his own life; all who hate me love death.”
verses.hebrew: וְחֹטְאִי חֹמֵס נַפְשׁוֹ כָּל־מְשַׂנְאַי אָהֲבוּ מָוֶת׃

verses.english: Wisdom has built her house; she has hewn out her seven pillars.
verses.hebrew: חָכְמוֹת בָּנְתָה בֵיתָהּ חָצְבָה עַמּוּדֶיהָ שִׁבְעָה׃

verses.english: She has slaughtered her slaughter-beasts, mixed her wine, and also arranged her table.
verses.hebrew: טָבְחָה טִבְחָהּ מָסְכָה יֵינָהּ אַף עָרְכָה שֻׁלְחָנָהּ׃

verses.english: She has sent her young women; she calls from the heights of the town's high places:
verses.hebrew: שָׁלְחָה נַעֲרֹתֶיהָ תִקְרָא עַל־גַּפֵּי מְרֹמֵי קָרֶת׃

verses.english: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” To one lacking heart she says:
verses.hebrew: מִי־פֶתִי יָסֻר הֵנָּה חֲסַר־לֵב אָמְרָה לּוֹ׃

verses.english: “Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine I have mixed.
verses.hebrew: לְכוּ לַחֲמוּ בְלַחֲמִי וּשְׁתוּ בְּיַיִן מָסָכְתִּי׃

verses.english: Leave the simple ones and live, and walk straight in the way of understanding.”
verses.hebrew: עִזְבוּ פְתָאיִם וִחְיוּ וְאִשְׁרוּ בְּדֶרֶךְ בִּינָה׃

verses.english: One who disciplines a scoffer takes disgrace for himself, and one who reproves a wicked person—his blemish.
verses.hebrew: יֹסֵר לֵץ לֹקֵחַ לוֹ קָלוֹן וּמוֹכִיחַ לְרָשָׁע מוּמוֹ׃

verses.english: Do not reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you; reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תּוֹכַח לֵץ פֶּן־יִשְׂנָאֶךָּ הוֹכַח לְחָכָם וְיֶאֱהָבֶךָּ׃

verses.english: Give to a wise person, and he will become still wiser; make known to a righteous person, and he will add learning.
verses.hebrew: תֵּן לְחָכָם וְיֶחְכַּם־עוֹד הוֹדַע לְצַדִּיק וְיוֹסֶף לֶקַח׃

verses.english: The beginning of wisdom is the fear of YHWH, and knowledge of holy ones is understanding.
verses.hebrew: תְּחִלַּת חָכְמָה יִרְאַת יְהוָה וְדַעַת קְדֹשִׁים בִּינָה׃

verses.english: For by me your days will multiply, and years of life will be added to you.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־בִי יִרְבּוּ יָמֶיךָ וְיוֹסִיפוּ לְּךָ שְׁנוֹת חַיִּים׃

verses.hebrew: מַיִם־גְּנוּבִים יִמְתָּקוּ וְלֶחֶם סְתָרִים יִנְעָם׃

verses.hebrew: מִשְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹה בֵּן חָכָם יְשַׂמַּח־אָב וּבֵן כְּסִיל תּוּגַת אִמּוֹ׃

verses.english: Treasures of wickedness do not profit, but righteousness rescues from death.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יוֹעִילוּ אוֹצְרוֹת רֶשַׁע וּצְדָקָה תַּצִּיל מִמָּוֶת׃

verses.english: YHWH will not let a righteous person's life go hungry, but He thrusts away the craving of the wicked.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יַרְעִיב יְהוָה נֶפֶשׁ צַדִּיק וְהַוַּת רְשָׁעִים יֶהְדֹּף׃

verses.english: One who works with a slack palm becomes poor, but the hand of the diligent makes rich.
verses.hebrew: רָאשׁ עֹשֶׂה כַף־רְמִיָּה וְיַד חָרוּצִים תַּעֲשִׁיר׃

verses.english: H — [No corresponding text in the displayed Hebrew main text.]
verses.hebrew: רָאשׁ עֹשֶׂה כַף־רְמִיָּה וְיַד חָרוּצִים תַּעֲשִׁיר׃

verses.english: One who gathers in summer is a prudent son; one who sleeps deeply at harvest is a son who brings shame.
verses.hebrew: אֹגֵר בַּקַּיִץ בֵּן מַשְׂכִּיל נִרְדָּם בַּקָּצִיר בֵּן מֵבִישׁ׃

verses.english: Blessings are upon the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
verses.hebrew: בְּרָכוֹת לְרֹאשׁ צַדִּיק וּפִי רְשָׁעִים יְכַסֶּה חָמָס׃

verses.english: The memory of the righteous is a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.
verses.hebrew: זֵכֶר צַדִּיק לִבְרָכָה וְשֵׁם רְשָׁעִים יִרְקָב׃

verses.english: The wise of heart accepts commands, but a fool of lips will be brought down.
verses.hebrew: חֲכַם־לֵב יִקַּח מִצְוֺת וֶאֱוִיל שְׂפָתַיִם יִלָּבֵט׃

verses.english: One who walks in integrity walks securely, but one who makes his ways crooked will be known.
verses.hebrew: הוֹלֵךְ בַּתֹּם יֵלֶךְ בֶּטַח וּמְעַקֵּשׁ דְּרָכָיו יִוָּדֵעַ׃

verses.english: One who winks an eye causes pain, and a fool of lips will be brought down.
verses.hebrew: קֹרֵץ עַיִן יִתֵּן עַצָּבֶת וֶאֱוִיל שְׂפָתַיִם יִלָּבֵט׃

verses.english: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
verses.hebrew: מְקוֹר חַיִּים פִּי צַדִּיק וּפִי רְשָׁעִים יְכַסֶּה חָמָס׃

verses.english: Hatred stirs up disputes, but love covers all transgressions.
verses.hebrew: שִׂנְאָה תְּעוֹרֵר מְדָנִים וְעַל כָּל־פְּשָׁעִים תְּכַסֶּה אַהֲבָה׃

verses.english: Wisdom is found on the lips of one who understands, but a rod is for the back of one lacking heart.
verses.hebrew: בְּשִׂפְתֵי נָבוֹן תִּמָּצֵא חָכְמָה וְשֵׁבֶט לְגֵו חֲסַר־לֵב׃

verses.english: Wise people store up knowledge, but the mouth of a fool is destruction near at hand.
verses.hebrew: חֲכָמִים יִצְפְּנוּ־דָעַת וּפִי־אֱוִיל מְחִתָּה קְרֹבָה׃

verses.english: A rich man's substance is his fortified town; the ruin of the poor is their poverty.
verses.hebrew: הוֹן עָשִׁיר קִרְיַת עֻזּוֹ מְחִתַּת דַּלִּים רֵישָׁם׃

verses.english: The earnings of the righteous are for life, the yield of the wicked for sin.
verses.hebrew: פְּעֻלַּת צַדִּיק לְחַיִּים תְּבוּאַת רָשָׁע לְחַטָּאת׃

verses.english: One who keeps discipline is a path to life, but one who abandons reproof leads astray.
verses.hebrew: אֹרַח לְחַיִּים שׁוֹמֵר מוּסָר וְעוֹזֵב תּוֹכַחַת מַתְעֶה׃

verses.english: One who conceals hatred has lying lips, and one who brings forth slander is a fool.
verses.hebrew: מְכַסֶּה שִׂנְאָה שִׂפְתֵי־שָׁקֶר וּמוֹצִא דִבָּה הוּא כְסִיל׃

verses.english: In a multitude of words transgression does not cease, but one who restrains his lips acts prudently.
verses.hebrew: בְּרֹב דְּבָרִים לֹא יֶחְדַּל־פָּשַׁע וְחֹשֵׂךְ שְׂפָתָיו מַשְׂכִּיל׃

verses.english: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver; the heart of the wicked is worth little.
verses.hebrew: כֶּסֶף נִבְחָר לְשׁוֹן צַדִּיק לֵב רְשָׁעִים כִּמְעָט׃

verses.english: The lips of the righteous shepherd many, but fools die for lack of heart.
verses.hebrew: שִׂפְתֵי צַדִּיק יִרְעוּ רַבִּים וֶאֱוִילִים בַּחֲסַר־לֵב יָמוּתוּ׃

verses.english: The blessing of YHWH—it makes rich, and He adds no sorrow with it.
verses.hebrew: בִּרְכַּת יְהוָה הִיא תַעֲשִׁיר וְלֹא־יוֹסִף עֶצֶב עִמָּהּ׃

verses.english: Doing mischief is like sport to a fool, and so is wisdom to a person of understanding.
verses.hebrew: כִּשְׂחוֹק לִכְסִיל עֲשׂוֹת זִמָּה וְחָכְמָה לְאִישׁ תְּבוּנָה׃

verses.english: What the wicked person dreads will come upon him, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
verses.hebrew: מְגוֹרַת רָשָׁע הִיא תְבוֹאֶנּוּ וְתַאֲוַת צַדִּיקִים יִתֵּן׃

verses.english: When a whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more, but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
verses.hebrew: כַּעֲבוֹר סוּפָה וְאֵין רָשָׁע וְצַדִּיק יְסוֹד עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: Like vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so is the lazy person to those who send him.
verses.hebrew: כַּחֹמֶץ לַשִּׁנַּיִם וְכֶעָשָׁן לָעֵינָיִם כֵּן הֶעָצֵל לְשֹׁלְחָיו׃

verses.english: The fear of YHWH adds days, but the years of the wicked will be shortened.
verses.hebrew: יִרְאַת יְהוָה תּוֹסִיף יָמִים וּשְׁנוֹת רְשָׁעִים תִּקְצֹרְנָה׃

verses.english: The expectation of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
verses.hebrew: תּוֹחֶלֶת צַדִּיקִים שִׂמְחָה וְתִקְוַת רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד׃

verses.english: The way of YHWH is a stronghold for integrity, but ruin for those who work wrongdoing.
verses.hebrew: מָעוֹז לַתֹּם דֶּרֶךְ יְהוָה וּמְחִתָּה לְפֹעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃

verses.english: The righteous will never be shaken, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.
verses.hebrew: צַדִּיק לְעוֹלָם בַּל־יִמּוֹט וּרְשָׁעִים לֹא יִשְׁכְּנוּ־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: The mouth of the righteous bears wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
verses.hebrew: פִּי־צַדִּיק יָנוּב חָכְמָה וּלְשׁוֹן תַּהְפֻּכוֹת תִּכָּרֵת׃

verses.english: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked knows perversities.
verses.hebrew: שִׂפְתֵי צַדִּיק יֵדְעוּן רָצוֹן וּפִי רְשָׁעִים תַּהְפֻּכוֹת׃

verses.english: Deceitful scales are an abomination to YHWH, but a full stone-weight is His delight.
verses.hebrew: מֹאזְנֵי מִרְמָה תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה וְאֶבֶן שְׁלֵמָה רְצוֹנוֹ׃

verses.english: Pride comes, and disgrace comes, but wisdom is with the modest.
verses.hebrew: בָּא־זָדוֹן וַיָּבֹא קָלוֹן וְאֶת־צְנוּעִים חָכְמָה׃

verses.english: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the crookedness of the treacherous devastates them.
verses.hebrew: תֻּמַּת יְשָׁרִים תַּנְחֵם וְסֶלֶף בּוֹגְדִים ושדם [יְשָׁדֵּם׃]

verses.english: The righteousness of the blameless makes his way straight, but the wicked falls through his wickedness.
verses.hebrew: צִדְקַת תָּמִים תְּיַשֵּׁר דַּרְכּוֹ וּבְרִשְׁעָתוֹ יִפֹּל רָשָׁע׃

verses.english: The righteousness of the upright rescues them, but the treacherous are caught in their craving.
verses.hebrew: צִדְקַת יְשָׁרִים תַּצִּילֵם וּבְהַוַּת בֹּגְדִים יִלָּכֵדוּ׃

verses.english: When a wicked person dies, hope perishes, and the expectation of strong ones has perished.
verses.hebrew: בְּמוֹת אָדָם רָשָׁע תֹּאבַד תִּקְוָה וְתוֹחֶלֶת אוֹנִים אָבָדָה׃

verses.english: The righteous is delivered from distress, and the wicked comes into it in his place.
verses.hebrew: צַדִּיק מִצָּרָה נֶחֱלָץ וַיָּבֹא רָשָׁע תַּחְתָּיו׃

verses.english: With his mouth the godless person destroys his neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous are delivered.
verses.hebrew: בְּפֶה חָנֵף יַשְׁחִת רֵעֵהוּ וּבְדַעַת צַדִּיקִים יֵחָלֵצוּ׃

verses.english: When the righteous prosper, the town exults, and when the wicked perish, there is a ringing cry.
verses.hebrew: בְּטוּב צַדִּיקִים תַּעֲלֹץ קִרְיָה וּבַאֲבֹד רְשָׁעִים רִנָּה׃

verses.english: By the blessing of the upright a town is exalted, but by the mouth of the wicked it is torn down.
verses.hebrew: בְּבִרְכַּת יְשָׁרִים תָּרוּם קָרֶת וּבְפִי רְשָׁעִים תֵּהָרֵס׃

verses.english: One who despises his neighbor lacks heart, but a person of understanding keeps silent.
verses.hebrew: בָּז־לְרֵעֵהוּ חֲסַר־לֵב וְאִישׁ תְּבוּנוֹת יַחֲרִישׁ׃

verses.english: One who goes about as a talebearer reveals a secret, but one faithful in spirit conceals a matter.
verses.hebrew: הוֹלֵךְ רָכִיל מְגַלֶּה־סּוֹד וְנֶאֱמַן־רוּחַ מְכַסֶּה דָבָר׃

verses.english: Where there is no guidance, a people falls, but deliverance is in an abundance of counselors.
verses.hebrew: בְּאֵין תַּחְבֻּלוֹת יִפָּל־עָם וּתְשׁוּעָה בְּרֹב יוֹעֵץ׃

verses.english: One who guarantees a stranger will surely fare badly, but one who hates striking pledges is secure.
verses.hebrew: רַע־יֵרוֹעַ כִּי־עָרַב זָר וְשֹׂנֵא תֹקְעִים בּוֹטֵחַ׃

verses.english: A gracious woman holds fast to honor, and ruthless men hold fast to wealth.
verses.hebrew: אֵשֶׁת־חֵן תִּתְמֹךְ כָּבוֹד וְעָרִיצִים יִתְמְכוּ־עֹשֶׁר׃

verses.english: A man of steadfast kindness benefits his own life, but a cruel man troubles his own flesh.
verses.hebrew: גֹּמֵל נַפְשׁוֹ אִישׁ חָסֶד וְעֹכֵר שְׁאֵרוֹ אַכְזָרִי׃

verses.english: The wicked earns deceptive wages, but one who sows righteousness earns a true reward.
verses.hebrew: רָשָׁע עֹשֶׂה פְעֻלַּת־שָׁקֶר וְזֹרֵעַ צְדָקָה שֶׂכֶר אֱמֶת׃

verses.english: Thus righteousness is for life, but one who pursues evil pursues it to his death.
verses.hebrew: כֵּן־צְדָקָה לְחַיִּים וּמְרַדֵּף רָעָה לְמוֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: The crooked of heart are an abomination to YHWH, but those blameless in their way are His delight.
verses.hebrew: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה עִקְּשֵׁי־לֵב וּרְצוֹנוֹ תְּמִימֵי דָרֶךְ׃

verses.english: Hand to hand, the evil person will not go unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous escapes.
verses.hebrew: יָד לְיָד לֹא־יִנָּקֶה רָּע וְזֶרַע צַדִּיקִים נִמְלָט׃

verses.english: A gold ring in a pig's snout is a beautiful woman who turns away from discretion.
verses.hebrew: נֶזֶם זָהָב בְּאַף חֲזִיר אִשָּׁה יָפָה וְסָרַת טָעַם׃

verses.english: The desire of the righteous is only good; the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.hebrew: תַּאֲוַת צַדִּיקִים אַךְ־טוֹב תִּקְוַת רְשָׁעִים עֶבְרָה׃

verses.english: There is one who scatters and increases still more, and one who withholds beyond what is right, only to lack.
verses.hebrew: יֵשׁ מְפַזֵּר וְנוֹסָף עוֹד וְחוֹשֵׂךְ מִיֹּשֶׁר אַךְ־לְמַחְסוֹר׃

verses.english: A life that bestows blessing will be made full, and one who waters will himself also be watered.
verses.hebrew: נֶפֶשׁ־בְּרָכָה תְדֻשָּׁן וּמַרְוֶה גַּם־הוּא יוֹרֶא׃

verses.english: One who withholds grain—the people curse him, but blessing is on the head of one who sells it.
verses.hebrew: מֹנֵעַ בָּר יִקְּבֻהוּ לְאוֹם וּבְרָכָה לְרֹאשׁ מַשְׁבִּיר׃

verses.english: One who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but one who searches for evil—it will come upon him.
verses.hebrew: שֹׁחֵר טוֹב יְבַקֵּשׁ רָצוֹן וְדֹרֵשׁ רָעָה תְבוֹאֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: One who trusts in his wealth will fall, but the righteous will flourish like foliage.
verses.hebrew: בּוֹטֵחַ בְּעָשְׁרוֹ הוּא יִפֹּל וְכֶעָלֶה צַדִּיקִים יִפְרָחוּ׃

verses.english: One who troubles his household will inherit wind, and a fool will be servant to one wise of heart.
verses.hebrew: עוֹכֵר בֵּיתוֹ יִנְחַל־רוּחַ וְעֶבֶד אֱוִיל לַחֲכַם־לֵב׃

verses.english: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and one who takes lives is wise.
verses.hebrew: פְּרִי־צַדִּיק עֵץ חַיִּים וְלֹקֵחַ נְפָשׂוֹת חָכָם׃

verses.english: Look, the righteous is repaid on earth; how much more the wicked and the sinner!
verses.hebrew: הֵן צַדִּיק בָּאָרֶץ יְשֻׁלָּם אַף כִּי־רָשָׁע וְחוֹטֵא׃

verses.english: One who loves discipline loves knowledge, but one who hates reproof is brutish.
verses.hebrew: אֹהֵב מוּסָר אֹהֵב דָּעַת וְשֹׂנֵא תוֹכַחַת בָּעַר׃

verses.english: A good person obtains favor from YHWH, but He condemns a man of schemes.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב יָפִיק רָצוֹן מֵיְהוָה וְאִישׁ מְזִמּוֹת יַרְשִׁיעַ׃

verses.english: A person is not established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous will not be shaken.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יִכּוֹן אָדָם בְּרֶשַׁע וְשֹׁרֶשׁ צַדִּיקִים בַּל־יִמּוֹט׃

verses.english: A woman of strength is the crown of her husband, but one who brings shame is like rot in his bones.
verses.hebrew: אֵשֶׁת־חַיִל עֲטֶרֶת בַּעְלָהּ וּכְרָקָב בְּעַצְמוֹתָיו מְבִישָׁה׃

verses.english: The thoughts of the righteous are justice; the guidance of the wicked is deceit.
verses.hebrew: מַחְשְׁבוֹת צַדִּיקִים מִשְׁפָּט תַּחְבֻּלוֹת רְשָׁעִים מִרְמָה׃

verses.english: The words of the wicked lie in wait for blood, but the mouth of the upright rescues them.
verses.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי רְשָׁעִים אֱרָב־דָּם וּפִי יְשָׁרִים יַצִּילֵם׃

verses.english: Overthrow the wicked, and they are no more, but the house of the righteous will stand.
verses.hebrew: הָפוֹךְ רְשָׁעִים וְאֵינָם וּבֵית צַדִּיקִים יַעֲמֹד׃

verses.english: A man is praised according to his prudence, but one crooked of heart becomes despised.
verses.hebrew: לְפִי־שִׂכְלוֹ יְהֻלַּל־אִישׁ וְנַעֲוֵה־לֵב יִהְיֶה לָבוּז׃

verses.english: Better is one lightly esteemed who has a servant than one honoring himself but lacking bread.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב נִקְלֶה וְעֶבֶד לוֹ מִמְּתַכַּבֵּד וַחֲסַר־לָחֶם׃

verses.english: The righteous knows the life of his animal, but the mercies of the wicked are cruel.
verses.hebrew: יוֹדֵעַ צַדִּיק נֶפֶשׁ בְּהֶמְתּוֹ וְרַחֲמֵי רְשָׁעִים אַכְזָרִי׃

verses.english: One who works his ground will be satisfied with bread, but one who pursues empty things lacks heart.
verses.hebrew: עֹבֵד אַדְמָתוֹ יִשְׂבַּע־לָחֶם וּמְרַדֵּף רֵיקִים חֲסַר־לֵב׃

verses.english: The wicked covets the catch of evil people, but the root of the righteous yields.
verses.hebrew: חָמַד רָשָׁע מְצוֹד רָעִים וְשֹׁרֶשׁ צַדִּיקִים יִתֵּן׃

verses.english: In transgression of lips is an evil snare, but the righteous comes out of distress.
verses.hebrew: בְּפֶשַׁע שְׂפָתַיִם מוֹקֵשׁ רָע וַיֵּצֵא מִצָּרָה צַדִּיק׃

verses.hebrew: בְּפֶשַׁע שְׂפָתַיִם מוֹקֵשׁ רָע וַיֵּצֵא מִצָּרָה צַדִּיק׃

verses.english: From the fruit of a man's mouth he is satisfied with good, and the recompense of a person's hands returns to him.
verses.hebrew: מִפְּרִי פִי־אִישׁ יִשְׂבַּע־טוֹב וּגְמוּל יְדֵי־אָדָם ישוב [יָשִׁיב] לוֹ׃

verses.english: The way of a fool is upright in his own eyes, but one who listens to counsel is wise.
verses.hebrew: דֶּרֶךְ אֱוִיל יָשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו וְשֹׁמֵעַ לְעֵצָה חָכָם׃

verses.english: A fool—his vexation becomes known that same day, but a shrewd person conceals disgrace.
verses.hebrew: אֱוִיל בַּיּוֹם יִוָּדַע כַּעְסוֹ וְכֹסֶה קָלוֹן עָרוּם׃

verses.english: One who breathes faithfulness declares righteousness, but a false witness declares deceit.
verses.hebrew: יָפִיחַ אֱמוּנָה יַגִּיד צֶדֶק וְעֵד שְׁקָרִים מִרְמָה׃

verses.english: There is one who speaks rashly like sword-thrusts, but the tongue of the wise is healing.
verses.hebrew: יֵשׁ בּוֹטֶה כְּמַדְקְרוֹת חָרֶב וּלְשׁוֹן חֲכָמִים מַרְפֵּא׃

verses.english: A lip of truth is established forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.
verses.hebrew: שְׂפַת־אֱמֶת תִּכּוֹן לָעַד וְעַד־אַרְגִּיעָה לְשׁוֹן שָׁקֶר׃

verses.english: Deceit is in the heart of those who devise evil, but joy is for those who counsel peace.
verses.hebrew: מִרְמָה בְּלֶב־חֹרְשֵׁי רָע וּלְיֹעֲצֵי שָׁלוֹם שִׂמְחָה׃

verses.english: No trouble will befall the righteous, but the wicked are full of evil.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יְאֻנֶּה לַצַּדִּיק כָּל־אָוֶן וּרְשָׁעִים מָלְאוּ רָע׃

verses.english: Lying lips are an abomination to YHWH, but those who practice faithfulness are His delight.
verses.hebrew: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה שִׂפְתֵי־שָׁקֶר וְעֹשֵׂי אֱמוּנָה רְצוֹנוֹ׃

verses.english: A shrewd person conceals knowledge, but the heart of fools proclaims folly.
verses.hebrew: אָדָם עָרוּם כֹּסֶה דָּעַת וְלֵב כְּסִילִים יִקְרָא אִוֶּלֶת׃

verses.english: The hand of the diligent will rule, but slackness will become forced labor.
verses.hebrew: יַד־חָרוּצִים תִּמְשׁוֹל ורְמִיָּה תִּהְיֶה לָמַס׃

verses.english: Anxiety in a person's heart bows it down, but a good word makes it glad.
verses.hebrew: דְּאָגָה בְלֶב־אִישׁ יַשְׁחֶנָּה וְדָבָר טוֹב יְשַׂמְּחֶנָּה׃

verses.english: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbor, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.
verses.hebrew: יָתֵר מֵרֵעֵהוּ צַדִּיק וְדֶרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים תַּתְעֵם׃

verses.english: The slack person does not roast his game, but diligence is a person's precious wealth.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יַחֲרֹךְ רְמִיָּה צֵידוֹ וְהוֹן־אָדָם יָקָר חָרוּץ׃

verses.english: In the path of righteousness is life, and in the way of its track there is no death.
verses.hebrew: בְּאֹרַח־צְדָקָה חַיִּים וְדֶרֶךְ נְתִיבָה אַל־מָוֶת׃

verses.english: A wise son receives a father's discipline, but a scoffer does not listen to rebuke.
verses.hebrew: בֵּן חָכָם מוּסַר אָב וְלֵץ לֹא־שָׁמַע גְּעָרָה׃

verses.english: From the fruit of a man's mouth he eats good, but the appetite of the treacherous is for violence.
verses.hebrew: מִפְּרִי פִי־אִישׁ יֹאכַל טוֹב וְנֶפֶשׁ בֹּגְדִים חָמָס׃

verses.english: One who guards his mouth keeps his life; one who opens his lips wide—ruin is his.
verses.hebrew: נֹצֵר פִּיו שֹׁמֵר נַפְשׁוֹ פֹּשֵׂק שְׂפָתָיו מְחִתָּה־לוֹ׃

verses.english: The appetite of the lazy craves, and has nothing, but the appetite of the diligent will be made full.
verses.hebrew: מִתְאַוָּה וָאַיִן נַפְשׁוֹ עָצֵל וְנֶפֶשׁ חָרֻצִים תְּדֻשָּׁן׃

verses.english: The righteous hates a lying word, but the wicked brings a stench and disgrace.
verses.hebrew: דְּבַר־שֶׁקֶר יִשְׂנָא צַדִּיק וְרָשָׁע יַבְאִישׁ וְיַחְפִּיר׃

verses.english: Righteousness guards one blameless in the way, but wickedness overturns the sinful one.
verses.hebrew: צְדָקָה תִּצֹּר תָּם־דָּרֶךְ וְרִשְׁעָה תְּסַלֵּף חַטָּאת׃

verses.english: There is one who makes himself rich, yet has nothing, and one who makes himself poor, yet has great wealth.
verses.hebrew: יֵשׁ מִתְעַשֵּׁר וְאֵין כֹּל מִתְרוֹשֵׁשׁ וְהוֹן רָב׃

verses.english: A man's wealth is the ransom of his life, but the poor person hears no rebuke.
verses.hebrew: כֹּפֶר נֶפֶשׁ־אִישׁ עָשְׁרוֹ וְרָשׁ לֹא־שָׁמַע גְּעָרָה׃

verses.english: The light of the righteous rejoices, but the lamp of the wicked is extinguished.
verses.hebrew: אוֹר־צַדִּיקִים יִשְׂמָח וְנֵר רְשָׁעִים יִדְעָךְ׃

verses.english: Through pride comes nothing but strife, but wisdom is with those who take counsel.
verses.hebrew: רַק־בְּזָדוֹן יִתֵּן מַצָּה וְאֶת־נוֹעָצִים חָכְמָה׃

verses.english: Wealth from emptiness dwindles, but one who gathers by hand increases it.
verses.hebrew: הוֹן מֵהֶבֶל יִמְעָט וְקֹבֵץ עַל־יָד יַרְבֶּה׃

verses.english: Expectation drawn out makes the heart sick, but a desire that comes to pass is a tree of life.
verses.hebrew: תּוֹחֶלֶת מְמֻשָּׁכָה מַחֲלָה־לֵב וְעֵץ חַיִּים תַּאֲוָה בָאָה׃

verses.english: One who despises a word is bound by it, but one who fears a command will be repaid.
verses.hebrew: בָּז לְדָבָר יֵחָבֶל לוֹ וִירֵא מִצְוָה הוּא יְשֻׁלָּם׃
