verses.hebrew: בָּז לְדָבָר יֵחָבֶל לוֹ וִירֵא מִצְוָה הוּא יְשֻׁלָּם׃

verses.english: The instruction of the wise is a fountain of life, for turning aside from the snares of death.
verses.hebrew: תּוֹרַת חָכָם מְקוֹר חַיִּים לָסוּר מִמֹּקְשֵׁי מָוֶת׃

verses.english: Good prudence gives favor, but the way of the treacherous is hard.
verses.hebrew: שֵׂכֶל־טוֹב יִתֶּן־חֵן וְדֶרֶךְ בֹּגְדִים אֵיתָן׃

verses.english: Every shrewd person acts with knowledge, but a fool spreads out folly.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־עָרוּם יַעֲשֶׂה בְדָעַת וּכְסִיל יִפְרֹשׂ אִוֶּלֶת׃

verses.english: A wicked messenger falls into evil, but a faithful envoy is healing.
verses.hebrew: מַלְאָךְ רָשָׁע יִפֹּל בְּרָע וְצִיר אֱמוּנִים מַרְפֵּא׃

verses.english: Poverty and disgrace belong to one who lets discipline go, but one who keeps reproof will be honored.
verses.hebrew: רֵישׁ וְקָלוֹן פּוֹרֵעַ מוּסָר וְשׁוֹמֵר תּוֹכַחַת יְכֻבָּד׃

verses.english: A desire fulfilled is sweet to the life, but turning from evil is an abomination to fools.
verses.hebrew: תַּאֲוָה נִהְיָה תֶּעֱרַב לְנָפֶשׁ וְתוֹעֲבַת כְּסִילִים סוּר מֵרָע׃

verses.english: Walk with the wise and become wise, but one who companions with fools will fare badly.
verses.hebrew: הלוך [הוֹלֵךְ] אֶת־חֲכָמִים וחכם [יֶחְכָּם] וְרֹעֶה כְסִילִים יֵרוֹעַ׃

verses.english: Evil pursues sinners, but good repays the righteous.
verses.hebrew: חַטָּאִים תְּרַדֵּף רָעָה וְאֶת־צַדִּיקִים יְשַׁלֶּם־טוֹב׃

verses.english: A good person leaves an inheritance to children's children, but a sinner's wealth is stored for the righteous.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב יַנְחִיל בְּנֵי־בָנִים וְצָפוּן לַצַּדִּיק חֵיל חוֹטֵא׃

verses.english: The newly worked ground of the poor has abundant food, but there is what is swept away through lack of justice.
verses.hebrew: רָב־אֹכֶל נִיר רָאשִׁים וְיֵשׁ נִסְפֶּה בְּלֹא מִשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: One who withholds his rod hates his son, but one who loves him diligently seeks discipline for him.
verses.hebrew: חוֹשֵׂךְ שִׁבְטוֹ שׂוֹנֵא בְנוֹ וְאֹהֲבוֹ שִׁחֲרוֹ מוּסָר׃

verses.english: The righteous eats to satisfy his appetite, but the belly of the wicked lacks.
verses.hebrew: צַדִּיק אֹכֵל לְשֹׂבַע נַפְשׁוֹ וּבֶטֶן רְשָׁעִים תֶּחְסָר׃

verses.english: The wisest of women builds her house, but Folly tears it down with her hands.
verses.hebrew: חַכְמוֹת נָשִׁים בָּנְתָה בֵיתָהּ וְאִוֶּלֶת בְּיָדֶיהָ תֶהֶרְסֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: One who walks in his uprightness fears YHWH, but one crooked in his ways despises Him.
verses.hebrew: הוֹלֵךְ בְּיָשְׁרוֹ יְרֵא יְהוָה וּנְלוֹז דְּרָכָיו בּוֹזֵהוּ׃

verses.english: In the mouth of a fool is a rod of pride, but the lips of the wise guard them.
verses.hebrew: בְּפִי־אֱוִיל חֹטֶר גַּאֲוָה וְשִׂפְתֵי חֲכָמִים תִּשְׁמוּרֵם׃

verses.english: Where there are no cattle, the manger is clean, but abundant produce comes through an ox's strength.
verses.hebrew: בְּאֵין אֲלָפִים אֵבוּס בָּר וְרָב־תְּבוּאוֹת בְּכֹחַ שׁוֹר׃

verses.english: A faithful witness does not lie, but a false witness breathes lies.
verses.hebrew: עֵד אֱמוּנִים לֹא יְכַזֵּב וְיָפִיחַ כְּזָבִים עֵד שָׁקֶר׃

verses.english: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and there is none, but knowledge is easy for one who understands.
verses.hebrew: בִּקֶּשׁ־לֵץ חָכְמָה וָאָיִן וְדַעַת לְנָבוֹן נָקָל׃

verses.english: Go away from the presence of a foolish man, for you will not know lips of knowledge there.
verses.hebrew: לֵךְ מִנֶּגֶד לְאִישׁ כְּסִיל וּבַל־יָדַעְתָּ שִׂפְתֵי־דָעַת׃

verses.english: The wisdom of the shrewd is to understand his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
verses.hebrew: חָכְמַת עָרוּם הָבִין דַּרְכּוֹ וְאִוֶּלֶת כְּסִילִים מִרְמָה׃

verses.english: Guilt mocks fools, but favor is among the upright.
verses.hebrew: אֱוִלִים יָלִיץ אָשָׁם וּבֵין יְשָׁרִים רָצוֹן׃

verses.english: The heart knows the bitterness of its own life, and a stranger does not share in its joy.
verses.hebrew: לֵב יוֹדֵעַ מָרַּת נַפְשׁוֹ וּבְשִׂמְחָתוֹ לֹא־יִתְעָרַב זָר׃

verses.english: The house of the wicked will be destroyed, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
verses.hebrew: בֵּית רְשָׁעִים יִשָּׁמֵד וְאֹהֶל יְשָׁרִים יַפְרִיחַ׃

verses.english: There is a way that is upright before a man, but its end is ways of death.
verses.hebrew: יֵשׁ דֶּרֶךְ יָשָׁר לִפְנֵי־אִישׁ וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ דַּרְכֵי־מָוֶת׃

verses.english: Even in laughter the heart may ache, and the end of joy is grief.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־בִּשְׂחוֹק יִכְאַב־לֵב וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ שִׂמְחָה תוּגָה׃

verses.english: One turned back in heart is filled from his own ways, and a good man from what is his.
verses.hebrew: מִדְּרָכָיו יִשְׂבַּע סוּג לֵב וּמֵעָלָיו אִישׁ טוֹב׃

verses.english: The simple person believes every word, but the shrewd gives thought to his step.
verses.hebrew: פֶּתִי יַאֲמִין לְכָל־דָּבָר וְעָרוּם יָבִין לַאֲשֻׁרוֹ׃

verses.english: The wise fears and turns from evil, but the fool grows heated and is confident.
verses.hebrew: חָכָם יָרֵא וְסָר מֵרָע וּכְסִיל מִתְעַבֵּר וּבוֹטֵחַ׃

verses.english: One short of temper acts foolishly, and a man of schemes is hated.
verses.hebrew: קְצַר־אַפַּיִם יַעֲשֶׂה אִוֶּלֶת וְאִישׁ מְזִמּוֹת יִשָּׂנֵא׃

verses.english: The simple inherit folly, but the shrewd crown themselves with knowledge.
verses.hebrew: נָחֲלוּ פְתָאיִם אִוֶּלֶת וַעֲרוּמִים יַכְתִּרוּ דָעַת׃

verses.english: Evil people bow before good people, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.hebrew: שַׁחוּ רָעִים לִפְנֵי טוֹבִים וּרְשָׁעִים עַל־שַׁעֲרֵי צַדִּיק׃

verses.english: The poor person is hated even by his neighbor, but those who love the rich are many.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־לְרֵעֵהוּ יִשָּׂנֵא רָשׁ וְאֹהֲבֵי עָשִׁיר רַבִּים׃

verses.english: One who despises his neighbor sins, but happy is one who shows favor to the afflicted.
verses.hebrew: בָּז־לְרֵעֵהוּ חוֹטֵא וּמְחוֹנֵן עניים [עֲנָוִים] אַשְׁרָיו׃

verses.english: Do not those who devise evil wander astray? But steadfast kindness and faithfulness are for those who devise good.
verses.hebrew: הֲ‍לוֹא־יִתְעוּ חֹרְשֵׁי רָע וְחֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת חֹרְשֵׁי טוֹב׃

verses.english: In all toil there is profit, but talk of the lips leads only to lack.
verses.hebrew: בְּכָל־עֶצֶב יִהְיֶה מוֹתָר וּדְבַר־שְׂפָתַיִם אַךְ־לְמַחְסוֹר׃

verses.english: The crown of the wise is their wealth; the folly of fools is folly.
verses.hebrew: עֲטֶרֶת חֲכָמִים עָשְׁרָם אִוֶּלֶת כְּסִילִים אִוֶּלֶת׃

verses.english: A truthful witness rescues lives, but one who breathes lies is deceit.
verses.hebrew: מַצִּיל נְפָשׁוֹת עֵד אֱמֶת וְיָפִחַ כְּזָבִים מִרְמָה׃

verses.english: In the fear of YHWH is strong confidence, and for his children there will be refuge.
verses.hebrew: בְּיִרְאַת יְהוָה מִבְטַח־עֹז וּלְבָנָיו יִהְיֶה מַחְסֶה׃

verses.english: The fear of YHWH is a fountain of life, for turning aside from the snares of death.
verses.hebrew: יִרְאַת יְהוָה מְקוֹר חַיִּים לָסוּר מִמֹּקְשֵׁי מָוֶת׃

verses.english: In a multitude of people is a king's splendor, but in the absence of a populace is a ruler's ruin.
verses.hebrew: בְּרָב־עָם הַדְרַת־מֶלֶךְ וּבְאֶפֶס לְאֹם מְחִתַּת רָזוֹן׃

verses.english: One slow to anger has great understanding, but one short of spirit raises up folly.
verses.hebrew: אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם רַב־תְּבוּנָה וּקְצַר־רוּחַ מֵרִים אִוֶּלֶת׃

verses.english: A healing heart is life for the flesh, but jealousy is rot in the bones.
verses.hebrew: חַיֵּי בְשָׂרִים לֵב מַרְפֵּא וּרְקַב עֲצָמוֹת קִנְאָה׃

verses.english: One who oppresses the poor insults his Maker, but one who shows favor to the needy honors Him.
verses.hebrew: עֹשֵׁק־דָּל חֵרֵף עֹשֵׂהוּ וּמְכַבְּדוֹ חֹנֵן אֶבְיוֹן׃

verses.english: The wicked is thrust down through his evil, but the righteous takes refuge in his death.
verses.hebrew: בְּרָעָתוֹ יִדָּחֶה רָשָׁע וְחֹסֶה בְמוֹתוֹ צַדִּיק׃

verses.english: Wisdom rests in an understanding heart, and in the midst of fools it is made known.
verses.hebrew: בְּלֵב נָבוֹן תָּנוּחַ חָכְמָה וּבְקֶרֶב כְּסִילִים תִּוָּדֵעַ׃

verses.english: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to peoples.
verses.hebrew: צְדָקָה תְרוֹמֵם־גּוֹי וְחֶסֶד לְאֻמִּים חַטָּאת׃

verses.english: A king's favor is for a prudent servant, but his wrath falls on one who brings shame.
verses.hebrew: רְצוֹן־מֶלֶךְ לְעֶבֶד מַשְׂכִּיל וְעֶבְרָתוֹ תִּהְיֶה מֵבִישׁ׃

verses.english: A gentle answer turns back wrath, but a painful word raises anger.
verses.hebrew: מַעֲנֶה־רַּךְ יָשִׁיב חֵמָה וּדְבַר־עֶצֶב יַעֲלֶה־אָף׃

verses.english: The tongue of the wise makes knowledge good, but the mouth of fools pours out folly.
verses.hebrew: לְשׁוֹן חֲכָמִים תֵּיטִיב דָּעַת וּפִי כְסִילִים יַבִּיעַ אִוֶּלֶת׃

verses.english: The eyes of YHWH are in every place, watching evil people and good people.
verses.hebrew: בְּכָל־מָקוֹם עֵינֵי יְהוָה צֹפוֹת רָעִים וטוֹבִים׃

verses.english: A healing tongue is a tree of life, but crookedness in it is a breaking of spirit.
verses.hebrew: מַרְפֵּא לָשׁוֹן עֵץ חַיִּים וְסֶלֶף בָּהּ שֶׁבֶר בְּרוּחַ׃

verses.english: A fool despises his father's discipline, but one who keeps reproof becomes shrewd.
verses.hebrew: אֱוִיל יִנְאַץ מוּסַר אָבִיו וְשֹׁמֵר תּוֹכַחַת יַעְרִם׃

verses.english: In the house of the righteous is great wealth, but in the yield of the wicked is trouble.
verses.hebrew: בֵּית צַדִּיק חֹסֶן רָב וּבִתְבוּאַת רָשָׁע נֶעְכָּרֶת׃

verses.english: The lips of the wise scatter knowledge, but the heart of fools does not do so.
verses.hebrew: שִׂפְתֵי חֲכָמִים יְזָרוּ דָעַת וְלֵב כְּסִילִים לֹא־כֵן׃

verses.english: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to YHWH, but the prayer of the upright is His delight.
verses.hebrew: זֶבַח רְשָׁעִים תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה וּתְפִלַּת יְשָׁרִים רְצוֹנוֹ׃

verses.english: The way of the wicked is an abomination to YHWH, but He loves one who pursues righteousness.
verses.hebrew: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה דֶּרֶךְ רָשָׁע וּמְרַדֵּף צְדָקָה יֶאֱהָב׃

verses.english: Harsh discipline is for one who abandons the path; one who hates reproof will die.
verses.hebrew: מוּסָר רָע לְעֹזֵב אֹרַח שׂוֹנֵא תוֹכַחַת יָמוּת׃

verses.english: Sheol and Abaddon are before YHWH; how much more the hearts of the children of humankind!
verses.hebrew: שְׁאוֹל וַאֲבַדּוֹן נֶגֶד יְהוָה אַף כִּי־לִבּוֹת בְּנֵי־אָדָם׃

verses.english: A scoffer does not love one who reproves him; he will not go to the wise.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יֶאֱהַב־לֵץ הוֹכֵחַ לוֹ אֶל־חֲכָמִים לֹא יֵלֵךְ׃

verses.english: A joyful heart makes a face good, but through sorrow of heart the spirit is stricken.
verses.hebrew: לֵב שָׂמֵחַ יֵיטִב פָּנִים וּבְעַצְּבַת־לֵב רוּחַ נְכֵאָה׃

verses.english: An understanding heart seeks knowledge, but the mouth of fools feeds on folly.
verses.hebrew: לֵב נָבוֹן יְבַקֶּשׁ־דָּעַת ופני [וּפִי] כְסִילִים יִרְעֶה אִוֶּלֶת׃

verses.english: All the days of the afflicted are bad, but one good of heart has a continual feast.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־יְמֵי עָנִי רָעִים וְטוֹב־לֵב מִשְׁתֶּה תָמִיד׃

verses.english: Better a little with the fear of YHWH than a great storehouse with turmoil in it.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב־מְעַט בְּיִרְאַת יְהוָה מֵאוֹצָר רָב וּמְהוּמָה בוֹ׃

verses.english: Better a meal of vegetables with love there than a stall-fed ox with hatred in it.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב אֲרֻחַת יָרָק וְאַהֲבָה־שָׁם מִשּׁוֹר אָבוּס וְשִׂנְאָה־בוֹ׃

verses.english: A wrathful man stirs up dispute, but one slow to anger quiets strife.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ חֵמָה יְגָרֶה מָדוֹן וְאֶרֶך אַפַּיִם יַשְׁקִיט רִיב׃

verses.english: H — [No corresponding text in the displayed Hebrew main text.]
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ חֵמָה יְגָרֶה מָדוֹן וְאֶרֶך אַפַּיִם יַשְׁקִיט רִיב׃

verses.english: The way of the lazy is like a hedge of thorns, but the path of the upright is a raised road.
verses.hebrew: דֶּרֶךְ עָצֵל כִּמְשֻׂכַת חָדֶק וְאֹרַח יְשָׁרִים סְלֻלָה׃

verses.english: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish person despises his mother.
verses.hebrew: בֵּן חָכָם יְשַׂמַּח־אָב וּכְסִיל אָדָם בּוֹזֶה אִמּוֹ׃

verses.english: Folly is joy to one lacking heart, but a person of understanding makes his walking straight.
verses.hebrew: אִוֶּלֶת שִׂמְחָה לַחֲסַר־לֵב וְאִישׁ תְּבוּנָה יְיַשֶׁר־לָכֶת׃

verses.english: Plans are frustrated where there is no consultation, but with many counselors they stand.
verses.hebrew: הָפֵר מַחֲשָׁבוֹת בְּאֵין סוֹד וּבְרֹב יוֹעֲצִים תָּקוּם׃

verses.english: A man has joy in the answer of his mouth, and a word in its time—how good!
verses.hebrew: שִׂמְחָה לָאִישׁ בְּמַעֲנֵה־פִיו וְדָבָר בְּעִתּוֹ מַה־טּוֹב׃

verses.english: The path of life is upward for the prudent, so that he turns from Sheol below.
verses.hebrew: אֹרַח חַיִּים לְמַעְלָה לְמַשְׂכִּיל לְמַעַן סוּר מִשְּׁאוֹל מָטָּה׃

verses.english: YHWH tears away the house of the proud, but He establishes the widow's boundary.
verses.hebrew: בֵּית גֵּאִים יִסַּח יְהוָה וְיַצֵּב גְּבוּל אַלְמָנָה׃

verses.english: Evil thoughts are an abomination to YHWH, but pleasant sayings are pure.
verses.hebrew: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה מַחְשְׁבוֹת רָע וּטְהֹרִים אִמְרֵי־נֹעַם׃

verses.english: One who gains unjust gain troubles his household, but one who hates gifts will live.
verses.hebrew: עֹכֵר בֵּיתוֹ בּוֹצֵעַ בָּצַע וְשׂוֹנֵא מַתָּנֹת יִחְיֶה׃

verses.english: By steadfast kindness and faithfulness iniquity is atoned for, and by the fear of YHWH one turns from evil.
verses.hebrew: עֹכֵר בֵּיתוֹ בּוֹצֵעַ בָּצַע וְשׂוֹנֵא מַתָּנֹת יִחְיֶה׃

verses.english: The heart of the righteous meditates how to answer, but the mouth of the wicked pours out evils.
verses.hebrew: לֵב צַדִּיק יֶהְגֶּה לַעֲנוֹת וּפִי רְשָׁעִים יַבִּיעַ רָעוֹת׃

verses.english: When YHWH delights in a man's ways, He makes even his enemies be at peace with him.
verses.hebrew: לֵב צַדִּיק יֶהְגֶּה לַעֲנוֹת וּפִי רְשָׁעִים יַבִּיעַ רָעוֹת׃

verses.english: YHWH is far from the wicked, but He hears the prayer of the righteous.
verses.hebrew: רָחוֹק יְהוָה מֵרְשָׁעִים וּתְפִלַּת צַדִּיקִים יִשְׁמָע׃

verses.english: Better a little with righteousness than abundant produce without justice.
verses.hebrew: רָחוֹק יְהוָה מֵרְשָׁעִים וּתְפִלַּת צַדִּיקִים יִשְׁמָע׃

verses.english: A person's heart plans his way, but YHWH establishes his step.
verses.hebrew: רָחוֹק יְהוָה מֵרְשָׁעִים וּתְפִלַּת צַדִּיקִים יִשְׁמָע׃

verses.english: The light of the eyes gladdens the heart; a good report makes the bones full.
verses.hebrew: מְאוֹר־עֵינַיִם יְשַׂמַּח־לֵב שְׁמוּעָה טוֹבָה תְּדַשֶּׁן־עָצֶם׃

verses.english: One who lets discipline go rejects his own life, but one who listens to reproof acquires heart.
verses.hebrew: אֹזֶן שֹׁמַעַת תּוֹכַחַת חַיִּים בְּקֶרֶב חֲכָמִים תָּלִין׃

verses.english: The fear of YHWH is the discipline of wisdom, and before honor comes humility.
verses.hebrew: יִרְאַת יְהוָה מוּסַר חָכְמָה וְלִפְנֵי כָבוֹד עֲנָוָה׃

verses.english: All a man's ways are pure in his own eyes, but YHWH weighs spirits.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־דַּרְכֵי־אִישׁ זַךְ בְּעֵינָיו וְתֹכֵן רוּחוֹת יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Everyone high of heart is an abomination to YHWH; hand to hand, he will not go unpunished.
verses.hebrew: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה כָּל־גְּבַהּ־לֵב יָד לְיָד לֹא יִנָּקֶה׃

verses.english: H — [No corresponding text in the displayed Hebrew chapter.]
verses.hebrew: בִּרְצוֹת יְהוָה דַּרְכֵי־אִישׁ גַּם־אוֹיְבָיו יַשְׁלִם אִתּוֹ׃

verses.english: H — [No corresponding text in the displayed Hebrew chapter.]
verses.hebrew: טוֹב־מְעַט בִּצְדָקָה מֵרֹב תְּבוּאוֹת בְּלֹא מִשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: YHWH has made everything for its purpose, even the wicked for an evil day.
verses.hebrew: כֹּל פָּעַל יְהוָה לַמַּעֲנֵהוּ וְגַם־רָשָׁע לְיוֹם רָעָה׃

verses.english: An oracle is on a king's lips; his mouth must not act faithlessly in judgment.
verses.hebrew: קֶסֶם עַל־שִׂפְתֵי־מֶלֶךְ בְּמִשְׁפָּט לֹא יִמְעַל־פִּיו׃

verses.english: A balance and scales of justice belong to YHWH; all the stone-weights in the bag are His work.
verses.hebrew: פֶּלֶס וּמֹאזְנֵי מִשְׁפָּט לַיהוָה מַעֲשֵׂהוּ כָּל־אַבְנֵי־כִיס׃

verses.english: Doing wickedness is an abomination to kings, for a throne is established by righteousness.
verses.hebrew: תּוֹעֲבַת מְלָכִים עֲשׂוֹת רֶשַׁע כִּי בִצְדָקָה יִכּוֹן כִּסֵּא׃

verses.english: Righteous lips are the delight of kings, and a king loves one who speaks upright things.
verses.hebrew: רְצוֹן מְלָכִים שִׂפְתֵי־צֶדֶק וְדֹבֵר יְשָׁרִים יֶאֱהָב׃

verses.english: A king's wrath is messengers of death, but a wise man appeases it.
verses.hebrew: חֲמַת־מֶלֶךְ מַלְאֲכֵי־מָוֶת וְאִישׁ חָכָם יְכַפְּרֶנָּה׃

verses.english: In the light of a king's face is life, and his favor is like a cloud of late rain.
verses.hebrew: בְּאוֹר־פְּנֵי־מֶלֶךְ חַיִּים וּרְצוֹנוֹ כְּעָב מַלְקוֹשׁ׃

verses.english: How much better to acquire wisdom than gold, and to acquire understanding is preferable to silver!
verses.hebrew: קְנֹה־חָכְמָה מַה־טּוֹב מֵחָרוּץ וּקְנוֹת בִּינָה נִבְחָר מִכָּסֶף׃

verses.english: The raised road of the upright is turning from evil; one who guards his way keeps his life.
verses.hebrew: מְסִלַּת יְשָׁרִים סוּר מֵרָע שֹׁמֵר נַפְשׁוֹ נֹצֵר דַּרְכּוֹ׃

verses.english: Pride comes before breaking, and height of spirit before stumbling.
verses.hebrew: לִפְנֵי־שֶׁבֶר גָּאוֹן וְלִפְנֵי כִשָּׁלוֹן גֹּבַהּ רוּחַ׃

verses.english: Better to be lowly in spirit with the afflicted than to divide spoil with the proud.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב שְׁפַל־רוּחַ אֶת־עניים [עֲנָוִים] מֵחַלֵּק שָׁלָל אֶת־גֵּאִים׃

verses.english: One who gives prudent attention to a matter finds good, and happy is one who trusts in YHWH.
verses.hebrew: מַשְׂכִּיל עַל־דָּבָר יִמְצָא־טוֹב וּבוֹטֵחַ בַּיהוָה אַשְׁרָיו׃

verses.english: One wise of heart is called understanding, and sweetness of lips increases learning.
verses.hebrew: לַחֲכַם־לֵב יִקָּרֵא נָבוֹן וּמֶתֶק שְׂפָתַיִם יֹסִיף לֶקַח׃

verses.english: Prudence is a fountain of life to its possessor, but the discipline of fools is folly.
verses.hebrew: מְקוֹר חַיִּים שֵׂכֶל בְּעָלָיו וּמוּסַר אֱוִלִים אִוֶּלֶת׃

verses.english: A wise heart gives prudence to its mouth, and adds learning to its lips.
verses.hebrew: לֵב חָכָם יַשְׂכִּיל פִּיהוּ וְעַל־שְׂפָתָיו יֹסִיף לֶקַח׃

verses.english: Pleasant sayings are a honeycomb, sweet to the life and healing to the bones.
verses.hebrew: צוּף־דְּבַשׁ אִמְרֵי־נֹעַם מָתוֹק לַנֶּפֶשׁ וּמַרְפֵּא לָעָצֶם׃

verses.english: There is a way upright before a man, but its end is ways of death.
verses.hebrew: יֵשׁ דֶּרֶךְ יָשָׁר לִפְנֵי־אִישׁ וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ דַּרְכֵי־מָוֶת׃

verses.english: The appetite of a worker works for him, for his mouth presses him on.
verses.hebrew: נֶפֶשׁ עָמֵל עָמְלָה לּוֹ כִּי־אָכַף עָלָיו פִּיהוּ׃

verses.english: A worthless man digs up evil, and on his lips is something like scorching fire.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ בְּלִיַּעַל כֹּרֶה רָעָה וְעַל־שפתיו [שְׂפָתוֹ] כְּאֵשׁ צָרָבֶת׃

verses.english: A perverse man sends out dispute, and a whisperer separates a close companion.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ תַּהְפֻּכוֹת יְשַׁלַּח מָדוֹן וְנִרְגָּן מַפְרִיד אַלּוּף׃

verses.english: A violent man entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ חָמָס יְפַתֶּה רֵעֵהוּ וְהוֹלִיכוֹ בְּדֶרֶךְ לֹא־טוֹב׃

verses.english: One who shuts his eyes devises perversities; one who pinches his lips has completed evil.
verses.hebrew: עֹצֶה עֵינָיו לַחְשֹׁב תַּהְפֻּכוֹת קֹרֵץ שְׂפָתָיו כִּלָּה רָעָה׃

verses.english: Gray hair is a crown of splendor; it is found in the way of righteousness.
verses.hebrew: עֲטֶרֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת שֵׂיבָה בְּדֶרֶךְ צְדָקָה תִּמָּצֵא׃

verses.english: Better one slow to anger than a mighty warrior, and one who rules his spirit than one who captures a city.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם מִגִּבּוֹר וּמֹשֵׁל בְּרוּחוֹ מִלֹּכֵד עִיר׃

verses.english: The lot is cast into the lap, but every decision of it is from YHWH.
verses.hebrew: בַּחֵיק יוּטַל אֶת־הַגּוֹרָל וּמֵיְהוָה כָּל־מִשְׁפָּטוֹ׃

verses.english: Better a dry morsel with quiet in it than a house full of sacrifices with strife.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב פַּת חֲרֵבָה וְשַׁלְוָה־בָהּ מִבַּיִת מָלֵא זִבְחֵי־רִיב׃

verses.english: A prudent servant rules over a son who brings shame, and shares an inheritance among brothers.
verses.hebrew: עֶבֶד־מַשְׂכִּיל יִמְשֹׁל בְּבֵן מֵבִישׁ וּבְתוֹךְ אַחִים יַחֲלֹק נַחֲלָה׃

verses.english: A crucible is for silver and a furnace for gold, but YHWH tests hearts.
verses.hebrew: מַצְרֵף לַכֶּסֶף וְכוּר לַזָּהָב וּבֹחֵן לִבּוֹת יְהוָה׃

verses.english: An evildoer listens to a lip of wrongdoing; a liar gives ear to a destructive tongue.
verses.hebrew: מֵרַע מַקְשִׁיב עַל־שְׂפַת־אָוֶן שֶׁקֶר מֵזִין עַל־לְשׁוֹן הַוֺּת׃

verses.english: One who mocks the poor insults his Maker; one who rejoices at calamity will not go unpunished.
verses.hebrew: לֹעֵג לָרָשׁ חֵרֵף עֹשֵׂהוּ שָׂמֵחַ לְאֵיד לֹא יִנָּקֶה׃

verses.english: The crown of elders is children's children, and the splendor of children is their fathers.
verses.hebrew: עֲטֶרֶת זְקֵנִים בְּנֵי בָנִים וְתִפְאֶרֶת בָּנִים אֲבוֹתָם׃

verses.english: Excellent speech does not suit a fool, still less a lying lip a noble person.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־נָאוָה לְנָבָל שְׂפַת־יֶתֶר אַף כִּי־לְנָדִיב שְׂפַת־שָׁקֶר׃

verses.english: A bribe is a stone of favor in the eyes of its possessor; wherever it turns, it prospers.
verses.hebrew: אֶבֶן־חֵן הַשֹּׁחַד בְּעֵינֵי בְעָלָיו אֶל־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר יִפְנֶה יַשְׂכִּיל׃

verses.english: One who covers a transgression seeks love, but one who repeats a matter separates a close companion.
verses.hebrew: מְכַסֶּה־פֶּשַׁע מְבַקֵּשׁ אַהֲבָה וְשֹׁנֶה בְדָבָר מַפְרִיד אַלּוּף׃

verses.english: A rebuke goes deeper into one who understands than striking a fool a hundred times.
verses.hebrew: תֵּחַת גְּעָרָה בְמֵבִין מֵהַכּוֹת כְּסִיל מֵאָה׃

verses.english: An evil person seeks only rebellion, and a cruel messenger will be sent against him.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ־מְרִי יְבַקֶּשׁ־רָע וּמַלְאָךְ אַכְזָרִי יְשֻׁלַּח־בּוֹ׃

verses.english: Let a bereaved bear meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.hebrew: פָּגוֹשׁ דֹּב שַׁכּוּל בְּאִישׁ וְאַל־כְּסִיל בְּאִוַּלְתּוֹ׃

verses.english: One who returns evil in place of good— evil will not depart from his house.
verses.hebrew: מֵשִׁיב רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה לֹא־תמיש [תָמוּשׁ] רָעָה מִבֵּיתוֹ׃

verses.english: The beginning of dispute is letting water loose; so abandon strife before it breaks out.
verses.hebrew: פּוֹטֵר מַיִם רֵאשִׁית מָדוֹן וְלִפְנֵי הִתְגַּלַּע הָרִיב נְטוֹשׁ׃

verses.english: One who declares the wicked righteous and one who declares the righteous wicked— both of them are an abomination to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: מַצְדִּיק רָשָׁע וּמַרְשִׁיעַ צַדִּיק תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה גַּם־שְׁנֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Why is there a price in the hand of a fool to acquire wisdom, when there is no heart?
verses.hebrew: לָמָּה־זֶּה מְחִיר בְּיַד־כְּסִיל לִקְנוֹת חָכְמָה וְלֶב־אָיִן׃

verses.hebrew: לָמָּה־זֶּה מְחִיר בְּיַד־כְּסִיל לִקְנוֹת חָכְמָה וְלֶב־אָיִן׃

verses.english: At every time a friend loves, and a brother is born for distress.
verses.hebrew: בְּכָל־עֵת אֹהֵב הָרֵעַ וְאָח לְצָרָה יִוָּלֵד׃

verses.english: A person lacking heart strikes a palm, guaranteeing a pledge before his neighbor.
verses.hebrew: אָדָם חֲסַר־לֵב תּוֹקֵעַ כָּף עֹרֵב עֲרֻבָּה לִפְנֵי רֵעֵהוּ׃

verses.english: One who loves strife loves transgression; one who makes his doorway high seeks breaking.
verses.hebrew: אֹהֵב פֶּשַׁע אֹהֵב מַצָּה מַגְבִּיהַּ פִּתְחוֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־שָׁבֶר׃

verses.english: One crooked of heart will find no good, and one who twists his tongue falls into evil.
verses.hebrew: עִקֶּשׁ־לֵב לֹא יִמְצָא־טוֹב וְנֶהְפָּךְ בִּלְשׁוֹנוֹ יִפּוֹל בְּרָעָה׃

verses.english: One who fathers a fool has grief, and the father of a senseless person does not rejoice.
verses.hebrew: יֹלֵד כְּסִיל לְתוּגָה לוֹ וְלֹא־יִשְׂמַח אֲבִי נָבָל׃

verses.english: A joyful heart makes healing good, but a stricken spirit dries the bones.
verses.hebrew: לֵב שָׂמֵחַ יֵיטִב גֵּהָה וְרוּחַ נְכֵאָה תְּיַבֶּשׁ־גָּרֶם׃

verses.english: The wicked takes a bribe from the fold of a garment, to bend the paths of justice.
verses.hebrew: שֹׁחַד מֵחֵיק רָשָׁע יִקָּח לְהַטּוֹת אָרְחוֹת מִשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: Wisdom is before the face of one who understands, but the eyes of a fool are at the end of the earth.
verses.hebrew: אֶת־פְּנֵי מֵבִין חָכְמָה וְעֵינֵי כְסִיל בִּקְצֵה־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: A foolish son is vexation to his father, and bitterness to the one who bore him.
verses.hebrew: כַּעַס לְאָבִיו בֵּן כְּסִיל וּמֶמֶר לְיוֹלַדְתּוֹ׃

verses.english: To fine the righteous is surely not good, nor to strike nobles for uprightness.
verses.hebrew: גַּם עֲנוֹשׁ לַצַּדִּיק לֹא־טוֹב לְהַכּוֹת נְדִיבִים עַל־יֹשֶׁר׃

verses.english: One who restrains his sayings knows knowledge, and a person of understanding is cool of spirit.
verses.hebrew: חוֹשֵׂךְ אֲמָרָיו יוֹדֵעַ דָּעַת וקר־[יְקַר־] רוּחַ אִישׁ תְּבוּנָה׃

verses.english: Even a fool who keeps silent is counted wise; one who shuts his lips is counted understanding.
verses.hebrew: גַּם אֱוִיל מַחֲרִישׁ חָכָם יֵחָשֵׁב אֹטֵם שְׂפָתָיו נָבוֹן׃

verses.english: One who separates himself seeks his own desire; he breaks out against all sound resourcefulness.
verses.hebrew: לְתַאֲוָה יְבַקֵּשׁ נִפְרָד בְּכָל־תּוּשִׁיָּה יִתְגַּלָּע׃

verses.english: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in uncovering his own heart.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יַחְפֹּץ כְּסִיל בִּתְבוּנָה כִּי אִם־בְּהִתְגַּלּוֹת לִבּוֹ׃

verses.english: When the wicked comes, contempt also comes, and with disgrace comes reproach.
verses.hebrew: בְּבוֹא־רָשָׁע בָּא גַם־בּוּז וְעִם־קָלוֹן חֶרְפָּה׃

verses.english: The words of a man's mouth are deep waters; the fountain of wisdom is a flowing stream.
verses.hebrew: מַיִם עֲמֻקִּים דִּבְרֵי פִי־אִישׁ נַחַל נֹבֵעַ מְקוֹר חָכְמָה׃

verses.english: To lift up the face of the wicked is not good, to turn aside the righteous in judgment.
verses.hebrew: שְׂאֵת פְּנֵי־רָשָׁע לֹא־טוֹב לְהַטּוֹת צַדִּיק בַּמִּשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: The lips of a fool enter into strife, and his mouth calls for blows.
verses.hebrew: שִׂפְתֵי כְסִיל יָבֹאוּ בְרִיב וּפִיו לְמַהֲלֻמוֹת יִקְרָא׃

verses.english: A fool's mouth is his ruin, and his lips are a snare for his life.
verses.hebrew: פִּי־כְסִיל מְחִתָּה־לוֹ וּשְׂפָתָיו מוֹקֵשׁ נַפְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: A whisperer's words are like swallowed delicacies, and they descend into the chambers of the belly.
verses.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי נִרְגָּן כְּמִתְלַהֲמִים וְהֵם יָרְדוּ חַדְרֵי־בָטֶן׃

verses.english: One who is slack in his work is also brother to a master of destruction.
verses.hebrew: גַּם מִתְרַפֶּה בִמְלַאכְתּוֹ אָח הוּא לְבַעַל מַשְׁחִית׃

verses.english: The name of YHWH is a tower of strength; the righteous runs into it and is set high.
verses.hebrew: מִגְדַּל־עֹז שֵׁם יְהוָה בּוֹ־יָרוּץ צַדִּיק וְנִשְׂגָּב׃

verses.english: A rich man's wealth is his fortified town, and like a high wall in his imagination.
verses.hebrew: הוֹן עָשִׁיר קִרְיַת עֻזּוֹ וּכְחוֹמָה נִשְׂגָּבָה בְּמַשְׂכִּיתוֹ׃

verses.english: Before breaking a man's heart grows high, and before honor comes humility.
verses.hebrew: לִפְנֵי־שֶׁבֶר יִגְבַּהּ לֵב־אִישׁ וְלִפְנֵי כָבוֹד עֲנָוָה׃

verses.english: One who answers a matter before hearing it— it is folly and humiliation for him.
verses.hebrew: מֵשִׁיב דָּבָר בְּטֶרֶם יִשְׁמָע אִוֶּלֶת הִיא־לוֹ וּכְלִמָּה׃

verses.english: A person's spirit sustains his sickness, but a stricken spirit—who can bear it?
verses.hebrew: רוּחַ־אִישׁ יְכַלְכֵּל מַחֲלֵהוּ וְרוּחַ נְכֵאָה מִי יִשָּׂאֶנָּה׃

verses.english: An understanding heart acquires knowledge, and the ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
verses.hebrew: לֵב נָבוֹן יִקְנֶה־דָּעַת וְאֹזֶן חֲכָמִים תְּבַקֶּשׁ־דָּעַת׃

verses.english: A person's gift makes room for him, and leads him before great people.
verses.hebrew: מַתָּן אָדָם יַרְחִיב לוֹ וְלִפְנֵי גְדֹלִים יַנְחֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: The first to state his case is righteous, until his neighbor comes and examines him.
verses.hebrew: צַדִּיק הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּרִיבוֹ יבא־[וּבָא־] רֵעֵהוּ וַחֲקָרוֹ׃

verses.english: The lot puts an end to disputes, and separates the mighty.
verses.hebrew: מִדְיָנִים יַשְׁבִּית הַגּוֹרָל וּבֵין עֲצוּמִים יַפְרִיד׃

verses.english: A brother offended is harder than a fortified town, and disputes are like a palace bar.
verses.hebrew: אָח נִפְשָׁע מִקִּרְיַת־עֹז ומדונים [וּמִדְיָנִים] כִּבְרִיחַ אַרְמוֹן׃

verses.english: From the fruit of a man's mouth his belly is satisfied; from the yield of his lips he is satisfied.
verses.hebrew: מִפְּרִי פִי־אִישׁ תִּשְׂבַּע בִּטְנוֹ תְּבוּאַת שְׂפָתָיו יִשְׂבָּע׃

verses.english: Death and life are in the hand of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
verses.hebrew: מָוֶת וְחַיִּים בְּיַד־לָשׁוֹן וְאֹהֲבֶיהָ יֹאכַל פִּרְיָהּ׃

verses.english: One who finds a wife finds good, and obtains favor from YHWH.
verses.hebrew: מָצָא אִשָּׁה מָצָא טוֹב וַיָּפֶק רָצוֹן מֵיְהוָה׃

verses.hebrew: מָצָא אִשָּׁה מָצָא טוֹב וַיָּפֶק רָצוֹן מֵיְהוָה׃

verses.english: A person's folly twists his way, but his heart rages against YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אִוֶּלֶת אָדָם תְּסַלֵּף דַּרְכּוֹ וְעַל־יְהוָה יִזְעַף לִבּוֹ׃

verses.english: Wealth adds many companions, but the poor person is separated from his companion.
verses.hebrew: הוֹן יֹסִיף רֵעִים רַבִּים וְדָל מֵרֵעהוּ יִפָּרֵד׃

verses.english: A false witness will not go unpunished, and one who breathes lies will not escape.
verses.hebrew: עֵד שְׁקָרִים לֹא יִנָּקֶה וְיָפִיחַ כְּזָבִים לֹא יִמָּלֵט׃

verses.english: Many seek the favor of a noble person, and everyone is a companion to a man of gifts.
verses.hebrew: רַבִּים יְחַלּוּ פְנֵי־נָדִיב וְכָל־הָרֵעַ לְאִישׁ מַתָּן׃

verses.english: All the brothers of a poor man hate him; how much more his companions keep far from him! He pursues words, but they are not there.
verses.hebrew: כָּל אֲחֵי־רָשׁ שְׂנֵאֻהוּ אַף כִּי מְרֵעֵהוּ רָחֲקוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מְרַדֵּף אֲמָרִים לא־[לוֹ־] הֵמָּה׃

verses.english: One who acquires heart loves his own life; one who keeps understanding finds good.
verses.hebrew: קֹנֶה־לֵּב אֹהֵב נַפְשׁוֹ שֹׁמֵר תְּבוּנָה לִמְצֹא־טוֹב׃

verses.english: A false witness will not go unpunished, and one who breathes lies will perish.
verses.hebrew: עֵד שְׁקָרִים לֹא יִנָּקֶה וְיָפִיחַ כְּזָבִים יֹאבֵד׃

verses.english: Luxury does not suit a fool, still less a servant ruling over princes.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־נָאוֶה לִכְסִיל תַּעֲנוּג אַף כִּי־לְעֶבֶד מְשֹׁל בְּשָׂרִים׃

verses.english: A person's prudence makes him slow to anger, and his splendor is to pass over a transgression.
verses.hebrew: שֵׂכֶל אָדָם הֶאֱרִיךְ אַפּוֹ וְתִפאַרְתּוֹ עֲבֹר עַל־פָּשַׁע׃

verses.english: A king's rage is like a young lion's roar, but his favor is like dew upon grass.
verses.hebrew: נַהַם כַּכְּפִיר זַעַף מֶלֶךְ וּכְטַל עַל־עֵשֶׂב רְצוֹנוֹ׃

verses.english: A foolish son is ruin to his father, and a wife's disputes are a persistent dripping.
verses.hebrew: הַוֺּת לְאָבִיו בֵּן כְּסִיל וְדֶלֶף טֹרֵד מִדְיְנֵי אִשָּׁה׃

verses.english: House and wealth are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from YHWH.
verses.hebrew: בַּיִת וָהוֹן נַחֲלַת אָבוֹת וּמֵיְהוָה אִשָּׁה מַשְׂכָּלֶת׃

verses.english: Laziness casts one into deep sleep, and a slack life will hunger.
verses.hebrew: עַצְלָה תַּפִּיל תַּרְדֵּמָה וְנֶפֶשׁ רְמִיָּה תִרְעָב׃

verses.english: One who keeps a command keeps his life; one who despises his ways will die.
verses.hebrew: שֹׁמֵר מִצְוָה שֹׁמֵר נַפְשׁוֹ בּוֹזֵה דְרָכָיו יומת [יָמוּת׃]

verses.english: One who shows favor to the poor lends to YHWH, and He will repay him his recompense.
verses.hebrew: מַלְוֵה יְהוָה חוֹנֵן דָּל וּגְמֻלוֹ יְשַׁלֶּם־לוֹ׃

verses.english: Discipline your son, for there is hope, but do not lift your desire toward putting him to death.
verses.hebrew: יַסֵּר בִּנְךָ כִּי־יֵשׁ תִּקְוָה וְאֶל־הֲמִיתוֹ אַל־תִּשָּׂא נַפְשֶׁךָ׃

verses.english: One of great wrath bears a penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.
verses.hebrew: גרל־[גְּדָל־] חֵמָה נֹשֵׂא עֹנֶשׁ כִּי אִם־תַּצִּיל וְעוֹד תּוֹסִף׃

verses.english: Listen to counsel and receive discipline, so that you may become wise in your latter days.
verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע עֵצָה וְקַבֵּל מוּסָר לְמַעַן תֶּחְכַּם בְּאַחֲרִיתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Many are the plans in a person's heart, but the counsel of YHWH—it will stand.
verses.hebrew: רַבּוֹת מַחֲשָׁבוֹת בְּלֶב־אִישׁ וַעֲצַת יְהוָה הִיא תָקוּם׃

verses.english: A person's desire is his steadfast kindness, and better a poor person than a lying man.
verses.hebrew: תַּאֲוַת אָדָם חַסְדּוֹ וְטוֹב־רָשׁ מֵאִישׁ כָּזָב׃

verses.english: The fear of YHWH is for life, and one rests satisfied, unvisited by evil.
verses.hebrew: יִרְאַת יְהוָה לְחַיִּים וְשָׂבֵעַ יָלִין בַּל־יִפָּקֶד רָע׃

verses.english: The lazy person buries his hand in the dish; he will not even bring it back to his mouth.
verses.hebrew: טָמַן עָצֵל יָדוֹ בַּצַּלָּחַת גַּם־אֶל־פִּיהוּ לֹא יְשִׁיבֶנָּה׃

verses.english: Strike a scoffer, and a simple person becomes shrewd; reprove one who understands, and he will understand knowledge.
verses.hebrew: לֵץ תַּכֶּה וּפֶתִי יַעְרִם וְהוֹכִיחַ לְנָבוֹן יָבִין דָּעַת׃

verses.english: One who devastates a father and drives a mother away is a son who brings shame and disgrace.
verses.hebrew: מְשַׁדֶּד־אָב יַבְרִיחַ אֵם בֵּן מֵבִישׁ וּמַחְפִּיר׃

verses.english: Cease, my son, to hear discipline, and you will wander from sayings of knowledge.
verses.hebrew: חַדַל־בְּנִי לִשְׁמֹעַ מוּסָר לִשְׁגוֹת מֵאִמְרֵי־דָעַת׃

verses.english: A worthless witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked swallows wrongdoing.
verses.hebrew: עֵד בְּלִיַּעַל יָלִיץ מִשְׁפָּט וּפִי רְשָׁעִים יְבַלַּע־אָוֶן׃

verses.english: Judgments are prepared for scoffers, and blows for the back of fools.
verses.hebrew: נָכוֹנוּ לַלֵּצִים שְׁפָטִים וּמַהֲלֻמוֹת לְגֵו כְּסִילִים׃

verses.english: Wine is a scoffer, strong drink a clamor-maker, and whoever wanders through it does not become wise.
verses.hebrew: לֵץ הַיַּין הֹמֶה שֵׁכָר וְכָל־שֹׁגֶה בּוֹ לֹא יֶחְכָּם׃

verses.english: The terror of a king is like a young lion's roar; one who provokes him sins against his own life.
verses.hebrew: נַהַם כַּכְּפִיר אֵימַת מֶלֶךְ מִתְעַבְּרוֹ חוֹטֵא נַפְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: It is honor for a man to cease from strife, but every fool breaks out into it.
verses.hebrew: כָּבוֹד לָאִישׁ שֶׁבֶת מֵרִיב וְכָל־אֱוִיל יִתְגַּלָּע׃

verses.english: Because of winter the lazy person does not plow; at harvest he asks, and there is nothing.
verses.hebrew: מֵחֹרֶף עָצֵל לֹא־יַחֲרֹשׁ ישאל [וְשָׁאַל] בַּקָּצִיר וָאָיִן׃

verses.english: Counsel in a man's heart is deep water, but a person of understanding draws it out.
verses.hebrew: מַיִם עֲמֻקִּים עֵצָה בְלֶב־אִישׁ וְאִישׁ תְּבוּנָה יִדְלֶנָּה׃

verses.english: Many a person proclaims his own steadfast kindness, but a faithful man—who can find him?
verses.hebrew: רָב־אָדָם יִקְרָא אִישׁ חַסְדּוֹ וְאִישׁ אֱמוּנִים מִי יִמְצָא׃

verses.english: The righteous walks in his integrity; happy are his children after him.
verses.hebrew: מִתְהַלֵּךְ בְּתֻמּוֹ צַדִּיק אַשְׁרֵי בָנָיו אַחֲרָיו׃

verses.english: A king sitting on a throne of judgment winnows every evil with his eyes.
verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא־דִין מְזָרֶה בְעֵינָיו כָּל־רָע׃

verses.english: Who can say, “I have made my heart clean; I am pure from my sin”?
verses.hebrew: מִי־יֹאמַר זִכִּיתִי לִבִּי טָהַרְתִּי מֵחַטָּאתִי׃

verses.english: One who curses his father and his mother— his lamp is extinguished in the pupil of darkness.
verses.hebrew: מִי־יֹאמַר זִכִּיתִי לִבִּי טָהַרְתִּי מֵחַטָּאתִי׃

verses.english: An inheritance hastened at the beginning will not be blessed at its end.
verses.hebrew: מִי־יֹאמַר זִכִּיתִי לִבִּי טָהַרְתִּי מֵחַטָּאתִי׃

verses.english: Do not say, “I will repay evil.” Wait for YHWH, and He will save you.
verses.hebrew: מִי־יֹאמַר זִכִּיתִי לִבִּי טָהַרְתִּי מֵחַטָּאתִי׃

verses.english: A stone and another stone, an ephah and another ephah— both of them are an abomination to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אֶבֶן וָאֶבֶן אֵיפָה וְאֵיפָה תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה גַּם־שְׁנֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Even a youth is known by his deeds, whether his work is pure and whether it is upright.
verses.hebrew: גַּם בְּמַעֲלָלָיו יִתְנַכֶּר־נָעַר אִם־זַךְ וְאִם־יָשָׁר פָּעֳלוֹ׃

verses.english: A hearing ear and a seeing eye— YHWH has made both of them.
verses.hebrew: אֹזֶן שֹׁמַעַת וְעַיִן רֹאָה יְהוָה עָשָׂה גַם־שְׁנֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Do not love sleep, lest you become poor; open your eyes and be satisfied with bread.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תֶּאֱהַב שֵׁנָה פֶּן־תִּוָּרֵשׁ פְּקַח עֵינֶיךָ שְׂבַע־לָחֶם׃

verses.english: A stone and another stone are an abomination to YHWH, and deceitful scales are not good.
verses.hebrew: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה אֶבֶן וָאָבֶן וּמֹאזְנֵי מִרְמָה לֹא־טוֹב׃

verses.english: A man's steps are from YHWH; how then can a person understand his way?
verses.hebrew: מֵיהוָה מִצְעֲדֵי־גָבֶר וְאָדָם מַה־יָּבִין דַּרְכּוֹ׃

verses.english: It is a snare for a person rashly to say, “Holy!” and after vows to make inquiry.
verses.hebrew: מוֹקֵשׁ אָדָם יָלַע קֹדֶשׁ וְאַחַר נְדָרִים לְבַקֵּר׃

verses.english: A wise king winnows the wicked, and turns a wheel over them.
verses.hebrew: מְזָרֶה רְשָׁעִים מֶלֶךְ חָכָם וַיָּשֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶם אוֹפָן׃

verses.english: A person's breath is the lamp of YHWH, searching all the chambers of the belly.
verses.hebrew: נֵר יְהוָה נִשְׁמַת אָדָם חֹפֵשׂ כָּל־חַדְרֵי־בָטֶן׃

verses.english: Steadfast kindness and faithfulness guard a king, and he supports his throne with steadfast kindness.
verses.hebrew: חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת יִצְּרוּ־מֶלֶךְ וְסָעַד בַּחֶסֶד כִּסְאוֹ׃

verses.english: The splendor of young men is their strength, and the majesty of elders is gray hair.
verses.hebrew: תִּפְאֶרֶת בַּחוּרִים כֹּחָם וַהֲדַר זְקֵנִים שֵׂיבָה׃

verses.english: Stripes from a wound scour away evil, and blows reach the chambers of the belly.
verses.hebrew: חַבֻּרוֹת פֶּצַע תמריק [תַּמְרוּק] בְּרָע וּמַכּוֹת חַדְרֵי־בָטֶן׃

verses.english: The heart of a king is streams of water in the hand of YHWH; He bends it toward whatever He desires.
verses.hebrew: פַּלְגֵי־מַיִם לֶב־מֶלֶךְ בְּיַד־יְהוָה עַל־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר יַחְפֹּץ יַטֶּנּוּ׃

verses.english: Every way of a man is upright in his own eyes, but YHWH weighs hearts.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־דֶּרֶךְ־אִישׁ יָשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו וְתֹכֵן לִבּוֹת יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Doing righteousness and justice is more desirable to YHWH than sacrifice.
verses.hebrew: עֲשֹׂה צְדָקָה וּמִשְׁפָּט נִבְחָר לַיהוָה מִזָּבַח׃

verses.english: Height of eyes and breadth of heart— the lamp of the wicked is sin.
verses.hebrew: רוּם־עֵינַיִם וּרְחַב־לֵב נִר רְשָׁעִים חַטָּאת׃

verses.english: Making treasures by a lying tongue is a driven breath—seekers of death.
verses.hebrew: פֹּעַל אוֹצָרוֹת בִּלְשׁוֹן שָׁקֶר הֶבֶל נִדָּף מְבַקְשֵׁי־מָוֶת׃

verses.english: The violence of the wicked drags them away, for they refuse to do justice.
verses.hebrew: שֹׁד־רְשָׁעִים יְגוֹרֵם כִּי מֵאֲנוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: A guilty man's way is twisted, but the pure person's work is upright.
verses.hebrew: הֲפַכְפַּךְ דֶּרֶךְ אִישׁ וָזָר וְזַךְ יָשָׁר פָּעֳלוֹ׃

verses.english: Better to dwell on a corner of a roof than with a contentious wife in a shared house.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב לָשֶׁבֶת עַל־פִּנַּת־גָּג מֵאֵשֶׁת מִדְיָנִים וּבֵית חָבֶר׃

verses.english: The appetite of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no favor in his eyes.
verses.hebrew: נֶפֶשׁ רָשָׁע אִוְּתָה־רָע לֹא־יֻחַן בְּעֵינָיו רֵעֵהוּ׃

verses.english: When a scoffer is penalized, a simple person becomes wise, and when a wise person is instructed, he receives knowledge.
verses.hebrew: בַּעְנָשׁ־לֵץ יֶחְכַּם־פֶּתִי וּבְהַשְׂכִּיל לְחָכָם יִקַּח־דָּעַת׃

verses.english: A righteous one gives thought to the house of the wicked, overturning the wicked into evil.
verses.hebrew: מַשְׂכִּיל צַדִּיק לְבֵית רָשָׁע מְסַלֵּף רְשָׁעִים לָרָע׃

verses.english: One who stops his ear to the cry of the poor will himself also call and not be answered.
verses.hebrew: אֹטֵם אָזְנוֹ מִזַּעֲקַת־דָּל גַּם־הוּא יִקְרָא וְלֹא יֵעָנֶה׃

verses.english: A gift in secret subdues anger, and a bribe in the garment-fold fierce wrath.
verses.hebrew: מַתָּן בַּסֵּתֶר יִכְפֶּה־אָף וְשֹׁחַד בַּחֵק חֵמָה עַזָּה׃

verses.english: Doing justice is joy to the righteous, but terror to those who work wrongdoing.
verses.hebrew: שִׂמְחָה לַצַּדִּיק עֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט וּמְחִתָּה לְפֹעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃

verses.english: A person who wanders from the way of prudence will rest in the assembly of the shades.
verses.hebrew: אָדָם תּוֹעֶה מִדֶּרֶךְ הַשְׂכֵּל בִּקְהַל רְפָאִים יָנוּחַ׃

verses.english: One who loves pleasure is a person of lack; one who loves wine and oil will not become rich.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ מַחְסוֹר אֹהֵב שִׂמְחָה אֹהֵב יַיִן־וָשֶׁמֶן לֹא יַעֲשִׁיר׃

verses.english: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, and the treacherous takes the place of the upright.
verses.hebrew: כֹּפֶר לַצַּדִּיק רָשָׁע וְתַחַת יְשָׁרִים בּוֹגֵד׃

verses.english: Better to dwell in a wilderness land than with a contentious and vexatious wife.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב שֶׁבֶת בְּאֶרֶץ־מִדְבָּר מֵאֵשֶׁת מדונים [מִדְיָנִים] וָכָעַס׃

verses.english: Desirable treasure and oil are in a wise person's dwelling, but a foolish person swallows it up.
verses.hebrew: אוֹצָר נֶחְמָד וָשֶׁמֶן בִּנְוֵה חָכָם וּכְסִיל אָדָם יְבַלְּעֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: One who pursues righteousness and steadfast kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.
verses.hebrew: רֹדֵף צְדָקָה וָחָסֶד יִמְצָא חַיִּים צְדָקָה וְכָבוֹד׃

verses.english: A wise person climbs a city of mighty men, and brings down the strength of its confidence.
verses.hebrew: עִיר גִּבֹּרִים עָלָה חָכָם וַיֹּרֶד עֹז מִבְטֶחָה׃

verses.english: One who guards his mouth and tongue guards his life from troubles.
verses.hebrew: שֹׁמֵר פִּיו וּלְשׁוֹנוֹ שֹׁמֵר מִצָּרוֹת נַפְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: An arrogant, haughty person—Scoffer is his name— acts in the fury of arrogance.
verses.hebrew: זֵד יָהִיר לֵץ שְׁמוֹ עוֹשֶׂה בְּעֶבְרַת זָדוֹן׃

verses.english: The desire of the lazy person kills him, for his hands refuse to work.
verses.hebrew: תַּאֲוַת עָצֵל תְּמִיתֶנּוּ כִּי־מֵאֲנוּ יָדָיו לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

verses.english: All day he craves a craving, but the righteous gives and does not withhold.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַיּוֹם הִתְאַוָּה תַאֲוָה וְצַדִּיק יִתֵּן וְלֹא יַחְשֹׂךְ׃

verses.english: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination; how much more when he brings it with an evil scheme!
verses.hebrew: זֶבַח רְשָׁעִים תּוֹעֵבָה אַף כִּי־בְזִמָּה יְבִיאֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: A lying witness will perish, but a man who listens will speak enduringly.
verses.hebrew: עֵד־כְּזָבִים יֹאבֵד וְאִישׁ שׁוֹמֵעַ לָנֶצַח יְדַבֵּר׃

verses.english: A wicked man hardens his face, but the upright establishes his ways.
verses.hebrew: הֵעֵז אִישׁ רָשָׁע בְּפָנָיו וְיָשָׁר הוּא יכין [יָבִין] דרכיו [דַּרְכּוֹ׃]

verses.english: There is no wisdom and no understanding and no counsel against YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אֵין חָכְמָה וְאֵין תְּבוּנָה וְאֵין עֵצָה לְנֶגֶד יְהוָה׃

verses.english: A horse is prepared for the day of battle, but deliverance belongs to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: סוּס מוּכָן לְיוֹם מִלְחָמָה וְלַיהוָה הַתְּשׁוּעָה׃

verses.english: A name is preferable to great wealth, and good favor to silver and gold.
verses.hebrew: נִבְחָר שֵׁם מֵעֹשֶׁר רָב מִכֶּסֶף וּמִזָּהָב חֵן טוֹב׃

verses.english: Rich and poor meet together; YHWH is the Maker of them all.
verses.hebrew: עָשִׁיר וָרָשׁ נִפְגָּשׁוּ עֹשֵׂה כֻלָּם יְהוָה׃

verses.english: A shrewd person sees evil and hides, but the simple pass on and are penalized.
verses.hebrew: עָרוּם רָאָה רָעָה ויסתר [וְנִסְתָּר] וּפְתָיִים עָבְרוּ וְנֶעֱנָשׁוּ׃

verses.english: The outcome of humility is the fear of YHWH, wealth and honor and life.
verses.hebrew: עֵקֶב עֲנָוָה יִרְאַת יְהוָה עֹשֶׁר וְכָבוֹד וְחַיִּים׃

verses.english: Thorns and snares are in the way of the crooked; one who guards his life keeps far from them.
verses.hebrew: צִנִּים פַּחִים בְּדֶרֶךְ עִקֵּשׁ שׁוֹמֵר נַפְשׁוֹ יִרְחַק מֵהֶם׃

verses.english: The rich rules over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the man who lends.
verses.hebrew: עָשִׁיר בְּרָשִׁים יִמְשׁוֹל וְעֶבֶד לֹוֶה לְאִישׁ מַלְוֶה׃

verses.english: One who sows injustice reaps trouble, and the rod of his wrath will come to an end.
verses.hebrew: זוֹרֵעַ עַוְלָה יקצור־[יִקְצָר־] אָוֶן וְשֵׁבֶט עֶבְרָתוֹ יִכְלֶה׃

verses.english: One good of eye will be blessed, for he has given of his bread to the poor.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב־עַיִן הוּא יְבֹרָךְ כִּי־נָתַן מִלַּחְמוֹ לַדָּל׃

verses.hebrew: טוֹב־עַיִן הוּא יְבֹרָךְ כִּי־נָתַן מִלַּחְמוֹ לַדָּל׃

verses.english: Drive out a scoffer, and dispute goes out; strife and disgrace cease.
verses.hebrew: גָּרֵשׁ לֵץ וְיֵצֵא מָדוֹן וְיִשְׁבֹּת דִּין וְקָלוֹן׃

verses.english: One who loves purity of heart, whose lips have favor—a king is his companion.
verses.hebrew: אֹהֵב טהור־[טְהָר־] לֵב חֵן שְׂפָתָיו רֵעֵהוּ מֶלֶךְ׃

verses.english: The eyes of YHWH guard knowledge, but He overturns the words of the treacherous.
verses.hebrew: עֵינֵי יְהוָה נָצְרוּ דָעַת וַיְסַלֵּף דִּבְרֵי בֹגֵד׃

verses.english: The lazy person says, “A lion is outside! I will be murdered in the midst of the squares!”
verses.hebrew: אָמַר עָצֵל אֲרִי בַחוּץ בְּתוֹךְ רְחֹבוֹת אֵרָצֵחַ׃

verses.english: The mouth of foreign women is a deep pit; one under YHWH's indignation falls there.
verses.hebrew: שׁוּחָה עֲמֻקָּה פִּי זָרוֹת זְעוּם יְהוָה יפול־[יִפָּל־] שָׁם׃

verses.english: H — [No corresponding text in the displayed Hebrew main text.]
verses.hebrew: שׁוּחָה עֲמֻקָּה פִּי זָרוֹת זְעוּם יְהוָה יפול־[יִפָּל־] שָׁם׃

verses.english: Folly is bound in a youth's heart; the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
verses.hebrew: אִוֶּלֶת קְשׁוּרָה בְלֶב־נָעַר שֵׁבֶט מוּסָר יַרְחִיקֶנָּה מִמֶּנּוּ׃

verses.english: One who oppresses the poor to increase for himself, one who gives to the rich—only to lack.
verses.hebrew: עֹשֵׁק דָּל לְהַרְבּוֹת לוֹ נֹתֵן לְעָשִׁיר אַךְ־לְמַחְסוֹר׃

verses.english: Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise, and set your heart upon my knowledge,
verses.hebrew: הַט אָזְנְךָ וּשְׁמַע דִּבְרֵי חֲכָמִים וְלִבְּךָ תָּשִׁית לְדַעְתִּי׃

verses.english: for it is pleasant when you keep them in your belly, when they are established together upon your lips.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־נָעִים כִּי־תִשְׁמְרֵם בְּבִטְנֶךָ יִכֹּנוּ יַחְדָּו עַל־שְׂפָתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: So that your confidence may be in YHWH, I have made them known to you today—to you yourself.
verses.hebrew: לִהְיוֹת בַּיהוָה מִבְטַחֶךָ הוֹדַעְתִּיךָ הַיּוֹם אַף־אָתָּה׃

verses.english: Have I not written threefold things for you, with counsels and knowledge,
verses.hebrew: הֲלֹא כָתַבְתִּי לְךָ שלשום [שָׁלִישִׁים] בְּמוֹעֵצֹת וָדָעַת׃

verses.english: to make you know the certainty of sayings of truth, to return sayings of truth to those who send you?
verses.hebrew: לְהוֹדִיעֲךָ קֹשְׁטְ אִמְרֵי אֱמֶת לְהָשִׁיב אֲמָרִים אֱמֶת לְשֹׁלְחֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Do not rob the poor because he is poor, and do not crush the afflicted in the gate,
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּגְזָל־דָּל כִּי דַל־הוּא וְאַל־תְּדַכֵּא עָנִי בַשָּׁעַר׃

verses.english: for YHWH will plead their case, and rob their robbers of life.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יְהוָה יָרִיב רִיבָם וְקָבַע אֶת־קֹבְעֵיהֶם נָפֶשׁ׃

verses.english: Do not befriend a master of anger, and do not go with a man of wrath,
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתְרַע אֶת־בַּעַל אָף וְאֶת־אִישׁ חֵמוֹת לֹא תָבוֹא׃

verses.english: lest you learn his paths and take a snare for your life.
verses.hebrew: פֶּן־תֶּאֱלַף ארחתו [אֹרְחֹתָיו] וְלָקַחְתָּ מוֹקֵשׁ לְנַפְשֶׁךָ׃

verses.english: Do not be among those striking palms, among those guaranteeing debts.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תְּהִי בְתֹקְעֵי־כָף בַּעֹרְבִים מַשָּׁאוֹת׃

verses.english: If you have nothing with which to pay, why should he take your bed from under you?
verses.hebrew: אִם־אֵין־לְךָ לְשַׁלֵּם לָמָּה יִקַּח מִשְׁכָּבְךָ מִתַּחְתֶּיךָ׃

verses.english: Do not move an ancient boundary that your fathers made.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּסֵּג גְּבוּל עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר עָשׂוּ אֲבוֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Have you seen a man swift in his work? He will stand before kings; he will not stand before obscure people.
verses.hebrew: חָזִיתָ אִישׁ מָהִיר בִּמְלַאכְתּוֹ לִפְנֵי־מְלָכִים יִתְיַצָּב בַּל־יִתְיַצֵּב לִפְנֵי חֲשֻׁכִּים׃

verses.english: When you sit to eat with a ruler, carefully understand what is before you,
verses.hebrew: כִּי־תֵשֵׁב לִלְחוֹם אֶת־מוֹשֵׁל בִּין תָּבִין אֶת־אֲשֶׁר לְפָנֶיךָ׃

verses.english: and put a knife to your throat if you are a person of appetite.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתָּ שַׂכִּין בְּלֹעֶךָ אִם־בַּעַל נֶפֶשׁ אָתָּה׃

verses.english: Do not crave his delicacies, for it is bread of lies.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּלְחַם אֶת־לֶחֶם רַע עָיִן וְאַל־תתאו [תִּתְאָיו] לְמַטְעַמֹּתָיו׃

verses.english: Do not weary yourself to become rich; cease from your own understanding.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּיגַע לְהַעֲשִׁיר מִבִּינָתְךָ חֲדָל׃

verses.english: Will you make your eyes fly upon it, and it is gone? For it surely makes wings for itself; like an eagle it flies toward the heavens.
verses.hebrew: התעוף [הֲתָעִיף] עֵינֶיךָ בּוֹ וְאֵינֶנּוּ כִּי עָשֹׂה יַעֲשֶׂה־לּוֹ כְנָפַיִם כְּנֶשֶׁר ועיף [יָעוּף] הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

verses.english: Do not eat the bread of one evil of eye, and do not crave his delicacies,
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּלְחַם אֶת־לֶחֶם רַע עָיִן וְאַל־תתאו [תִּתְאָיו] לְמַטְעַמֹּתָיו׃

verses.english: for as he calculates within his life, so he is. “Eat and drink,” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כְּמוֹ־שָׁעַר בְּנַפְשׁוֹ כֶּן־הוּא אֱכֹל וּשְׁתֵה יֹאמַר לָךְ וְלִבּוֹ בַּל־עִמָּךְ׃

verses.english: You will vomit the morsel you ate, and spoil your pleasant words.
verses.hebrew: פִּתְּךָ־אָכַלְתָּ תְקִיאֶנָּה וְשִׁחַתָּ דְּבָרֶיךָ הַנְּעִימִים׃

verses.english: Do not speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the prudence of your words.
verses.hebrew: בְּאָזְנֵי כְסִיל אַל־תְּדַבֵּר כִּי־יָבוּז לְשֵׂכֶל מִלֶּיךָ׃

verses.english: Do not move an ancient boundary, and do not enter the fields of orphans,
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּסֵּג גְּבוּל עוֹלָם וּבִשְׂדֵי יְתוֹמִים אַל־תָּבֹא׃

verses.english: for their Redeemer is strong; He will plead their case against you.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־גֹאֲלָם חָזָק הוּא־יָרִיב אֶת־רִיבָם אִתָּךְ׃

verses.english: Bring your heart to discipline, and your ear to sayings of knowledge.
verses.hebrew: הָבִיאָה לַמּוּסָר לִבֶּךָ וְאָזְנֶךָ לְאִמְרֵי־דָעַת׃

verses.english: Do not withhold discipline from a youth; if you strike him with the rod, he will not die.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּמְנַע מִנַּעַר מוּסָר כִּי־תַכֶּנּוּ בַשֵּׁבֶט לֹא יָמוּת׃

verses.english: You strike him with the rod, and rescue his life from Sheol.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה בַּשֵּׁבֶט תַּכֶּנּוּ וְנַפְשׁוֹ מִשְּׁאוֹל תַּצִּיל׃

verses.english: My son, if your heart becomes wise, my heart, mine also, will rejoice.
verses.hebrew: בְּנִי אִם־חָכַם לִבֶּךָ יִשְׂמַח לִבִּי גַם־אָנִי׃

verses.english: And my kidneys will exult when your lips speak upright things.
verses.hebrew: וְתַעְלֹזְנָה כִלְיוֹתָי בְּדַבֵּר שְׂפָתֶיךָ מֵישָׁרִים׃

verses.english: Do not let your heart envy sinners, but be in the fear of YHWH all day.
verses.hebrew: אַל־יְקַנֵּא לִבְּךָ בַּחַטָּאִים כִּי אִם־בְּיִרְאַת־יְהוָה כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃

verses.english: For surely there is an afterward, and your hope will not be cut off.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־יֵשׁ אַחֲרִית וְתִקְוָתְךָ לֹא תִכָּרֵת׃

verses.english: Hear, you, my son, and become wise, and lead your heart straight in the way.
verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע־אַתָּה בְנִי וַחֲכָם וְאַשֵּׁר בַּדֶּרֶךְ לִבֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Do not be among wine-guzzlers, among those who gorge themselves on meat,
verses.hebrew: אַל־תְּהִי בְסֹבְאֵי־יָיִן בְּזֹלֲלֵי בָשָׂר לָמוֹ׃

verses.english: for the guzzler and glutton becomes poor, and drowsiness clothes one in rags.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־סֹבֵא וְזוֹלֵל יִוָּרֵשׁ וּקְרָעִים תַּלְבִּישׁ נוּמָה׃

verses.english: Listen to your father, who begot you, and do not despise your mother when she is old.
verses.hebrew: שְׁמַע לְאָבִיךָ זֶה יְלָדֶךָ וְאַל־תָּבוּז כִּי־זָקְנָה אִמֶּךָ׃

verses.english: The father of a righteous person will greatly exult, and one who begets a wise person rejoices in him.
verses.hebrew: גול [גִּיל] יגול [יָגִיל] אֲבִי צַדִּיק יולד [וְיוֹלֵד] חָכָם וישמח־[יִשְׂמַח־] בּוֹ׃

verses.english: Let your father and your mother rejoice, and let the one who bore you exult.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׂמַח־אָבִיךָ וְאִמֶּךָ וְתָגֵל יוֹלַדְתֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Give me your heart, my son, and let your eyes delight in my ways,
verses.hebrew: תְּנָה־בְנִי לִבְּךָ לִי וְעֵינֶיךָ דְּרָכַי תרצנה [תִּצֹּרְנָה׃]

verses.english: for a prostitute is a deep pit, and a foreign woman a narrow well.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־שׁוּחָה עֲמֻקָּה זוֹנָה וּבְאֵר צָרָה נָכְרִיָּה׃

verses.english: She too lies in wait like a robber, and increases the treacherous among humankind.
verses.hebrew: אַף־הִיא כְּחֶתֶף תֶּאֱרֹב וּבוֹגְדִים בְּאָדָם תּוֹסִף׃

verses.english: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has disputes? Who has complaint? Who has wounds without cause? Who has redness of eyes?
verses.hebrew: לְמִי אוֹי לְמִי אֲבוֹי לְמִי מדונים [מִדְיָנִים ] לְמִי שִׂיחַ לְמִי פְּצָעִים חִנָּם לְמִי חַכְלִלוּת עֵינָיִם׃

verses.english: Those who linger over wine, those who come to investigate mixed drink.
verses.hebrew: לַמְאַחֲרִים עַל־הַיָּיִן לַבָּאִים לַחְקֹר מִמְסָךְ׃

verses.english: Do not look at wine when it reddens, when it gives its sparkle in the cup, when it moves smoothly.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תֵּרֶא יַיִן כִּי יִתְאַדָּם כִּי־יִתֵּן בכיס [בַּכּוֹס] עֵינוֹ יִתְהַלֵּךְ בְּמֵישָׁרִים׃

verses.english: At its end it bites like a snake, and strikes like a viper.
verses.hebrew: אַחֲרִיתוֹ כְּנָחָשׁ יִשָּׁךְ וּכְצִפְעֹנִי יַפְרִשׁ׃

verses.english: Your eyes will see foreign things, and your heart will speak perversities.
verses.hebrew: עֵינֶיךָ יִרְאוּ זָרוֹת וְלִבְּךָ יְדַבֵּר תַּהְפֻּכוֹת׃

verses.english: and you will be like one lying in the heart of the sea, and like one lying at the top of the rigging.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיִיתָ כְּשֹׁכֵב בְּלֶב־יָם וּכְשֹׁכֵב בְּרֹאשׁ חִבֵּל׃

verses.english: “They struck me, but I felt no hurt; they beat me, but I did not know. When will I wake? I will seek it yet again.”
verses.hebrew: הִכּוּנִי בַל־חָלִיתִי הֲלָמוּנִי בַּל־יָדָעְתִּי מָתַי אָקִיץ אוֹסִיף אֲבַקְשֶׁנּוּ עוֹד׃

verses.english: Do not envy men of evil, and do not desire to be with them,
verses.hebrew: אַל־תְּקַנֵּא בְּאַנְשֵׁי רָעָה וְאַל־תתאו [תִּתְאָיו] לִהְיוֹת אִתָּם׃

verses.english: for their heart meditates violence, and their lips speak trouble.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־שֹׁד יֶהְגֶּה לִבָּם וְעָמָל שִׂפְתֵיהֶם תְּדַבֵּרְנָה׃

verses.english: By wisdom a house is built, and by understanding it is established;
verses.hebrew: בְּחָכְמָה יִבָּנֶה בָּיִת וּבִתְבוּנָה יִתְכּוֹנָן׃

verses.english: and by knowledge rooms are filled with every precious and pleasant possession.
verses.hebrew: וּבְדַעַת חֲדָרִים יִמָּלְאוּ כָּל־הוֹן יָקָר וְנָעִים׃

verses.english: A wise man is in strength, and a man of knowledge makes power firm.
verses.hebrew: גֶּבֶר־חָכָם בַּעוֹז וְאִישׁ־דַּעַת מְאַמֶּץ־כֹּחַ׃

verses.english: for with guidance you wage your war, and deliverance is in an abundance of counselors.
verses.hebrew: כִּי בְתַחְבֻּלוֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה־לְּךָ מִלְחָמָה וּתְשׁוּעָה בְּרֹב יוֹעֵץ׃

verses.english: Wisdom is too high for a fool; in the gate he does not open his mouth.
verses.hebrew: רָאמוֹת לֶאֱוִיל חָכְמוֹת בַּשַּׁעַר לֹא יִפְתַּח־פִּיהוּ׃

verses.english: One who plans to do evil— they call him a master of schemes.
verses.hebrew: מְחַשֵּׁב לְהָרֵעַ לוֹ בַּעַל־מְזִמּוֹת יִקְרָאוּ׃

verses.english: The scheming of folly is sin, and a scoffer is an abomination to humankind.
verses.hebrew: זִמַּת אִוֶּלֶת חַטָּאת וְתוֹעֲבַת לְאָדָם לֵץ׃

verses.english: If you grow slack on a day of distress, your strength is narrow.
verses.hebrew: הִתְרַפִּיתָ בְּיוֹם צָרָה צַר כֹּחֶכָה׃

verses.english: Rescue those being taken to death, and those tottering toward slaughter—would you hold back?
verses.hebrew: הַצֵּל לְקֻחִים לַמָּוֶת וּמָטִים לַהֶרֶג אִם־תַּחְשׂוֹךְ׃

verses.english: If you say, “Look, we did not know this,” does not the One who weighs hearts understand? The One who guards your life knows, and repays a person according to his work.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־תֹאמַר הֵן לֹא־יָדַעְנוּ זֶה הֲ‍לֹא־תֹכֵן לִבּוֹת הוּא־יָבִין וְנֹצֵר נַפְשְׁךָ הוּא יֵדָע וְהֵשִׁיב לְאָדָם כְּפָעֳלוֹ׃

verses.english: Eat honey, my son, for it is good, and drippings are sweet upon your palate.
verses.hebrew: אֱכָל־בְּנִי דְבַשׁ כִּי־טוֹב וְנֹפֶת מָתוֹק עַל־חִכֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Know wisdom thus for your life; if you find it, there is an afterward, and your hope will not be cut off.
verses.hebrew: כֵּן דְּעֶה חָכְמָה לְנַפְשֶׁךָ אִם־מָצָאתָ וְיֵשׁ אַחֲרִית וְתִקְוָתְךָ לֹא תִכָּרֵת׃

verses.english: Do not lie in wait, wicked person, against the dwelling of the righteous; do not devastate his resting place,
verses.hebrew: אַל־תֶּאֱרֹב רָשָׁע לִנְוֵה צַדִּיק אַל־תְּשַׁדֵּד רִבְצוֹ׃

verses.english: for the righteous falls seven times and rises, but the wicked stumble in evil.
verses.hebrew: כִּי שֶׁבַע יִפּוֹל צַדִּיק וָקָם וּרְשָׁעִים יִכָּשְׁלוּ בְרָעָה׃

verses.english: When your enemies fall, do not rejoice, and when he stumbles, do not let your heart exult,
verses.hebrew: בִּנְפֹל אויביך [אוֹיִבְךָ] אַל־תִּשְׂמָח וּבִכָּשְׁלוֹ אַל־יָגֵל לִבֶּךָ׃

verses.english: lest YHWH see and it be evil in His eyes, and He turn His anger away from him.
verses.hebrew: פֶּן־יִרְאֶה יְהוָה וְרַע בְּעֵינָיו וְהֵשִׁיב מֵעָלָיו אַפּוֹ׃

verses.english: Do not burn with anger at evildoers; do not envy the wicked,
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתְחַר בַּמְּרֵעִים אַל־תְּקַנֵּא בָּרְשָׁעִים׃

verses.english: for the evil person has no afterward; the lamp of the wicked is extinguished.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־תִהְיֶה אַחֲרִית לָרָע נֵר רְשָׁעִים יִדְעָךְ׃

verses.english: Fear YHWH, my son, and the king; do not associate with those who change,
verses.hebrew: יְרָא־אֶת־יְהוָה בְּנִי וָמֶלֶךְ עִם־שׁוֹנִים אַל־תִּתְעָרָב׃

verses.english: for suddenly their calamity will arise, and who knows the ruin of them both?
verses.hebrew: כִּי־פִתְאֹם יָקוּם אֵידָם וּפִיד שְׁנֵיהֶם מִי יוֹדֵעַ׃

verses.english: These also belong to the wise: to recognize faces in judgment is not good.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֵלֶּה לַחֲכָמִים הַכֵּר־פָּנִים בְּמִשְׁפָּט בַּל־טוֹב׃

verses.english: One who says to the wicked, “You are righteous,” peoples curse him, nations denounce him;
verses.hebrew: אֹמֵר לְרָשָׁע צַדִּיק אָתָּה יִקְּבֻהוּ עַמִּים יִזְעָמוּהוּ לְאֻמִּים׃

verses.english: but it will be pleasant for those who reprove, and a blessing of good will come upon them.
verses.hebrew: וְלַמּוֹכִיחִים יִנְעָם וַעֲלֵיהֶם תָּבוֹא בִרְכַּת־טוֹב׃

verses.english: One who answers straightforward words kisses lips.
verses.hebrew: שְׂפָתַיִם יִשָּׁק מֵשִׁיב דְּבָרִים נְכֹחִים׃

verses.english: Prepare your work outside, and make it ready for yourself in the field; afterward build your house.
verses.hebrew: הָכֵן בַּחוּץ מְלַאכְתֶּךָ וְעַתְּדָהּ בַּשָּׂדֶה לָךְ אַחַר וּבָנִיתָ בֵיתֶךָ׃

verses.english: Do not be a witness against your neighbor without cause, and would you deceive with your lips?
verses.hebrew: אַל־תְּהִי עֵד־חִנָּם בְּרֵעֶךָ וַהֲפִתִּיתָ בִּשְׂפָתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Do not say, “As he did to me, so I will do to him; I will repay the man according to his work.”
verses.hebrew: אַל־תֹּאמַר כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה־לִי כֵּן אֶעֱשֶׂה־לּוֹ אָשִׁיב לָאִישׁ כְּפָעֳלוֹ׃

verses.english: I passed by a lazy man's field, and by the vineyard of a person lacking heart;
verses.hebrew: עַל־שְׂדֵה אִישׁ־עָצֵל עָבַרְתִּי וְעַל־כֶּרֶם אָדָם חֲסַר־לֵב׃

verses.english: and look, all of it had grown up with thorns, nettles covered its surface, and its stone wall was torn down.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה עָלָה כֻלּוֹ קִמְּשֹׂנִים כָּסּוּ פָנָיו חֲרֻלִּים וְגֶדֶר אֲבָנָיו נֶהֱרָסָה׃

verses.english: I looked, I set my heart upon it; I saw, I received discipline:
verses.hebrew: וָאֶחֱזֶה אָנֹכִי אָשִׁית לִבִּי רָאִיתִי לָקַחְתִּי מוּסָר׃

verses.english: “A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of hands to lie down”—
verses.hebrew: מְעַט שֵׁנוֹת מְעַט תְּנוּמוֹת מְעַט חִבֻּק יָדַיִם לִשְׁכָּב׃

verses.english: and your poverty comes as one walking about, and your lack like a man with a shield.
verses.hebrew: וּבָא־מִתְהַלֵּךְ רֵישֶׁךָ וּמַחְסֹרֶיךָ כְּאִישׁ מָגֵן׃

verses.english: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־אֵלֶּה מִשְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹה אֲשֶׁר הֶעְתִּיקוּ אַנְשֵׁי חִזְקִיָּה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָה׃

verses.english: The glory of God is to conceal a matter, and the glory of kings is to search out a matter.
verses.hebrew: כְּבֹד אֱלֹהִים הַסְתֵּר דָּבָר וּכְבֹד מְלָכִים חֲקֹר דָּבָר׃

verses.english: The heavens for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.
verses.hebrew: שָׁמַיִם לָרוּם וָאָרֶץ לָעֹמֶק וְלֵב מְלָכִים אֵין חֵקֶר׃

verses.english: Remove dross from silver, and a vessel comes forth for the refiner.
verses.hebrew: הָגוֹ סִיגִים מִכָּסֶף וַיֵּצֵא לַצֹּרֵף כֶּלִי׃

verses.english: Remove the wicked from before a king, and his throne is established in righteousness.
verses.hebrew: הָגוֹ רָשָׁע לִפְנֵי־מֶלֶךְ וְיִכּוֹן בַּצֶּדֶק כִּסְאוֹ׃

verses.english: Do not adorn yourself before a king, and do not stand in the place of great people,
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתְהַדַּר לִפְנֵי־מֶלֶךְ וּבִמְקוֹם גְּדֹלִים אַל־תַּעֲמֹד׃

verses.english: for it is better to be told, “Come up here,” than to be lowered before a noble whom your eyes have seen.
verses.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב אֲמָר־לְךָ עֲ‍לֵה הֵנָּה מֵהַשְׁפִּילְךָ לִפְנֵי נָדִיב אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ׃

verses.english: Do not go out hastily to dispute, lest—what will you do at its end, when your neighbor humiliates you?
verses.hebrew: אַל־תֵּצֵא לָרִב מַהֵר פֶּן מַה־תַּעֲשֶׂה בְּאַחֲרִיתָהּ בְּהַכְלִים אֹתְךָ רֵעֶךָ׃

verses.english: Plead your case with your neighbor, but do not reveal another's secret,
verses.hebrew: רִיבְךָ רִיב אֶת־רֵעֶךָ וְסוֹד אַחֵר אַל־תְּגָל׃

verses.english: lest one who hears shame you, and your bad report not turn away.
verses.hebrew: פֶּן־יְחַסֶּדְךָ שֹׁמֵעַ וְדִבָּתְךָ לֹא תָשׁוּב׃

verses.english: H — [No corresponding text in the displayed Hebrew main text.]
verses.hebrew: פֶּן־יְחַסֶּדְךָ שֹׁמֵעַ וְדִבָּתְךָ לֹא תָשׁוּב׃

verses.english: Golden apples in silver settings— a word spoken upon its fitting occasions.
verses.hebrew: תַּפּוּחֵי זָהָב בְּמַשְׂכִּיּוֹת כָּסֶף דָּבָר דָּבֻר עַל־אָפְנָיו׃

verses.english: A gold ring and an ornament of fine gold— a wise reprover upon a listening ear.
verses.hebrew: נֶזֶם זָהָב וַחֲלִי־כָתֶם מוֹכִיחַ חָכָם עַל־אֹזֶן שֹׁמָעַת׃

verses.english: Like the coolness of snow on a harvest day is a faithful envoy to those who send him; he restores the life of his masters.
verses.hebrew: כְּצִנַּת־שֶׁלֶג בְּיוֹם קָצִיר צִיר נֶאֱמָן לְשֹׁלְחָיו וְנֶפֶשׁ אֲדֹנָיו יָשִׁיב׃

verses.english: Clouds and wind, but no rain— a man boasting of a false gift.
verses.hebrew: נְשִׂיאִים וְרוּחַ וְגֶשֶׁם אָיִן אִישׁ מִתְהַלֵּל בְּמַתַּת־שָׁקֶר׃

verses.english: By slowness to anger a ruler is persuaded, and a soft tongue breaks bone.
verses.hebrew: בְּאֹרֶךְ אַפַּיִם יְפֻתֶּה קָצִין וְלָשׁוֹן רַכָּה תִּשְׁבָּר־גָּרֶם׃

verses.english: Have you found honey? Eat enough for yourself, lest you become filled with it and vomit it.
verses.hebrew: דְּבַשׁ מָצָאתָ אֱכֹל דַּיֶּךָּ פֶּן־תִּשְׂבָּעֶנּוּ וַהֲקֵאתוֹ׃

verses.english: Make your foot rare in your neighbor's house, lest he have his fill of you and hate you.
verses.hebrew: הֹקַר רַגְלְךָ מִבֵּית רֵעֶךָ פֶּן־יִשְׂבָּעֲךָ וּשְׂנֵאֶךָ׃

verses.english: A club and sword and sharpened arrow is a man who answers against his neighbor as a false witness.
verses.hebrew: מֵפִיץ וְחֶרֶב וְחֵץ שָׁנוּן אִישׁ עֹנֶה בְרֵעֵהוּ עֵד שָׁקֶר׃

verses.english: A bad tooth and a slipping foot is confidence in a treacherous person on a day of distress.
verses.hebrew: שֵׁן רֹעָה וְרֶגֶל מוּעָדֶת מִבְטָח בּוֹגֵד בְּיוֹם צָרָה׃

verses.english: Like removing a garment on a cold day, like vinegar on natron, is one singing songs over a troubled heart.
verses.hebrew: מַעֲדֶה בֶּגֶד בְּיוֹם קָרָה חֹמֶץ עַל־נָתֶר וְשָׁר בַּשִּׁרִים עַל לֶב־רָע׃

verses.english: H — [No corresponding text in the displayed Hebrew main text.]
verses.hebrew: מַעֲדֶה בֶּגֶד בְּיוֹם קָרָה חֹמֶץ עַל־נָתֶר וְשָׁר בַּשִּׁרִים עַל לֶב־רָע׃

verses.english: If the one who hates you is hungry, feed him bread, and if he is thirsty, give him water to drink,
verses.hebrew: אִם־רָעֵב שֹׂנַאֲךָ הַאֲכִלֵהוּ לָחֶם וְאִם־צָמֵא הַשְׁקֵהוּ מָיִם׃

verses.english: for you heap coals upon his head, and YHWH will repay you.
verses.hebrew: כִּי גֶחָלִים אַתָּה חֹתֶה עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ וַיהוָה יְשַׁלֶּם־לָךְ׃

verses.english: The north wind brings forth rain, and a secret tongue brings indignant faces.
verses.hebrew: רוּחַ צָפוֹן תְּחוֹלֵל גָּשֶׁם וּפָנִים נִזְעָמִים לְשׁוֹן סָתֶר׃

verses.english: Better to dwell on a corner of a roof than with a contentious wife in a shared house.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב שֶׁבֶת עַל־פִּנַּת־גָּג מֵאֵשֶׁת מדונים [מִדְיָנִים] וּבֵית חָבֶר׃

verses.english: Cold water upon a weary life, and a good report from a distant land.
verses.hebrew: מַיִם קָרִים עַל־נֶפֶשׁ עֲיֵפָה וּשְׁמוּעָה טוֹבָה מֵאֶרֶץ מֶרְחָק׃

verses.english: A muddied spring and a ruined fountain is a righteous person tottering before the wicked.
verses.hebrew: מַעְיָן נִרְפָּשׂ וּמָקוֹר מָשְׁחָת צַדִּיק מָט לִפְנֵי־רָשָׁע׃

verses.english: Eating much honey is not good, and searching out their glory is glory.
verses.hebrew: אָכֹל דְּבַשׁ הַרְבּוֹת לֹא־טוֹב וְחֵקֶר כְּבֹדָם כָּבוֹד׃

verses.english: A breached city without a wall is a man with no restraint over his spirit.
verses.hebrew: עִיר פְּרוּצָה אֵין חוֹמָה אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אֵין מַעְצָר לְרוּחוֹ׃

verses.english: Like snow in summer and rain at harvest, so honor does not suit a fool.
verses.hebrew: כַּשֶּׁלֶג בַּקַּיִץ וְכַמָּטָר בַּקָּצִיר כֵּן לֹא־נָאוֶה לִכְסִיל כָּבוֹד׃

verses.english: Like a bird fluttering, like a swallow flying, so a causeless curse does not come.
verses.hebrew: כַּצִּפּוֹר לָנוּד כַּדְּרוֹר לָעוּף כֵּן קִלְלַת חִנָּם לא [לוֹ] תָבֹא׃

verses.english: A whip for a horse, a bridle for a donkey, and a rod for the back of fools.
verses.hebrew: שׁוֹט לַסּוּס מֶתֶג לַחֲמוֹר וְשֵׁבֶט לְגֵו כְּסִילִים׃

verses.english: Do not answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also become like him.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּעַן כְּסִיל כְּאִוַּלְתּוֹ פֶּן־תִּשְׁוֶה־לּוֹ גַם־אָתָּה׃

verses.english: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he become wise in his own eyes.
verses.hebrew: עֲנֵה כְסִיל כְּאִוַּלְתּוֹ פֶּן־יִהְיֶה חָכָם בְּעֵינָיו׃

verses.english: One who sends words by the hand of a fool cuts off feet and drinks violence.
verses.hebrew: מְקַצֶּה רַגְלַיִם חָמָס שֹׁתֶה שֹׁלֵחַ דְּבָרִים בְּיַד־כְּסִיל׃

verses.english: Legs hang loose from a lame person, and a proverb in the mouth of fools.
verses.hebrew: דַּלְיוּ שֹׁקַיִם מִפִּסֵּחַ וּמָשָׁל בְּפִי כְסִילִים׃

verses.english: Like binding a stone in a sling, so is one who gives honor to a fool.
verses.hebrew: כִּצְרוֹר אֶבֶן בְּמַרְגֵּמָה כֵּן־נוֹתֵן לִכְסִיל כָּבוֹד׃

verses.english: A thorn rises in the hand of a drunkard, and a proverb in the mouth of fools.
verses.hebrew: חוֹחַ עָלָה בְיַד־שִׁכּוֹר וּמָשָׁל בְּפִי כְסִילִים׃

verses.english: An archer who wounds everyone, and one who hires a fool and hires passersby.
verses.hebrew: רַב מְחוֹלֵל־כֹּל וְשֹׂכֵר כְּסִיל וְשֹׂכֵר עֹבְרִים׃

verses.english: Like a dog returning to its vomit, a fool repeats his folly.
verses.hebrew: כְּכֶלֶב שָׁב עַל־קֵאוֹ כְּסִיל שׁוֹנֶה בְאִוַּלְתּוֹ׃

verses.english: H — [No corresponding text in the displayed Hebrew main text.]
verses.hebrew: כְּכֶלֶב שָׁב עַל־קֵאוֹ כְּסִיל שׁוֹנֶה בְאִוַּלְתּוֹ׃

verses.english: Have you seen a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
verses.hebrew: רָאִיתָ אִישׁ חָכָם בְּעֵינָיו תִּקְוָה לִכְסִיל מִמֶּנּוּ׃

verses.english: The lazy person says, “A lion is on the road! A lion is among the squares!”
verses.hebrew: אָמַר עָצֵל שַׁחַל בַּדָּרֶךְ אֲרִי בֵּין הָרְחֹבוֹת׃

verses.english: The door turns on its hinge, and the lazy person on his bed.
verses.hebrew: הַדֶּלֶת תִּסּוֹב עַל־צִירָהּ וְעָצֵל עַל־מִטָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: The lazy person buries his hand in the dish; he is too weary to bring it back to his mouth.
verses.hebrew: טָמַן עָצֵל יָדוֹ בַּצַּלָּחַת נִלְאָה לַהֲשִׁיבָהּ אֶל־פִּיו׃

verses.english: The lazy person is wiser in his own eyes than seven who return a discerning answer.
verses.hebrew: חָכָם עָצֵל בְּעֵינָיו מִשִּׁבְעָה מְשִׁיבֵי טָעַם׃

verses.english: One passing by who grows heated over a dispute not his own is grasping a dog by the ears.
verses.hebrew: מַחֲזִיק בְּאָזְנֵי־כָלֶב עֹבֵר מִתְעַבֵּר עַל־רִיב לֹּא־לוֹ׃

verses.english: Like a madman shooting firebrands, arrows, and death,
verses.hebrew: כְּמִתְלַהְלֵהַּ הַיֹּרֶה זִקִּים חִצִּים וָמָוֶת׃

verses.english: so is a man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not playing?”
verses.hebrew: כֵּן־אִישׁ רִמָּה אֶת־רֵעֵהוּ וְאָמַר הֲ‍לֹא־מְשַׂחֵק אָנִי׃

verses.english: When wood is absent, fire goes out, and when a whisperer is absent, dispute grows quiet.
verses.hebrew: בְּאֶפֶס עֵצִים תִּכְבֶּה־אֵשׁ וּבְאֵין נִרְגָּן יִשְׁתֹּק מָדוֹן׃

verses.english: Charcoal for embers and wood for fire, and a contentious man for kindling strife.
verses.hebrew: פֶּחָם לְגֶחָלִים וְעֵצִים לְאֵשׁ וְאִישׁ מדונים [מִדְיָנִים] לְחַרְחַר־רִיב׃

verses.english: A whisperer's words are like swallowed delicacies, and they descend into the chambers of the belly.
verses.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי נִרְגָּן כְּמִתְלַהֲמִים וְהֵם יָרְדוּ חַדְרֵי־בָטֶן׃

verses.english: Silver dross coated on earthenware— burning lips and an evil heart.
verses.hebrew: כֶּסֶף סִיגִים מְצֻפֶּה עַל־חָרֶשׂ שְׂפָתַיִם דֹּלְקִים וְלֶב־רָע׃

verses.english: One who hates disguises himself with his lips, but within him he sets deceit.
verses.hebrew: בשפתו [בִּשְׂפָתָיו] יִנָּכֵר שׂוֹנֵא וּבְקִרְבּוֹ יָשִׁית מִרְמָה׃

verses.english: When he makes his voice gracious, do not trust him, for seven abominations are in his heart.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־יְחַנֵּן קוֹלוֹ אַל־תַּאֲמֶן־בּוֹ כִּי שֶׁבַע תּוֹעֵבוֹת בְּלִבּוֹ׃

verses.english: Hatred may be covered by deception, but his evil will be revealed in the assembly.
verses.hebrew: תִּכַּסֶּה שִׂנְאָה בְּמַשָּׁאוֹן תִּגָּלֶה רָעָתוֹ בְקָהָל׃

verses.english: One who digs a pit falls into it, and one who rolls a stone—it returns upon him.
verses.hebrew: כֹּרֶה־שַּׁחַת בָּהּ יִפֹּל וְגֹלֵל אֶבֶן אֵלָיו תָּשׁוּב׃

verses.english: A lying tongue hates those it has crushed, and a smooth mouth works ruin.
verses.hebrew: לְשׁוֹן־שֶׁקֶר יִשְׂנָא דַכָּיו וּפֶה חָלָק יַעֲשֶׂה מִדְחֶה׃

verses.english: Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day will bear.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתְהַלֵּל בְּיוֹם מָחָר כִּי לֹא־תֵדַע מַה־יֵּלֶד יוֹם׃

verses.english: Let another praise you, and not your mouth, a foreigner, and not your lips.
verses.hebrew: יְהַלֶּלְךָ זָר וְלֹא־פִיךָ נָכְרִי וְאַל־שְׂפָתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: A stone's weight and a load of sand— a fool's vexation is heavier than both.
verses.hebrew: כֹּבֶד־אֶבֶן וְנֵטֶל הַחוֹל וְכַעַס אֱוִיל כָּבֵד מִשְּׁנֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Wrath is cruelty and anger a flood, but who can stand before jealousy?
verses.hebrew: אַכְזְרִיּוּת חֵמָה וְשֶׁטֶף אָף וּמִי יַעֲמֹד לִפְנֵי קִנְאָה׃

verses.english: Better open reproof than hidden love.
verses.hebrew: טוֹבָה תּוֹכַחַת מְגֻלָּה מֵאַהֲבָה מְסֻתָּרֶת׃

verses.english: Faithful are the wounds of one who loves, but profuse are the kisses of one who hates.
verses.hebrew: נֶאֱמָנִים פִּצְעֵי אוֹהֵב וְנַעְתָּרוֹת נְשִׁיקוֹת שׂוֹנֵא׃

verses.english: A satisfied appetite tramples honey-drippings, but to a hungry appetite every bitter thing is sweet.
verses.hebrew: נֶפֶשׁ שְׂבֵעָה תָּבוּס נֹפֶת וְנֶפֶשׁ רְעֵבָה כָּל־מַר מָתוֹק׃

verses.english: Like a bird wandering from its nest, so is a man wandering from his place.
verses.hebrew: כְּצִפּוֹר נוֹדֶדֶת מִן־קִנָּהּ כֵּן־אִישׁ נוֹדֵד מִמְּקוֹמוֹ׃

verses.english: Oil and incense gladden the heart, and a companion's sweetness comes from counsel of the soul.
verses.hebrew: שֶׁמֶן וּקְטֹרֶת יְשַׂמַּח־לֵב וּמֶתֶק רֵעֵהוּ מֵעֲצַת־נָפֶשׁ׃

verses.english: Do not abandon your companion or your father's companion, and do not enter your brother's house on your day of calamity; better a nearby neighbor than a distant brother.
verses.hebrew: רֵעֲךָ ורעה [וְרֵעַ] אָבִיךָ אַל־תַּעֲזֹב וּבֵית אָחִיךָ אַל־תָּבוֹא בְּיוֹם אֵידֶךָ טוֹב שָׁכֵן קָרוֹב מֵאָח רָחוֹק׃

verses.english: Be wise, my son, and gladden my heart, so that I may return a word to the one reproaching me.
verses.hebrew: חֲכַם בְּנִי וְשַׂמַּח לִבִּי וְאָשִׁיבָה חֹרְפִי דָבָר׃

verses.english: A shrewd person sees evil and hides; the simple pass on and are penalized.
verses.hebrew: עָרוּם רָאָה רָעָה נִסְתָּר פְּתָאיִם עָבְרוּ נֶעֱנָשׁוּ׃

verses.english: Take his garment, for he guaranteed a stranger, and for a foreign woman take a pledge from him.
verses.hebrew: קַח־בִּגְדוֹ כִּי־עָרַב זָר וּבְעַד נָכְרִיָּה חַבְלֵהוּ׃

verses.english: One who blesses his companion with a loud voice early in the morning— it will be counted as a curse to him.
verses.hebrew: מְבָרֵךְ רֵעֵהוּ בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל בַּבֹּקֶר הַשְׁכֵּים קְלָלָה תֵּחָשֶׁב לוֹ׃

verses.english: A persistent dripping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike.
verses.hebrew: דֶּלֶף טוֹרֵד בְּיוֹם סַגְרִיר וְאֵשֶׁת מדונים [מִדְיָנִים] נִשְׁתָּוָה׃

verses.english: One who restrains her restrains wind, and oil in his right hand calls out.
verses.hebrew: צֹפְנֶיהָ צָפַן־רוּחַ וְשֶׁמֶן יְמִינוֹ יִקְרָא׃

verses.english: Iron sharpens iron, and a man sharpens the face of his companion.
verses.hebrew: בַּרְזֶל בְּבַרְזֶל יָחַד וְאִישׁ יַחַד פְּנֵי־רֵעֵהוּ׃

verses.english: One who guards a fig tree eats its fruit, and one who watches over his master will be honored.
verses.hebrew: נֹצֵר תְּאֵנָה יֹאכַל פִּרְיָהּ וְשֹׁמֵר אֲדֹנָיו יְכֻבָּד׃

verses.english: As in water face answers face, so a person's heart answers a person.
verses.hebrew: כַּמַּיִם הַפָּנִים לַפָּנִים כֵּן לֵב־הָאָדָם לָאָדָם׃

verses.english: Sheol and destruction are not satisfied, and human eyes are not satisfied.
verses.hebrew: שְׁאוֹל ואבדה [וַאֲבַדּוֹ] לֹא תִשְׂבַּעְנָה וְעֵינֵי הָאָדָם לֹא תִשְׂבַּעְנָה׃

verses.english: A crucible for silver and a furnace for gold, and a man according to his praise.
verses.hebrew: מַצְרֵף לַכֶּסֶף וְכוּר לַזָּהָב וְאִישׁ לְפִי מַהֲלָלוֹ׃
