verses.english: Even if you pound a fool in a mortar among crushed grain with a pestle, his folly will not turn from him.
verses.hebrew: אִם תִּכְתּוֹשׁ־אֶת־הָאֱוִיל בַּמַּכְתֵּשׁ בְּתוֹךְ הָרִיפוֹת בַּעֱלִי לֹא־תָסוּר מֵעָלָיו אִוַּלְתּוֹ׃

verses.english: Know well the faces of your flock; set your heart upon the herds,
verses.hebrew: יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע פְּנֵי צֹאנֶךָ שִׁית לִבְּךָ לַעֲדָרִים׃

verses.english: for wealth is not forever, nor is a crown for generation after generation.
verses.hebrew: כִּי לֹא לְעוֹלָם חֹסֶן וְאִם־נֵזֶר לְדוֹר דור [וָדוֹר׃]

verses.english: When grass is removed and fresh growth appears, and the mountain herbs are gathered,
verses.hebrew: גָּלָה חָצִיר וְנִרְאָה־דֶשֶׁא וְנֶאֶסְפוּ עִשְּׂבוֹת הָרִים׃

verses.english: lambs are for your clothing, and male goats are the price of a field,
verses.hebrew: כְּבָשִׂים לִלְבוּשֶׁךָ וּמְחִיר שָׂדֶה עַתּוּדִים׃

verses.english: and there is enough goats' milk for your food, for the food of your household, and sustenance for your young women.
verses.hebrew: וְדֵי חֲלֵב עִזִּים לְלַחְמְךָ לְלֶחֶם בֵּיתֶךָ וְחַיִּים לְנַעֲרוֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: The wicked flee when no one pursues, but the righteous are confident like a young lion.
verses.hebrew: נָסוּ וְאֵין־רֹדֵף רָשָׁע וְצַדִּיקִים כִּכְפִיר יִבְטָח׃

verses.english: Through a land’s transgression its rulers are many, but through an understanding, knowledgeable person, it endures.
verses.hebrew: בְּפֶשַׁע אֶרֶץ רַבִּים שָׂרֶיהָ וּבְאָדָם מֵבִין יֹדֵעַ כֵּן יַאֲרִיךְ׃

verses.english: A poor man who oppresses the lowly is a sweeping rain that leaves no bread.
verses.hebrew: גֶּבֶר רָשׁ וְעֹשֵׁק דַּלִּים מָטָר סֹחֵף וְאֵין לָחֶם׃

verses.english: Those who abandon instruction praise the wicked, but those who keep instruction contend with them.
verses.hebrew: עֹזְבֵי תוֹרָה יְהַלְלוּ רָשָׁע וְשֹׁמְרֵי תוֹרָה יִתְגָּרוּ בָם׃

verses.english: Evil people do not understand judgment, but those who seek YHWH understand everything.
verses.hebrew: אַנְשֵׁי־רָע לֹא־יָבִינוּ מִשְׁפָּט וּמְבַקְשֵׁי יְהוָה יָבִינוּ כֹל׃

verses.english: Better a poor person walking in integrity than someone crooked in two ways, though rich.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב־רָשׁ הוֹלֵךְ בְּתֻמּוֹ מֵעִקֵּשׁ דְּרָכַיִם וְהוּא עָשִׁיר׃

verses.english: One who keeps instruction is an understanding son, but a companion of gluttons shames his father.
verses.hebrew: נוֹצֵר תּוֹרָה בֵּן מֵבִין וְרֹעֶה זוֹלְלִים יַכְלִים אָבִיו׃

verses.english: One who increases his wealth by interest and increase gathers it for one who is gracious to the poor.
verses.hebrew: מַרְבֶּה הוֹנוֹ בְּנֶשֶׁךְ ובתרבית [וְתַרְבִּית] לְחוֹנֵן דַּלִּים יִקְבְּצֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: One who turns his ear away from hearing instruction— even his prayer is an abomination.
verses.hebrew: מֵסִיר אָזְנוֹ מִשְּׁמֹעַ תּוֹרָה גַּם־תְּפִלָּתוֹ תּוֹעֵבָה׃

verses.english: One who leads the upright astray on an evil way will himself fall into his own pit, but the blameless will inherit good.
verses.hebrew: מַשְׁגֶּה יְשָׁרִים בְּדֶרֶךְ רָע בִּשְׁחוּתוֹ הוּא־יִפּוֹל וּתְמִימִים יִנְחֲלוּ־טוֹב׃

verses.english: A rich man is wise in his own eyes, but an understanding poor person searches him out.
verses.hebrew: חָכָם בְּעֵינָיו אִישׁ עָשִׁיר וְדַל מֵבִין יַחְקְרֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: When the righteous rejoice, glory is great, but when the wicked arise, a person is searched out.
verses.hebrew: בַּעֲלֹץ צַדִּיקִים רַבָּה תִפְאָרֶת וּבְקוּם רְשָׁעִים יְחֻפַּשׂ אָדָם׃

verses.english: One who covers his transgressions will not prosper, but one who confesses and forsakes them will receive mercy.
verses.hebrew: מְכַסֶּה פְשָׁעָיו לֹא יַצְלִיחַ וּמוֹדֶה וְעֹזֵב יְרֻחָם׃

verses.english: Happy is the person who remains fearful always, but one who hardens his heart will fall into evil.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם מְפַחֵד תָּמִיד וּמַקְשֶׁה לִבּוֹ יִפּוֹל בְּרָעָה׃

verses.english: A roaring lion and a rushing bear— a wicked ruler over a poor people.
verses.hebrew: אֲרִי־נֹהֵם וְדֹב שׁוֹקֵק מֹשֵׁל רָשָׁע עַל עַם־דָּל׃

verses.english: A ruler lacking understanding is great in oppressions; one who hates unjust gain will lengthen his days.
verses.hebrew: נָגִיד חֲסַר תְּבוּנוֹת וְרַב מַעֲשַׁקּוֹת שנאי [שֹׂנֵא] בֶצַע יַאֲרִיךְ יָמִים׃

verses.english: A person burdened with the blood of a life will flee to the pit; let no one support him.
verses.hebrew: אָדָם עָשֻׁק בְּדַם־נָפֶשׁ עַד־בּוֹר יָנוּס אַל־יִתְמְכוּ־בוֹ׃

verses.english: H — [No corresponding Hebrew text at this location.]
verses.hebrew: אָדָם עָשֻׁק בְּדַם־נָפֶשׁ עַד־בּוֹר יָנוּס אַל־יִתְמְכוּ־בוֹ׃

verses.english: One who walks blamelessly will be saved, but one crooked in two ways will fall in one.
verses.hebrew: הוֹלֵךְ תָּמִים יִוָּשֵׁעַ וְנֶעְקַשׁ דְּרָכַיִם יִפּוֹל בְּאֶחָת׃

verses.english: One who works his land will be filled with bread, but one who pursues empty things will be filled with poverty.
verses.hebrew: עֹבֵד אַדְמָתוֹ יִשְׂבַּע־לָחֶם וּמְרַדֵּף רֵקִים יִשְׂבַּע־רִישׁ׃

verses.english: A faithful person has many blessings, but one hurrying to become rich will not go unpunished.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ אֱמוּנוֹת רַב־בְּרָכוֹת וְאָץ לְהַעֲשִׁיר לֹא יִנָּקֶה׃

verses.english: Showing partiality is not good, yet for a morsel of bread a man will transgress.
verses.hebrew: הַכֵּר־פָּנִים לֹא־טוֹב וְעַל־פַּת־לֶחֶם יִפְשַׁע־גָּבֶר׃

verses.english: A man with an evil eye hastens after wealth and does not know that want will come upon him.
verses.hebrew: נִבֳהָל לַהוֹן אִישׁ רַע עָיִן וְלֹא־יֵדַע כִּי־חֶסֶר יְבֹאֶנּוּ׃

verses.english: One who reproves a person will afterward find more favor than one who smooths with the tongue.
verses.hebrew: מוֹכִיחַ אָדָם אַחֲרַי חֵן יִמְצָא מִמַּחֲלִיק לָשׁוֹן׃

verses.english: One who robs his father and his mother and says, ‘There is no transgression,’ is a companion of a destroying man.
verses.hebrew: גּוֹזֵל אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ וְאֹמֵר אֵין־פָּשַׁע חָבֵר הוּא לְאִישׁ מַשְׁחִית׃

verses.english: One with a wide appetite stirs up strife, but one who trusts in YHWH will be well fed.
verses.hebrew: רְחַב־נֶפֶשׁ יְגָרֶה מָדוֹן וּבוֹטֵחַ עַל־יְהוָה יְדֻשָּׁן׃

verses.english: One who trusts in his own heart is a fool, but one who walks in wisdom will escape.
verses.hebrew: בּוֹטֵחַ בְּלִבּוֹ הוּא כְסִיל וְהוֹלֵךְ בְּחָכְמָה הוּא יִמָּלֵט׃

verses.english: One who gives to the poor has no lack, but one who hides his eyes has many curses.
verses.hebrew: נוֹתֵן לָרָשׁ אֵין מַחְסוֹר וּמַעְלִים עֵינָיו רַב־מְאֵרוֹת׃

verses.english: When the wicked arise, a person hides, but when they perish, the righteous increase.
verses.hebrew: בְּקוּם רְשָׁעִים יִסָּתֵר אָדָם וּבְאָבְדָם יִרְבּוּ צַדִּיקִים׃

verses.english: A man often reproved who stiffens his neck will suddenly be broken, with no healing.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ תּוֹכָחוֹת מַקְשֶׁה־עֹרֶף פֶּתַע יִשָּׁבֵר וְאֵין מַרְפֵּא׃

verses.english: When the righteous increase, the people rejoice; but when a wicked person rules, the people groan.
verses.hebrew: בִּרְבוֹת צַדִּיקִים יִשְׂמַח הָעָם וּבִמְשֹׁל רָשָׁע יֵאָנַח עָם׃

verses.english: A man who loves wisdom makes his father glad, but a companion of prostitutes destroys wealth.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ־אֹהֵב חָכְמָה יְשַׂמַּח אָבִיו וְרֹעֶה זוֹנוֹת יְאַבֶּד־הוֹן׃

verses.english: A king establishes a land through judgment, but a man of exactions tears it down.
verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ בְּמִשְׁפָּט יַעֲמִיד אָרֶץ וְאִישׁ תְּרוּמוֹת יֶהֶרְסֶנָּה׃

verses.english: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net over his steps.
verses.hebrew: גֶּבֶר מַחֲלִיק עַל־רֵעֵהוּ רֶשֶׁת פּוֹרֵשׂ עַל־פְּעָמָיו׃

verses.english: In an evil man’s transgression is a snare, but a righteous person sings out and rejoices.
verses.hebrew: בְּפֶשַׁע אִישׁ רָע מוֹקֵשׁ וְצַדִּיק יָרוּן וְשָׂמֵחַ׃

verses.english: A righteous person knows the cause of the poor; a wicked person does not understand such knowledge.
verses.hebrew: יֹדֵעַ צַדִּיק דִּין דַּלִּים רָשָׁע לֹא־יָבִין דָּעַת׃

verses.english: Scoffing men inflame a city, but wise people turn away anger.
verses.hebrew: אַנְשֵׁי לָצוֹן יָפִיחוּ קִרְיָה וַחֲכָמִים יָשִׁיבוּ אָף׃

verses.english: When a wise man enters judgment with a foolish man, there is raging and laughing, but no rest.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ־חָכָם נִשְׁפָּט אֶת־אִישׁ אֱוִיל וְרָגַז וְשָׂחַק וְאֵין נָחַת׃

verses.english: Men of blood hate a blameless person, but the upright seek his life.
verses.hebrew: אַנְשֵׁי דָמִים יִשְׂנְאוּ־תָם וִישָׁרִים יְבַקְשׁוּ נַפְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: A fool lets out all his spirit, but a wise person holds it back.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־רוּחוֹ יוֹצִיא כְסִיל וְחָכָם בְּאָחוֹר יְשַׁבְּחֶנָּה׃

verses.english: When a ruler listens to a lying word, all his attendants are wicked.
verses.hebrew: מֹשֵׁל מַקְשִׁיב עַל־דְּבַר־שָׁקֶר כָּל־מְשָׁרְתָיו רְשָׁעִים׃

verses.english: A poor person and a man of oppression meet together; YHWH gives light to the eyes of both.
verses.hebrew: רָשׁ וְאִישׁ תְּכָכִים נִפְגָּשׁוּ מֵאִיר־עֵינֵי שְׁנֵיהֶם יְהוָה׃

verses.english: A king who judges the poor in truth— his throne will be established forever.
verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ שׁוֹפֵט בֶּאֱמֶת דַּלִּים כִּסְאוֹ לָעַד יִכּוֹן׃

verses.english: A rod and reproof give wisdom, but a youth left loose shames his mother.
verses.hebrew: שֵׁבֶט וְתוֹכַחַת יִתֵּן חָכְמָה וְנַעַר מְשֻׁלָּח מֵבִישׁ אִמּוֹ׃

verses.english: When the wicked increase, transgression increases, but the righteous will see their downfall.
verses.hebrew: בִּרְבוֹת רְשָׁעִים יִרְבֶּה־פָּשַׁע וְצַדִּיקִים בְּמַפַּלְתָּם יִרְאוּ׃

verses.english: Discipline your son, and he will give you rest and give delights to your life.
verses.hebrew: יַסֵּר בִּנְךָ וִינִיחֶךָ וְיִתֵּן מַעֲדַנִּים לְנַפְשֶׁךָ׃

verses.english: Where there is no vision, a people runs loose, but happy is one who keeps instruction.
verses.hebrew: בְּאֵין חָזוֹן יִפָּרַע עָם וְשֹׁמֵר תּוֹרָה אַשְׁרֵהוּ׃

verses.english: A servant is not disciplined by words, for though he understands, there is no response.
verses.hebrew: בִּדְבָרִים לֹא־יִוָּסֶר עָבֶד כִּי־יָבִין וְאֵין מַעֲנֶה׃

verses.english: Have you seen a man hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
verses.hebrew: חָזִיתָ אִישׁ אָץ בִּדְבָרָיו תִּקְוָה לִכְסִיל מִמֶּנּוּ׃

verses.english: One who pampers his servant from youth— in the end he will become a son.
verses.hebrew: מְפַנֵּק מִנֹּעַר עַבְדּוֹ וְאַחֲרִיתוֹ יִהְיֶה מָנוֹן׃

verses.english: An angry man stirs up strife, and a hot-tempered person has much transgression.
verses.hebrew: אִישׁ־אַף יְגָרֶה מָדוֹן וּבַעַל חֵמָה רַב־פָּשַׁע׃

verses.english: A person’s pride brings him low, but one lowly in spirit will hold honor.
verses.hebrew: גַּאֲוַת אָדָם תַּשְׁפִּילֶנּוּ וּשְׁפַל־רוּחַ יִתְמֹךְ כָּבוֹד׃

verses.english: One who shares with a thief hates his own life; he hears an oath-curse but does not report.
verses.hebrew: חוֹלֵק עִם־גַּנָּב שׂוֹנֵא נַפְשׁוֹ אָלָה יִשְׁמַע וְלֹא יַגִּיד׃

verses.english: Fear of people sets a snare, but one who trusts in YHWH will be set on high.
verses.hebrew: חֶרְדַּת אָדָם יִתֵּן מוֹקֵשׁ וּבוֹטֵחַ בַּיהוָה יְשֻׂגָּב׃

verses.english: Many seek a ruler’s face, but a person’s judgment comes from YHWH.
verses.hebrew: רַבִּים מְבַקְשִׁים פְּנֵי־מוֹשֵׁל וּמֵיְהוָה מִשְׁפַּט־אִישׁ׃

verses.english: An unjust man is an abomination to the righteous, and one upright in way is an abomination to the wicked.
verses.hebrew: תּוֹעֲבַת צַדִּיקִים אִישׁ עָוֶל וְתוֹעֲבַת רָשָׁע יְשַׁר־דָּרֶךְ׃

verses.english: The words of Agur son of Jakeh, the oracle. The utterance of the man to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:
verses.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי אָגוּר בִּן־יָקֶה הַמַּשָּׂא נְאֻם הַגֶּבֶר לְאִיתִיאֵל לְאִיתִיאֵל וְאֻכָל׃

verses.english: For I am more brutish than a man, and human understanding is not mine.
verses.hebrew: כִּי בַעַר אָנֹכִי מֵאִישׁ וְלֹא־בִינַת אָדָם לִי׃

verses.english: And I have not learned wisdom, and knowledge of holy ones I know.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־לָמַדְתִּי חָכְמָה וְדַעַת קְדֹשִׁים אֵדָע׃

verses.english: Who has gone up to heaven and come down? Who has gathered wind in his cupped hands? Who has bound water in a garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?
verses.hebrew: מִי עָלָה־שָׁמַיִם וַיֵּרַד מִי אָסַף־רוּחַ בְּחָפְנָיו מִי צָרַר־מַיִם בַּשִּׂמְלָה מִי הֵקִים כָּל־אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ מַה־שְּׁמוֹ וּמַה־שֶּׁם־בְּנוֹ כִּי תֵדָע׃

verses.english: Every saying of God is refined; He is a shield to those who take refuge in Him.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־אִמְרַת אֱלוֹהַּ צְרוּפָה מָגֵן הוּא לַחֹסִים בּוֹ׃

verses.english: Do not add to His words, lest He reprove you and you be found false.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תּוֹסְףְּ עַל־דְּבָרָיו פֶּן־יוֹכִיחַ בְּךָ וְנִכְזָבְתָּ׃

verses.english: Two things I have asked of You; do not withhold them from me before I die:
verses.hebrew: שְׁתַּיִם שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאִתָּךְ אַל־תִּמְנַע מִמֶּנִּי בְּטֶרֶם אָמוּת׃

verses.english: Keep emptiness and a lying word far from me; give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me the bread allotted to me,
verses.hebrew: שָׁוְא וּדְבַר־כָּזָב הַרְחֵק מִמֶּנִּי רֵאשׁ וָעֹשֶׁר אַל־תִּתֶּן־לִי הַטְרִיפֵנִי לֶחֶם חֻקִּי׃

verses.english: lest I be full and deny, saying, ‘Who is YHWH?’ or lest I become poor and steal and seize upon the name of my God.
verses.hebrew: פֶּן אֶשְׂבַּע וְכִחַשְׁתִּי וְאָמַרְתִּי מִי יְהוָה וּפֶן־אִוָּרֵשׁ וְגָנַבְתִּי וְתָפַשְׂתִּי שֵׁם אֱלֹהָי׃

verses.english: Do not slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you and you incur guilt.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּלְשֵׁן עֶבֶד אֶל־אדנו [אֲדֹנָיו] פֶּן־יְקַלֶּלְךָ וְאָשָׁמְתָּ׃

verses.english: A generation curses its father and does not bless its mother.
verses.hebrew: דּוֹר אָבִיו יְקַלֵּל וְאֶת־אִמּוֹ לֹא יְבָרֵךְ׃

verses.english: A generation is pure in its own eyes, but has not been washed from its filth.
verses.hebrew: דּוֹר טָהוֹר בְּעֵינָיו וּמִצֹּאָתוֹ לֹא רֻחָץ׃

verses.english: A generation—how lofty its eyes are, and its eyelids are lifted!
verses.hebrew: דּוֹר מָה־רָמוּ עֵינָיו וְעַפְעַפָּיו יִנָּשֵׂאוּ׃

verses.english: A generation whose teeth are swords and whose jaws are knives, to devour the poor from the earth and the needy from humanity.
verses.hebrew: דּוֹר חֲרָבוֹת שִׁנָּיו וּמַאֲכָלוֹת מְתַלְּעֹתָיו לֶאֱכֹל עֲנִיִּים מֵאֶרֶץ וְאֶבְיוֹנִים מֵאָדָם׃

verses.english: The leech has two daughters: ‘Give! Give!’ Three things are not satisfied; four have not said, ‘Enough!’
verses.hebrew: לַעֲלוּקָה שְׁתֵּי בָנוֹת הַב הַב שָׁלוֹשׁ הֵנָּה לֹא תִשְׂבַּעְנָה אַרְבַּע לֹא־אָמְרוּ הוֹן׃

verses.english: Sheol, a closed womb, a land not satisfied with water, and fire that has not said, ‘Enough!’
verses.hebrew: שְׁאוֹל וְעֹצֶר רָחַם אֶרֶץ לֹא־שָׂבְעָה מַּיִם וְאֵשׁ לֹא־אָמְרָה הוֹן׃

verses.english: An eye that mocks a father and scorns obedience to a mother— ravens of the valley will peck it out, and young eagles will eat it.
verses.hebrew: עַיִן תִּלְעַג לְאָב וְתָבוּז לִיקֲּהַת־אֵם יִקְּרוּהָ עֹרְבֵי־נַחַל וְיֹאכְלוּהָ בְנֵי־נָשֶׁר׃

verses.english: Three things are too wonderful for me, and four I do not know:
verses.hebrew: שְׁלֹשָׁה הֵמָּה נִפְלְאוּ מִמֶּנִּי וארבע [וְאַרְבָּעָה] לֹא יְדַעְתִּים׃

verses.english: the way of an eagle in the heavens, the way of a snake upon a rock, the way of a ship in the heart of the sea, and the way of a man with a young woman.
verses.hebrew: דֶּרֶךְ הַנֶּשֶׁר בַּשָּׁמַיִם דֶּרֶךְ נָחָשׁ עֲלֵי צוּר דֶּרֶךְ־אֳנִיָּה בְלֶב־יָם וְדֶרֶךְ גֶּבֶר בְּעַלְמָה׃

verses.english: Such is the way of an adulterous woman: she eats and wipes her mouth and says, ‘I have done no wrong.’
verses.hebrew: כֵּן דֶּרֶךְ אִשָּׁה מְנָאָפֶת אָכְלָה וּמָחֲתָה פִיהָ וְאָמְרָה לֹא־פָעַלְתִּי אָוֶן׃

verses.english: Under three things the earth trembles, and under four it cannot bear up:
verses.hebrew: תַּחַת שָׁלוֹשׁ רָגְזָה אֶרֶץ וְתַחַת אַרְבַּע לֹא־תוּכַל שְׂאֵת׃

verses.english: under a servant when he becomes king, and a fool when he is filled with bread,
verses.hebrew: תַּחַת־עֶבֶד כִּי יִמְלוֹךְ וְנָבָל כִּי יִשְׂבַּע־לָחֶם׃

verses.english: under an unloved woman when she is married, and a maidservant when she inherits from her mistress.
verses.hebrew: תַּחַת שְׂנוּאָה כִּי תִבָּעֵל וְשִׁפְחָה כִּי־תִירַשׁ גְּבִרְתָּהּ׃

verses.english: Four things are small on the earth, yet they are exceedingly wise:
verses.hebrew: אַרְבָּעָה הֵם קְטַנֵּי־אָרֶץ וְהֵמָּה חֲכָמִים מְחֻכָּמִים׃

verses.english: the ants are a people without strength, yet they prepare their bread in summer;
verses.hebrew: הַנְּמָלִים עַם לֹא־עָז וַיָּכִינוּ בַקַּיִץ לַחְמָם׃

verses.english: the rock badgers are a people without might, yet they make their house in the crag;
verses.hebrew: שְׁפַנִּים עַם לֹא־עָצוּם וַיָּשִׂימוּ בַסֶּלַע בֵּיתָם׃

verses.english: the locust has no king, yet all of it goes out in ranks;
verses.hebrew: מֶלֶךְ אֵין לָאַרְבֶּה וַיֵּצֵא חֹצֵץ כֻּלּוֹ׃

verses.english: The lizard you can grasp with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.
verses.hebrew: שְׂמָמִית בְּיָדַיִם תְּתַפֵּשׂ וְהִיא בְּהֵיכְלֵי מֶלֶךְ׃

verses.english: Three things are stately in their stride, and four are stately in walking:
verses.hebrew: שְׁלֹשָׁה הֵמָּה מֵיטִיבֵי צָעַד וְאַרְבָּעָה מֵיטִבֵי לָכֶת׃

verses.english: the lion, mighty among beasts, which does not turn back before anything;
verses.hebrew: לַיִשׁ גִּבּוֹר בַּבְּהֵמָה וְלֹא־יָשׁוּב מִפְּנֵי־כֹל׃

verses.english: the one girded at the loins, or the male goat, and a king against whom none rises.
verses.hebrew: זַרְזִיר מָתְנַיִם אוֹ־תָיִשׁ וּמֶלֶךְ אַלְקוּם עִמּוֹ׃

verses.english: If you have acted foolishly by exalting yourself, or if you have schemed—put a hand to your mouth.
verses.hebrew: אִם־נָבַלְתָּ בְהִתְנַשֵּׂא וְאִם־זַמּוֹתָ יָד לְפֶה׃

verses.english: For pressing milk brings out curds, and pressing the nose brings out blood, and pressing anger brings out strife.
verses.hebrew: כִּי מִיץ חָלָב יוֹצִיא חֶמְאָה וּמִיץ־אַף יוֹצִיא דָם וּמִיץ אַפַּיִם יוֹצִיא רִיב׃

verses.english: The words of King Lemuel, an oracle with which his mother instructed him.
verses.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי לְמוּאֵל מֶלֶךְ מַשָּׂא אֲ‍שֶׁר־יִסְּרַתּוּ אִמּוֹ׃

verses.english: What, my son? And what, son of my womb? And what, son of my vows?
verses.hebrew: מַה־בְּרִי וּמַה־בַּר־בִּטְנִי וּמֶה בַּר־נְדָרָי׃

verses.english: Do not give your strength to women, or your ways to what destroys kings.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּתֵּן לַנָּשִׁים חֵילֶךָ וּדְרָכֶיךָ לַמְחוֹת מְלָכִין׃

verses.english: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for rulers to ask, ‘Where is strong drink?’
verses.hebrew: אַל לַמְלָכִים לְמוֹאֵל אַל לַמְלָכִים שְׁתוֹ־יָיִן וּלְרוֹזְנִים או [אֵי] שֵׁכָר׃

verses.english: lest he drink and forget what is decreed and alter the cause of all the afflicted.
verses.hebrew: פֶּן־יִשְׁתֶּה וְיִשְׁכַּח מְחֻקָּק וִישַׁנֶּה דִּין כָּל־בְּנֵי־עֹנִי׃

verses.english: Give strong drink to one who is perishing, and wine to those bitter in life.
verses.hebrew: תְּנוּ־שֵׁכָר לְאוֹבֵד וְיַיִן לְמָרֵי נָפֶשׁ׃

verses.english: Let him drink and forget his poverty and remember his trouble no more.
verses.hebrew: יִשְׁתֶּה וְיִשְׁכַּח רִישׁוֹ וַעֲמָלוֹ לֹא יִזְכָּר־עוֹד׃

verses.english: Open your mouth for the mute, for the cause of all those passing away.
verses.hebrew: פְּתַח־פִּיךָ לְאִלֵּם אֶל־דִּין כָּל־בְּנֵי חֲלוֹף׃

verses.english: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
verses.hebrew: פְּתַח־פִּיךָ שְׁפָט־צֶדֶק וְדִין עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן׃

verses.english: A woman of strength—who can find her? Her worth is far beyond precious stones.
verses.hebrew: אֵשֶׁת־חַיִל מִי יִמְצָא וְרָחֹק מִפְּנִינִים מִכְרָהּ׃

verses.english: Her husband’s heart trusts in her, and he will not lack spoil.
verses.hebrew: בָּטַח בָּהּ לֵב בַּעְלָהּ וְשָׁלָל לֹא יֶחְסָר׃

verses.english: She does him good and not evil all the days of her life.
verses.hebrew: גְּמָלַתְהוּ טוֹב וְלֹא־רָע כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיה׃

verses.english: She seeks wool and flax and works with willing hands.
verses.hebrew: דָּרְשָׁה צֶמֶר וּפִשְׁתִּים וַתַּעַשׂ בְּחֵפֶץ כַּפֶּיהָ׃

verses.english: She is like merchant ships; from afar she brings her bread.
verses.hebrew: הָיְתָה כָּאֳנִיּוֹת סוֹחֵר מִמֶּרְחָק תָּבִיא לַחְמָהּ׃

verses.english: She rises while it is still night and gives food to her household and an allotted portion to her servant girls.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּקָם בְּעוֹד לַיְלָה וַתִּתֵּן טֶרֶף לְבֵיתָהּ וְחֹק לְנַעֲרֹתֶיהָ׃

verses.english: She considers a field and acquires it; from the fruit of her hands she plants a vineyard.
verses.hebrew: זָמְמָה שָׂדֶה וַתִּקָּחֵהוּ מִפְּרִי כַפֶּיהָ נטע [נָטְעָה] כָּרֶם׃

verses.english: She girds her loins with strength and makes her arms strong.
verses.hebrew: חָגְרָה בְעוֹז מָתְנֶיהָ וַתְּאַמֵּץ זְרֹעוֹתֶיהָ׃

verses.english: She tastes that her trade is good; her lamp does not go out at night.
verses.hebrew: טָעֲמָה כִּי־טוֹב סַחְרָהּ לֹא־יִכְבֶּה בליל [בַלַּיְלָה] נֵרָהּ׃

verses.english: She stretches her hands to the distaff, and her palms hold the spindle.
verses.hebrew: יָדֶיהָ שִׁלְּחָה בַכִּישׁוֹר וְכַפֶּיהָ תָּמְכוּ פָלֶךְ׃

verses.english: She opens her palm to the poor and stretches her hands to the needy.
verses.hebrew: כַּפָּהּ פָּרְשָׂה לֶעָנִי וְיָדֶיהָ שִׁלְּחָה לָאֶבְיוֹן׃

verses.english: She does not fear snow for her household, for all her household is clothed in scarlet.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־תִירָא לְבֵיתָהּ מִשָּׁלֶג כִּי כָל־בֵּיתָהּ לָבֻשׁ שָׁנִים׃

verses.english: She makes coverings for herself; fine linen and purple are her clothing.
verses.hebrew: מַרְבַדִּים עָשְׂתָה־לָּהּ שֵׁשׁ וְאַרְגָּמָן לְבוּשָׁהּ׃

verses.english: Her husband is known in the gates when he sits with the elders of the land.
verses.hebrew: נוֹדָע בַּשְּׁעָרִים בַּעְלָהּ בְּשִׁבְתּוֹ עִם־זִקְנֵי־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: She makes linen cloth and sells it, and gives a belt to the merchant.
verses.hebrew: סָדִין עָשְׂתָה וַתִּמְכֹּר וַחֲגוֹר נָתְנָה לַכְּנַעֲנִי׃

verses.english: She opens her mouth with wisdom, and instruction of kindness is on her tongue.
verses.hebrew: פִּיהָ פָּתְחָה בְחָכְמָה וְתוֹרַת־חֶסֶד עַל־לְשׁוֹנָהּ׃

verses.english: Strength and splendor are her clothing, and she laughs at the day to come.
verses.hebrew: עֹז־וְהָדָר לְבוּשָׁהּ וַתִּשְׂחַק לְיוֹם אַחֲרוֹן׃

verses.english: She watches the ways of her household and does not eat the bread of idleness.
verses.hebrew: צוֹפִיָּה הֲלִיכוֹת בֵּיתָהּ וְלֶחֶם עַצְלוּת לֹא תֹאכֵל׃

verses.english: Her children rise and call her happy; her husband also praises her:
verses.hebrew: קָמוּ בָנֶיהָ וַיְאַשְּׁרוּהָ בַּעְלָהּ וַיְהַלְלָהּ׃

verses.english: ‘Many daughters have shown strength, but you surpass them all.’
verses.hebrew: רַבּוֹת בָּנוֹת עָשׂוּ חָיִל וְאַתְּ עָלִית עַל־כֻּלָּנָה׃

verses.english: Charm is false and beauty is a breath; a woman who fears YHWH—she is to be praised.
verses.hebrew: שֶׁקֶר הַחֵן וְהֶבֶל הַיֹּפִי אִשָּׁה יִרְאַת־יְהוָה הִיא תִתְהַלָּל׃

verses.english: Give her from the fruit of her hands, and let her works praise her in the gates.
verses.hebrew: תְּנוּ־לָהּ מִפְּרִי יָדֶיהָ וִיהַלְלוּהָ בַשְּׁעָרִים מַעֲשֶׂיהָ׃
